units.slavonic_text: [Внѣшняя переплетная доска памятника: кожанное тисненіе по доскамъ XVI–XVII вѣка. Тисненый орнаментальный окладъ съ геометрическими и растительными бордюрами. Во углахъ средника четыре круглыя клейма со символами святыхъ четырехъ евангелистовъ. Въ срединѣ овала пышный ренессансный плетеный медальонъ съ акантовыми листьями и растительными пальметтами. На правомъ краѣ видны слѣды мѣдныхъ застежекъ переплета.]
units.english_text: [Front binding board of the monument: contemporary 16th–17th century blind-tooled brown calf over wooden boards. Blind-tooled ornamental frame composed of geometric rules and foliate roll borders. At the four corners of the inner panel are four circular medallions depicting the symbols of the Four Evangelists. In the center is an elaborate Renaissance oval strapwork medallion adorned with acanthus leaves and palmettes. Traces of brass clasp mountings are visible on the fore-edge.]

units.english_text: Seeing that many zealous lovers of the Divine law take care concerning the sacred books, by which the Church of God is adorned, and the faith is defended, the praise of the Most High is multiplied, the faithful are confirmed, and heretics are confounded; and the people, raised up as if by a certain spur from slothfulness, are moved unto learning and are encouraged; and above all, by which God is entreated. Therefore, being desirous to print this book, I deemed it right to inform you in this preface—even as you were previously informed of this in the Liturgies[^3]—whence I arrived at this work, God prospering me: namely, having been moved by the writings of the blessed Meletios, Pope of Alexandria;[^4] but also, more than ten years ago, a synod having taken place in Brest of Lithuania,[^5] under Mikhail Rahoza, Metropolitan of Kyiv,[^6] and the other bishops then assembled, before his apostasy with his partisans from the One Holy Eastern Catholic Apostolic Church: there was much inquiry and consideration by them concerning the great discrepancy of Church rites, and especially concerning the Euchologion,[^7] that is, the Molitvoslovets or Trebnyk: by which, being instructed as by a certain artistic guidance, those who perform sacred rites accomplish decently all things pertaining to the perfect calling of Christianity, and agree in their prayers unto God. And having considered these matters at the synod, they entrusted to humble me, the Bishop of Lviv, to take all care and diligence concerning the correction of that book of the said Trebnyk. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: к книгоу сию
units.slavonic_text: къ кни́гоу сїю̀
units.english_text: I grieved exceedingly; but I found a remedy for my sorrow through an epistle sent to the most blessed Meletios, Pope of Alexandria—who had attained to the height of external wisdom and of our noble instruction, as an excellent steersman of the ship of Christ, who was then administering the place of the Throne of Constantinople[^10]—informing him concerning the discordance and lack of correction in our Slavonic books, whether on account of unskilled scribes or because of certain other causes; and at the same time beseeching him that, for the sake of certain and unconflicting knowledge of the Church services, he would send us a Greek Euchologion. And he did not disregard my petition, but sent me a Sluzhebnik, and this book, the Trebnyk, well corrected according to the ancient Trebnyks of the Holy Mountain;[^11] which also he signed with his own hand with his pastoral blessing, commanding that it be printed for the common benefit of the renowned Russian race.[^12] And since I had as my fellow laborer in this work the noble Teodor Yurievych Balaban, the son of my brother, with whom having established a printing house in our ancestral estate of Striatyn,[^13] fittingly, as was most urgent, with typographical instruments, having previously an urge toward this, as I said before, [encouraged] by the most blessed Meletios: we first printed the Sluzhebniks,[^14] and thereafter we resolved to print this Trebnyk; in which, lest anyone reproach us among those who delight in dissension concerning certain matters—especially concerning the Proskomedia,[^15] and concerning the particles of bread placed upon the diskos on account of discordance with ancient manuscript Sluzhebniks: let each know that not from my own opinion or speculation did I thus set this down; but having commanded [the translators] to interpret into Slavonic with all diligence the understanding and exposition concerning this formerly of blessed memory Jeremiah, Ecumenical Patriarch,[^16] who also traveled as a pilgrim here among us, and likewise of the most blessed Meletios, from the Greek books sent unto us by him, we have thus set it down. And having translated also this book, the Trebnyk,[^17] to issue it for the common need of the churches: yet lest there be any differing opinion concerning this also, we commanded that there be a synod of priests experienced in the sacred rites, to inspect and examine it. And I saw it to be necessary that what is found in our old Slavonic Trebnyks—namely, how to receive those coming from various heresies unto the Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church,[^18] the Consecration of the Great Myron,[^19] and the rest—lest the book be deficient in this also, we commanded to append this as well. And if there are any who take offense at this, that the authors of all the sequences are not known, let such know that neither do we know [the authors] for the other sequences of the Church's holy mysteries—namely, Baptism, Holy Unction,[^20] and others; yet we know from the commandments of the Holy Apostles that these were instituted by them. Concerning which also the fiery-tongued Dionysius the Areopagite in the book *On the Ecclesiastical Hierarchy* clearly testifies (that these were handed down by the Apostles),[^21] and the rest by the Holy Fathers; which, having received from both, we firmly maintain. For if, as the Great Basil says, we begin to neglect unwritten customs as having little force, we shall unawares bring harm even unto the written things themselves.[^22] And the Divine Chrysostom said: Hence it is manifest that the Apostles did not hand down all things by writing, but many things also unwritten; and both the one and the other are alike worthy of belief. Therefore we also deem the tradition of the Church worthy of belief: it is a tradition; seek nothing further.[^23] And when I was occupied with other necessary Church needs, and was taking care concerning other books—namely, Psalters and Didactic Gospels—to issue them from my printing house of Krylos,[^24] the aforementioned noble Teodor Yurievych Balaban zealously applied himself unto the work of this book: a man flourishing in many righteous deeds, and exceedingly [a fervent lover] of the pious dogma and the traditions of the fathers, a fervent lover, who not in word only, but also in deed kept blamelessly the piety of the fathers. And especially where many of the multitude who go abroad—I mean to Italy[^25]—being beguiled by the vain philosophy of secular learning, fall into various heresies, and being stripped of piety fall away from the Church. But he, having lived there for a long time in his youth, harmed not piety, and turned aside not even a little from the traditions of the Eastern Church; but even as one in the midst of fire remained unburned, or as one in the midst of the sea's surges suffered no shipwreck. Therefore I praise him; on account of the righteousness of his virtue I praise him; whose zeal and care in this was to issue into the light of day the books necessary for the Church: among which, after the Sluzhebnik, he took diligence to print this Trebnyk from his printing house of Striatyn, with the counsel and blessing of our humility, at his own cost and expense, having gathered for this work men skilled in that craft. Who, before this book had yet reached its completion, passed away, the faithful servant of his Lord, Teodor Yurievych, in the year after the Nativity of Christ one thousand six hundred and six, on the twenty-fourth day of the month of May.[^26]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: предословие
units.slavonic_text: предосло́вїе
units.english_text: And the composition of this book is proportioned to the span of man's age,[^27] from when he is born, a man receives the naming of a name, and Holy Baptism, with the anointing of the Great Myron, and the other sacred rites according to the Church tradition even unto his demise. Nor have we omitted the monastic sequences; likewise the prayerful supplication sequences for various necessary needs. And because the canons are not found among all priests, for this reason, having selected the most necessary from the Apostolic and Holy Fathers' commandments, we have appended them at the end of this book.[^28] Which do you, receiving with gratitude and love, honor, performing what has been labored over and corrected sacredly without any gainsaying, in concord; [remembering] those who exerted themselves and [brought] all diligence into this work, having brought it for the sake of your common benefit. And especially remember zealously the departed and ever-memorable servant of God, Teodor, at the accomplishment of the dread, bloodless sacrifice,[^29] and in the other lityas and supplications: that by grateful love and devotion to books you may also sharpen us for the work of other books.

And especially remember zealously the departed and ever-memorable servant of God, Teodor, at the accomplishment of the dread, bloodless sacrifice,[^29] and in the other lityas and supplications: that by grateful love and devotion to books you may also sharpen us for the work of other books.

units.english_text: O Lord our God, Who from the dust didst fashion man, and from him didst form woman, and didst honor her with equal dignity; and when they transgressed Thy commandment, Thou didst cast [them] out of Paradise into this laborious life, and didst say unto the man: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread; and unto the woman: In sorrow shalt thou bring forth children:[^39] Who Thyself didst deign sinlessly to be born of a woman without sin for the salvation of our race: do Thou now also, we pray Thy tender mercy, sanctify this Thy servant, [N.], [saying the name,] who has given birth to an infant; and cleanse her bodily defilement and spiritual passion, and make her worthy to keep her house purely and blamelessly; and cleanse every doubt from her soul.[^40] For Thou art He that blesses and sanctifies all things, O Christ our God, and unto Thee do we send up glory, with the Father, and the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

Amen.

units.slavonic_incipit: Въ четыредеся́тный же де́нь па́кы прино́сится
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: в четыредесятный же ден пакы приносится в црковьститися
units.slavonic_text: Въ четыредеся́тный же де́нь па́кы прино́сится въ цр҃ковьсти́тися, ре́к[ше] нача́ло прїѧ́ти вноси́тися въ цр҃ко́вь. приноси́мъ же сѧ мт҃рїю оу҆же́ ѡ҆чище́ною и҆ ѡ҆мыве́ною. тоу̀ сꙋ́щꙋ и҆ хотя́щом[у] прїѧ́ти то̀ по кр҃ще́нїи. и҆ прекло́ньшей се́й главꙋ̀ въкоу́пѣ съ ѡ҆троча́темъ предъ двь́рми цр҃ко́вными. Сщ҃е́нникъ начина́етъ. Бл҃гослове́нъ б҃ъ на́шъ. та́[же] ст҃ы́й Б҃же, г҃. Пр҃та́я Тр҃це. по Ѿч҃е на́шъ. Ꙗ҆́ко твоѐ є҆́стъ цр҃тво тропа́рь, гла́съ а҃. Ра́дꙋйся ѡ҆брадо́ванная Бц҃е дв҃о. и҆стебе́ бо возсїѧ̀ Х҃с Б҃ъ на́шъ, просвѣща́ѧ и҆́же въ тмѣ̀ соу́щихъ. весели́ся и҆ ты ста́рче пра́ведныи, прїе́мый на рꙋ́коу

units.slavonic_incipit: свободи́телѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ. дароу́ющаго на́мъ въскресе́нїе
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: свободителя душам нашим дароующаго нам въскресение ко ндак
units.slavonic_text: свободи́телѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ. дароу́ющаго на́мъ въскресе́нїе :⁓ кѡ[ндакъ] гла[съ] а҃. І҆́же оу҆тро́бꙋ дв҃ичю ѡ҆ст҃ивъ рожество́мъ си. и҆ рꙋ́цѣ сѷмеѡ́ни бл҃вивъ ꙗ҆́коже подоба́ше предвари́въ нн҃ѣ сп҃лъ є҆сѝ х҃е Б҃е. но̀ оу҆мирѝ въ бра́нехъ житїѐ и҆ оу҆крѣпѝ цр҃ѧ и҆́хъже възлюби́лъ є҆си є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче :⁓ Та́же каса́яся главѣ̀ тоѧ̀ зна́мена́етъ кр҃тоѡбра́зно гла[голя], Гд҃у помо́лимся. Г҃и Б҃же на́шъ тебѣ́ ся мо́лимъ, и҆ тебе про́симъ, и҆ ми́лися дѣ́емъ. ты оу҆́бо є҆си сы́й Ѿц҃ъ Гд҃а на́шего і҆ѵ х҃а. и҆́же всѐ слове́сное и҆ безслове́сное є҆ство̀ сло́вомъ свои́мъ созда́въ.

units.slavonic_text: съпричте́тсѧ ст҃о́мꙋ ти ста́дꙋ, ра́ди є҆диноро́днаго сн҃а твое́го, съни́мже бл҃ве́нъ є҆сѝ. и҆ съ пр҃ты́мъ и҆ бл҃гы́мъ и҆ животворя́щимъ ти дх҃омъ нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ а҆ми́нь :⁓ Ми́ръ всѣ́мъ, главы̑ ва́ша Гд҃ви приклони́те. та́же мл҃твꙋ сїю̀ втаѝ. Г҃и Б҃е на́шъ, прише́дый въ ми́ръ на сп҃нїе ро́доу чл҃ческомоу. прїидѝ и҆ къ рабѣ̀ твое́й се́й, [в красном: и҆́мѧ ре́къ.] и҆ сподо́би є҆ѧ̀ чт҃нымъ сѝ презби́терствомъ въхо́дꙋ хра́ма сла́вы твоеѧ̀. ѡ҆мы́й є҆ѧ̀ сквръ́ноу дꙋше́внꙋю и҆ теле́снꙋю, въ и҆сполне́нїи четиредесѧ́те дн҃їи. творѧ̀ ю̀ досто́йноу причаще́нїа чт҃наго тѣ́ла и҆ кро́ве твоеѧ̀.

units.slavonic_text: Ꙗ҆́ко бл҃ви́ся и҆ просла́вися. пр҃чтно́е и҆ великолѣ́пое и҆́мя твоѐ, съ Ѿце́мъ и҆ съ ст҃ы́мъ дх҃омъ. и҆ нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ :⁓ Та́же сщ҃енникъ са́мъ прїе́мъ рꙋка́ми ѿроча̀, ѿно́ситъ въ жръто́вникъ. и҆ приложи́тъ оу҆ста̀ є҆го̀ на ѻ҆бѡ́ихъ страна́хъ двере́й въ ѡ҆́бразъ цѣлова́нїа та́коже и҆ къ ст҃ѣ́й трапе́зѣ прине́съ, въ ѡ҆бража́етъ младе́нца ꙗ҆́ко поклана́яся, ѻ҆бхо́дитъ три́щи. И҆ а҆́ще оу҆́бо мꙋ́жескїй по́лъ є҆́стъ, твори́тъ си́це. а҆́ще же́нскїй по́лъ є҆́стъ, не вноси́тся въ ѡ҆лта́рь, но то́чїю къ сты̑мъ две́ремъ, и҆ и҆кѡ́намъ ꙗ҆́коже є҆́стъ рече́но. Си̑мъ же бы́вши, гл҃етъ къ себѣ̀ сщ҃е́никъ. Нн҃ѣ ѿпоуща́еши

units.english_text: [accurately ordains: for having divided] all into two classes, it legislates that some should be anointed with myron, while others should be baptized from the beginning: namely, the Arians, Macedonians, Sabbatians, and Novatians (who call themselves the pure and the left), and the Quartodecimans (that is, the Tetradites), and the Apollinarians.[^69] Since, therefore, they perform the divine baptism equally with us, it is not deemed proper to baptize them again; but upon their written renunciation and anathematization of their heresy, [the canon] commands to anoint them with the holy myron: the forehead, the eyes, and the nostrils, the mouth, and the ears; and signing them, to say: "The seal of the gift of the Holy Spirit."[^70]

units.slavonic_text: лоука́ваго доу́ха . а҆́ще же конча́тися є҆моу̀ прїи́детъ , повелѣва́етъ кр҃ти́тися . да не тъ́щь и҆зы́детъ ѿ житїа́, и҆ неприча́стився Бж҃въ́ныя бл҃гти : ⁓ Четве́ртое же , а҆́ще не ѿ дѣ́мона речѐ ѡ҆глаше́нныи ѡ҆бурева́емъ є҆́стъ . но̀ ѿ недꙋ́га и҆стꙋпле́нїа оу҆ма̀ ѿраже́нъ . ꙗ҆́ко ниже́ ѿвѣща́ти мощѝ є҆моу̀ , ѿвѣ́тоу и҆ завѣща́нїю . но̀ є҆́льма показа̀ ѿ произволе́нїа вѣ́роу лобыза́ти , самово́лнѣ въ ѡ҆глаше́нныхъ почте́нъ . без̾ сꙋмнѣ́нїа да кр҃ти́тсѧ : ⁓ А҆ и҆́же въ карѳаге́нѣ събо́ра , р҃ка́ , кр҃ще́нїе речѐ пода́емаѧ бл҃гть намъ , не тъ́кмо грѣхѡ́мъ ѿпоуще́нїе . но
units.english_text: If a catechumen is troubled not by a demon, but is stricken by a disease of derangement of mind, so that he is not even able to reply to questions or make his profession; yet inasmuch as he showed of his own free choice that he embraced the faith, and was voluntarily enrolled among the catechumens: let him be baptized without doubt.

provenance.verbatim_source: If a catechumen is troubled not by a demon, but is stricken by a disease of derangement of mind, so that he is not even able to reply to questions or make his profession; yet inasmuch as he showed of his own free choice that he embraced the faith, and was voluntarily enrolled among the catechumens: let him be baptized without doubt.

units.english_text: O God, holy, fearful, and glorious, Who art incomprehensible and unsearchable in all Thy works and Thy power: Thou Who didst ordain for thee, O devil, the torment of eternal punishment: through us, His unworthy servants, He commands thee and all thy collaborative power to depart from him that has newly been signed in the Name of our Lord Jesus Christ, our true God. I adjure thee therefore, all-evil, unclean, defiled, abominable, and alien spirit, by the power of Jesus Christ, Who has all power in heaven and on earth; Who said unto the deaf and dumb demon: "Come out of the man, and enter no more into him!" Depart, recognize thy vain power, which had no authority even over the swine! Remember Him Who commanded thee at thy request to enter into the herd of swine. Fear God, by Whose command the earth was established upon the waters; Who created heaven, and set the mountains by a plummet, and the valleys by a measure; and placed sand as a boundary for the sea, and a firm path in the mighty waters; Who touches the mountains, and they smoke;[^91]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: номоу пресуществьныя трца действоу гду помолимся о еже
units.slavonic_text: номоу пресꙋще́ствьныѧ трⷪ҇ца дѣ́йствоу Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помоли́мсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же просвѣти́тисѧ на́мъ просвѣще́нїемъ ра́зꙋма и҆ бл҃гочтїа, прише́ствїа ра́ди ст҃го дх҃а. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помолимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же прїѧти є҆й ѿвраще́нїе всѧ́каго навѣ́та ви́димыхъ и҆ неви́димыхъ вра́гъ, Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помоли́мсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же досто́инꙋ бы́ти нетлѣ́ннаго црⷭ҇твїа и҆́же въ не́й крⷭ҇ща́емомꙋ. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помоли́мсѧ. Ѡ҆ и҆́же нн҃ѣ приходѧ́ще къ ст҃о́мꙋ просвѣще́нїю, и҆ ѡ҆ сп҃се́нїи є҆го̀. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ по: Ѡ҆ є҆́же показа́тисѧ є҆мꙋ̀ сн҃ꙋ свѣ́та, и҆ наслѣ́дникꙋ вѣ́чныхъ бл҃гъ. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помоли́мсѧ.
units.english_text: That it may receive the turning away of every assault of visible and invisible enemies, let us pray to the Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: That it may receive the turning away of every assault of visible and invisible enemies, let us pray to the Lord.

units.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ є҆́же бы́ти є҆моу съ ѡ҆́бразноу и҆ приѡ҆бщите́лю съ мр҃ти, и҆ въскрⷭ҇енїю Хрⷭ҇а̀ Бг҃а на́шего. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помолимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же бы́ти є҆моу водѣ́ се́й ба́ни па́ки бытѣ́йстей, ѡ҆ставле́нїю грѣхѡ́въ, и҆ ѡ҆де́жди нетлѣ́нїа. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помолимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же оу҆слы́шати Гдⷭ҇ꙋ Бг҃ꙋ гла́са моле́нїа на́шего. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помо́лимсѧ. units.slavonic_text: Ѡ҆ є҆́же бы́ти є҆моу съ ѡ҆́бразноу и҆ приѡ҆бщите́лю съ мр҃ти, и҆ въскрⷭ҇енїю Хрⷭ҇а̀ Бг҃а на́шего. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помолимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же съхрани́тисѧ є҆моу ѡ҆де́жди крⷭ҇ще́нїа, и҆ ѡ҆брꙋче́нїю Хрⷭ҇а несквръ́нꙋ и҆ непоро́чнꙋ въ дн҃ь стра́шный Хрⷭ҇а бг҃а на́шего. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помо́лимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же бы́ти є҆моу водѣ́ се́й ба́ни па́ки бытѣ́йстей, ѡ҆ставле́нїю грѣхѡ́въ, и҆ ѡ҆де́жди нетлѣ́нїа. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помолимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же оу҆слы́шати Гдⷭ҇ꙋ Бг҃ꙋ гла́са моле́нїа на́шего. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помо́лимсѧ. Ѡ҆ є҆́же и҆зба́витисѧ є҆моу̀ и҆ на́мъ ѿ въсѧ́кїѧ скръ́би гнѣ́ва и҆ ноу́жда Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помо́лимсѧ. Застꙋпѝ сп҃сѝ поми́лꙋй и҆ съхрани́ на́,
units.english_text: That this water may be unto him a laver of regeneration, unto the remission of sins, and a garment of incorruption, let us pray to the Lord.[^106]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: цркви и да невъстръгнеши и ко да преуспевающу
units.slavonic_text: цр҃кви. и҆ да̀ невъстръ́гнеши и҆. Ꙗ҆́ко да̀ преꙋспѣва́ющꙋ томꙋ̀ въ бл҃гочтїи, сла́витсѧ и҆ тѣ́мъ всест҃о́е и҆́мѧ твоѐ, Ѿца̀ и҆ Сн҃а и҆ Ст҃аго Дх҃а, нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́[мъ]. Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати ꙗ҆́ко ни въꙁглаша́етъ, но и҆ а҆ми́нь въ себѣ̀ гле́тъ. Та́же чте́тъ мл҃твꙋ сїю̀ велегла́сно. Ве́лїй є҆сѝ Гдⷭ҇и, и҆ чю́дна дѣла̀ твоѧ̀, и҆ ни є҆ди́но же сло́во дово́лно є҆́стъ на похвале́нїе чюде́съ твои́[хъ]. рцы́ же г҃. units.slavonic_text: цр҃кви. и҆ да̀ невъстръ́гнеши и҆. Ꙗ҆́ко да̀ преꙋспѣва́ющꙋ томꙋ̀ въ бл҃гочтїи, сла́витсѧ и҆ тѣ́мъ всест҃о́е и҆́мѧ твоѐ, Ѿца̀ и҆ Сн҃а и҆ Ст҃аго Дх҃а, нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́[мъ]. Подоба́етъ вѣ́дати ꙗ҆́ко ни въꙁглаша́етъ, но и҆ а҆ми́нь въ себѣ̀ гле́тъ. Та́же чте́тъ мл҃твꙋ сїю̀ велегла́сно. units.english_text: For by Thy will Thou hast brought all things out of non-existence into being; by Thy power Thou holdest creation together, and by Thy providence Thou directest the world. Thou hast composed creation; with four seasons Thou hast crowned the circle of the year.[^112] All the spiritual powers tremble before Thee; the sun sings Thy praise; the moon glorifies Thee; the stars make supplication unto Thee; the light obeys Thee; the abysses tremble before Thee; the springs serve Thee. Thou hast stretched out the heaven like a curtain; Thou hast established the earth upon the waters; Thou hast hedged the sea with sand; Thou hast poured out the air for breathing. The Archangelic powers minister unto Thee; the Angelic choirs worship Thee; the many-eyed Cherubim and the six-winged Seraphim, standing round about and flying, with fear cover themselves from Thine unapproachable glory.[^113] For Thou, being God uncircumscribed, without beginning, and ineffable, camest down upon the earth, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men. For Thou couldest not endure, O Master, through the tender compassion of Thy mercy, to behold mankind tormented by the devil; but Thou camest and didst save us. We confess Thy grace, we proclaim Thy mercy, we conceal not Thy benefactions. Thou hast set free the nature of our race; Thou didst sanctify the virginal womb by Thy nativity. All creation sings the praise of Thee Who didst manifest Thyself. For Thou, our God, didst appear upon the earth, and didst dwell among men. Thou the waters of Jordan didst sanctify, sending down from heaven Thy Holy Spirit, and didst break the heads of the dragons that nested there.[^114]

units.english_text: And let all airy and invisible phantoms depart from us; and let no dark demon hide himself in this water; neither let there descend with him that is baptized (we beseech Thee, O Lord) an evil spirit, bringing darkness of thoughts and tumult of mind. But do Thou, O Master of all, manifest this water as water of repose, water of redemption, water of sanctification, cleansing of the defilement of flesh and spirit, loosing of bonds, remission of sins, illumination of souls, the laver of regeneration, renewal of the Spirit, the gift of adoption, the garment of incorruptibility, the renewal of the soul, a fountain of life.[^116] For Thou hast said, O Lord: "Wash you, make you clean, put away evil from your souls." Thou hast bestowed upon us regeneration from on high through water and the Spirit. Manifest Thyself, O Lord, in this water, and grant that he who is baptized therein may be transformed, so that he may put off the old man, corrupt according to the deceits of lust, and put on the new man, renewed according to the image of Him that created him; that having been united unto the likeness of Thy death through baptism, a partaker of the resurrection also shall he be, and having preserved the gift of Thy Holy Spirit,[^117] and increased the deposit of grace, he may receive the prize of the high calling, and be numbered among the firstborn enrolled in heaven.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: г диаконже дръжа иелей в руку глет гду
units.slavonic_text: г҃. дїа́конже дръжа̀ і҆еле́й въ рꙋ́кꙋ гле́тъ. Гдⷭ҇ꙋ помоли́мсѧ. Сщ҃енникъ же гле́тъ мл҃твоу сїю. Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и Бг҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ. и҆́же сꙋ́щимъ въ ковче́ѕѣ но́евѣ, го́лꙋбь посла́въ соу́чець ма́слинный и҆моу́щь въ оу҆стѣ́хъ. премѣне́нїа знаме́нїе, сп҃се́нїа же є҆́же ѿ пото́па, и҆ бл҃года́ти та́инство ѡ҆нѣ́ми проѡбразова́въ. и҆ ма́слинный пло́дъ въ и҆сплъне́нїе ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ та́инъ пода́въ. и҆ того̀ ра́ди сꙋ́щихъ въ зако́нѣ дх҃а ст҃го и҆сплънилъ є҆си, ниже́ въ блгⷣти съвръша́ѧ. Са́мъ бл҃ви и҆ сѐ ма́сло си́лою и҆ дѣ́йствомъ и҆ прише́ствїемъ ст҃го твое́го дх҃а.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ко быти сему помазание нетлениа ружие правде обновление
units.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́ко бы́ти семꙋ̀ помаза́нїе нетлѣ́нїа. Ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе пра́вдѣ. Ѡ҆бновле́нїе дшѝ и҆ тѣ́лꙋ, и҆сто́чникъ живота̀. всѧ́каго дїа́вола дѣ́йства ѿрази́телно. въ и҆змѣне́нїе въсѧ́кыхъ зо́лъ, пома́зꙋющимсѧ вѣ́рою, и҆ли прие́млющимъ ѿ него:. и҆ въскло́ньсѧ въꙁглаша́етъ. Въ сла́вꙋ твою̀, и҆ є҆диноро́днаго сн҃а твоего̀, и҆ пр҃та́го и҆ бл҃га́го, и҆ животворѧ́щаго ти дх҃а. нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ :~ Ли́къ, а҆ми́нь. Дїа́конъ. вънме́мъ. Сщ҃е́нникъ же вземъ є҆ле́й, твори́тъ ка́плѧми на водѣ̀ крⷭ҇ты, г҃. поѧ̀ а҆ллилоу́їа съ людьмѝ, г҃. та́же въꙁглаша́етъ
units.english_text: Unto Thy glory, and of Thine Only-begotten Son, and of Thine all-holy, and good, and life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages.

units.slavonic_incipit: Бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ просвѣща́ѧ и҆ ѡ҆свѣща́ѧ всѧ́кого
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: блгословен бг просвещая и освещая всякого члка грядоущаго
units.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослове́нъ Бг҃ъ просвѣща́ѧ и҆ ѡ҆свѣща́ѧ всѧ́кого чл҃ка грѧдоу́щаго въ ми́ръ. нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ. Ли́къ, а҆ми́нь. И҆ прино́ситсѧ кр҃ща́емый сщ҃е́нникꙋ. Ѻ҆́нже взе́мъ ѿ ст҃го є҆ле́ѧ пръсто́мъ, твори́тъ крⷭ҇та ѡ҆́бразъ младе́нцоу на челѣ̀, и҆ на пръ́сехъ, и҆ на лицѝ, и҆ на пле́щїю гл҃ѧ. Пома́зꙋетсѧ ра́бъ бж҃їй [и҆мⷬ҇къ], є҆ле́ѡмъ ра́дости, въ и҆́мѧ ѻ҆ц҃а и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃го дх҃а, нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ. Ли́къ. А҆ми́нь. И҆ зна́менаетъ є҆мꙋ пръ́си, и҆ пле́щи. На пръ́сехъ оу҆́бо гл҃ѧ. Въ и҆сцѣле́нїе дшѝ и҆ тѣ́лоу. На оу҆шесе́хъ же. Въ оу҆слыша́нїе вѣ́ры. На нога́хъ
units.english_text: Amen.

provenance.verbatim_source:
**Choir:**
Amen.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 32 детем
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 32r. Running header: ДѢ́ТЕМЪ]
units.english_text: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered. Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord does not impute sin, neither is there guile in his mouth. Because I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my crying all the day long. For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me; I turned into misery when the thorn was pierced into me. I acknowledged my sin, and mine iniquity have I not hidden. I said: I will confess against myself mine iniquity unto the Lord; and Thou forgavest the ungodliness of my heart. For this shall every one that is holy pray unto Thee in a time acceptable; surely in a flood of many waters they shall not come nigh unto Him. Thou art my refuge from the affliction that surrounds me; my joy, deliver me from them that compass me about. I will give thee understanding, and instruct thee in this way wherein thou shalt go; I will fix Mine eyes upon thee. Be ye not as horse and mule, which have no understanding; whose jaws thou must bind with bit and bridle, lest they come nigh unto thee. Many are the scourges of the sinner; but mercy shall compass him that hopes in the Lord. Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous; and boast, all ye that are upright in heart.[^125]

units.slavonic_incipit: И҆ а́ще оу҆́бо младе́цъ є҆́сть кр҃ща́емый,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и аще оубо младец ест крщаемый посаждает того
units.slavonic_text: И҆ а́ще оу҆́бо младе́цъ є҆́сть кр҃ща́емый, посажда́етъ того̀ въ крⷭ҇ти́лницꙋ водѣ̀ соу́щи по́шїю, придръжа̀ лѣ́вою роуко́ю. де́сноюже прїе́мъ те́плою во́доу възлива́етъ на главоу̀ є҆го̀ зане́же блюстѝ зали́тисѧ младе́нца и҆ гл҃етъ пререче́нныѧ гла́сы. є҆́же є҆́ст въ и҆́мѧ ѿца̀ и҆ про́чее. а́ще ли є҆́стъ смы́сленъ кр҃ща́емый, погружа́етъ є҆го̀ въ трѝ погроуже́нїа ꙗ҆́коже бы́ше сказа́хомъ. Посе́мъ ѡ҆блачи́тъ є҆го̀ въ ѡ҆де́ждꙋ гл҃ѧ. Ѻ҆блачи́тсѧ ра́бъ бж҃їй [и҆́мѧ ре́къ], ѡ҆де́ждею пра́вды, въ и҆́мѧ ѿца̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃го дх҃а нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇нѡ и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ, а҆ми́нь. И҆ пое́тъ тропа́рь се́й, на гла́съ, и҆҃.

units.english_text: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God Almighty, Fountain of good things, Sun of Righteousness, Who hast caused the light of salvation to shine forth unto them that were in darkness, through the manifestation of Thine Only-begotten Son and our God; and Who hast granted unto us unworthy ones blessed cleansing in holy water, and divine sanctification in the life-creating anointing; Who even now hast been well pleased to regenerate Thy servant newly-illumined, *[Name]*, by water and the Spirit, and granted unto him remission of sins voluntary and involuntary.[^129] Do Thou Thyself, O Master of all, compassionate King, grant unto him also the seal of the gift of Thy Holy, all-powerful, and adorable Spirit, and communion of the holy Body and precious Blood of Thy Christ. Preserve him in Thy sanctification; confirm him in the Orthodox faith; deliver him from the evil one and all his snares; and by Thy saving fear keep his soul in purity and righteousness: that pleasing Thee in every deed and word, he may become a son and heir of Thy Heavenly Kingdom.

provenance.verbatim_source:

Blessed art Thou, O Lord God Almighty, Fountain of good things, Sun of Righteousness, Who hast caused the light of salvation to shine forth unto them that were in darkness, through the manifestation of Thine Only-begotten Son and our God; and Who hast granted unto us unworthy ones blessed cleansing in holy water, and divine sanctification in the life-creating anointing; Who even now hast been well pleased to regenerate Thy servant newly-illumined, *[Name]*, by water and the Spirit, and granted unto him remission of sins voluntary
and involuntary.[^129] Do Thou Thyself, O Master of all, compassionate King, grant unto him also the seal of the gift of Thy Holy, all-powerful, and adorable Spirit, and communion of the holy Body and precious Blood of Thy Christ. Preserve him in Thy sanctification; confirm him in the Orthodox faith; deliver him from the evil one and all his snares; and by Thy saving fear keep his soul in purity and righteousness: that pleasing Thee in every deed and word, he may become a son and heir of Thy Heavenly Kingdom.

units.slavonic_incipit: А҆пⷭ҇лъ, къ римлѧ́номъ: Бра́тїе, є҆ли́ци въ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: апл к римляном братие елици в хрта кртихомся
units.slavonic_text: А҆пⷭ҇лъ, къ римлѧ́номъ: Бра́тїе, є҆ли́ци въ Хрⷭ҇та̀ кр҃ти́хомсѧ, въ сме́рть є҆го̀ кр҃ти́хомсѧ. съпогребо́хомсѧ оу҆́бо съ ни́мъ кр҃ще́нїемъ въ сме́рть. да ꙗ҆́коже въста̀ Хрⷭ҇тосъ ѿ мр҃твыхъ сла́вою ѿчею, та́ко и҆ мы̀ въ ѡ҆бновле́нїи жи́зни ходи́ти на́чнемъ. А҆́ще бо съѡбра́зни бы́хѡмъ подо́бїю сме́рти є҆го̀, но и҆ въскрⷭ҇енїю бꙋ́демъ прича́стници. сїѐ вѣ́дѧще ꙗ҆́ко ве́тхїй на́шъ чл҃къ съ ни́мъ распѧ́тсѧ, да оу҆праздни́тсѧ тѣ́ло грѣхо́вное, є҆́же нектому̀ работа́ти на́мъ грѣхоу̀. оу҆́мерый бо ѡ҆правдисѧ ѿ грѣха̀. А҆́щели же оу҆мро́хѡмъ съ Хрⷭ҇то́мъ вѣ́роуемъ ꙗ҆́ко и҆ жи́ви бꙋ́демъ
units.english_text: Brethren, as many of us as were baptized into Christ were baptized into His death. Therefore we were buried with Him through baptism into death; that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life. For if we have become united with Him in the likeness of His death, so also shall we be partakers of His resurrection: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with Him, that the body of sin might be done away, that henceforth we should not serve sin. For he that is dead is justified from sin. Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, dies no more; death has dominion over Him no more. For in that He died, He died unto sin once; but in that He lives, He lives unto God. Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God in Christ Jesus our Lord.[^135]

units.slavonic_text: [Инициал Г] Гн҃и Бг҃е на́шъ, и҆́же ѿ и҆сполне́нїа коупе́лнаго, Твое́го блгⷭ҇тїю ѡ҆ст҃и́лъ є҆сѝ въ Тѧ̀ вѣ́роующихъ. Бл҃ви настоѧ́щее се мла́дѧ, и҆ на гла́воу є҆го̀ блгⷭ҇ве́нїе Твоѐ да сни́детъ. И҆ ꙗ҆́коже бл҃гви́лъ є҆си Дв҃да цр҃ѧ прⷪ҇рко́мъ Твои́мъ Самоилѡмъ, бл҃ви и҆ гла́воу раба̀ Твоего̀ сего̀ и҆́мѧ ре́къ, рꙋко́ю мое́ю грѣ́шною, ѻ҆сѣнѧ́ѧ того Дх҃омъ Твои́мъ Ст҃ы́мъ. Ꙗ҆́ко да преспѣ́ющоу є҆мꙋ̀ въ зра́стомъ, и҆ сѣди́намъ ста́рости, сла́вꙋ возсыла́етъ Тебѣ̀ и҆ оу҆ви́дитъ бл҃гаѧ І҆ерл҃има всѧ дни̑ живота̀ є҆го̀.

units.english_text: O Holy God and our Savior, Who desirest that all men should be saved and come unto the knowledge of the truth: receive this Thy servant, *[Name]*, who has scarcely recovered himself from deception,[^158] and who has loved to come unto the knowledge of the truth. For Thou, O Lord, didst say: "Other sheep I have which are not of this fold; them also I must bring, and they shall hear My voice; and there shall be one fold, and one shepherd."[^159] Shepherd him unto Thy glory, in the true knowledge according to the exposition of Thy holy and glorious Apostles; and account him worthy of the seal of the holy myron, and of communion of the holy Body and Blood. Show forth this Thy servant, *[Name]*, complete, that he also may be numbered among Thy flock, unto the praise and glory of Thy Name.

units.slavonic_text: и҆ по си́хъ причаща́етъ є҆го̀ . и҆ повелѣва́етъ є҆мꙋ̀ з҃ , дн҃ии ма́са не ꙗ҆́сти . и҆ лица̀ не оу҆мыва́ти . но̀ ꙗ҆́коже новокрща́емый та́ко пребыва́ти . и҆ въ ѻ҆́смый дн҃ь оу҆мы́тисѧ .
units.english_text: Unto Thee, O God of all creation visible and invisible, Who didst make all things by the Word: this man is brought, that upon him may be signed the light of Thine Only-begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, and of Thy Holy Spirit. Deliver him, O Lord, from all uncleanness, and from every deception of the adversary, and from every heretical name. Make him a chosen vessel; that this man also may be an equal Christian, known from this day forth, bearing the seal of Christ, Thy true God: with Whom Thou art blessed, together with Thine All-holy, and good, and life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^163]

units.english_text: [O Thou] Who hast granted unto Thy servant deliverance of sins by reason of holy baptism, and hast bestowed upon him renewal of life: do Thou Thyself, Master and Lord, ever deign to make the illumination of Thy countenance to shine in his heart. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 51 и же избавление
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 51r. Decorative woodcut initial I.] [И҆́]же и҆збавле́нїе съгрѣше́нїемъ ра́ди ст҃го кр҃ще́нїа рабꙋ̀ твое́моу дарова́въ, и҆ живота̀ ѻ҆бновле́нїе пода́въ є҆моу̀. Са́мъ влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и просвѣще́нїе лица̀ твое́го въ срⷣци є҆го̀ въсїѧва́ти всегда̀ бл҃говолѝ. Крѣ́пость вѣ́ры є҆го̀ ненавѣ́тноу ѿ врагѡ́въ съблюдѝ. Нетлѣ́нїе ѻ҆дѣѧ́нїа и҆́миже ѻ҆дѣ́ѧсѧ несквръ́но ѡ҆не́мъ, и҆ небла́зно съхранѝ. Нероуши́мꙋ въ не́мъ дх҃овноую печа́ть бл҃гтїю тѝ съблюда́ѧ. И҆ мл҃тивъ томоу́ же и҆ на́мъ бꙋ́ди по мно́жествꙋ щедро́тъ твои́хъ.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: верою и блгоговением и страхом бжиим въходящих вън
units.slavonic_text: вѣ́рою и҆ бл҃гоговѣ́нїемъ и҆ стра́хомъ Бж҃їимъ въходѧ́щихъ вънь, Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ. Ѡ҆ а҆рхїепⷭ҇пѣ на́шемъ, *[и҆́мѧ ре́къ]*, чⷭ҇тна́го є҆го̀ преꙁвѵ́терства, є҆́же ѡ҆ Хрⷭ҇тѣ̀ дїа́конства, и҆ всегѡ̀ при́чта и҆ люде́и, Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ. Ѡ҆ рабѣ́хъ Бж҃їихъ, *[и҆́мѧ ре́къ]*, и҆́же нн҃ѣ ѡ҆брꙋча́ющихсѧ дроу́гъ дроу́гꙋ, и҆ ѡ҆ сп҃ні́и и҆́хъ Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ: ͠ Ѡ҆ є҆́же пода́тисѧ и҆̀мъ ча́да къ воспрїѧ́тїе ро́да, и҆ всѧ̀ ꙗ҆́же къ сп҃се́нїю проше́нїа Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ: ͠ Ѡ҆ є҆́же ниꙁпосла́тисѧ и҆̀мъ любвѝ съвръше́ннѣй ми́рнѣй, и҆ по́мощи, Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ: ͠ Ѡ҆ є҆́же бл҃ви́тисѧ и҆̀мъ въ съєдине́нїи,
units.english_text: That there may be granted unto them children for the succession of the race, and all petitions unto salvation, let us pray unto the Lord.

provenance.verbatim_source: That there may be granted unto them children for the succession of the race, and all petitions unto salvation, let us pray unto the Lord.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: диакон гду помолимся
units.slavonic_text: *Дїа́конъ:* Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ.
units.english_text: O Lord our God, Who didst journey with the servant of the patriarch Abraham into Mesopotamia, when he was sent to betroth a wife for his master Isaac; and didst reveal unto him through the mediation of the water pitcher to betroth Rebecca: do Thou Thyself bless the betrothal of these Thy servants, *[Name]* and *[Name]*, and confirm the word spoken by them; establish them in the holy union that is from Thee.[^190] For Thou from the beginning didst create male and female, and by Thee is a wife betrothed unto a husband for help, and for the succession of the human race. Do Thou Thyself therefore, O Lord our God, Who hast sent forth truth unto Thine inheritance, and Thy promise unto Thy servants our fathers, Thine elect in every generation: look down upon Thy servant, *[Name]*, and upon Thy handmaid, *[Name]*, and confirm their betrothal in faith, and in unity, and in truth, and in love. For Thou, O Lord, didst show that betrothal is to be given, and to be confirmed in all things: by a ring was authority given unto Joseph in Egypt;[^191] by a ring was Daniel glorified in the land of Babylon; by a ring was the truth of Tamar made manifest; by a ring our Heavenly Father was compassionate toward His son, for He said: 'Put a ring upon his right hand, and having slain the fatted calf, let us eat and make merry.' This Thy right hand, O Lord, armed Moses in the Red Sea; for by Thy true word the heavens were established, and the earth founded. And the right hand of Thy servants shall be blessed by Thy mighty word, and by Thine exalted arm.[^192] Do Thou Thyself therefore, even now, O Master, bless this putting on of the rings with a heavenly blessing; and may the angel of the Lord go before them all the days of their life. For Thou art He Who blesses and sanctifies all things, and unto Thee do we send up glory, to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^193]

units.english_text: O God most pure, and Creator of all creation, Who through Thy love for mankind didst transform the rib of our forefather Adam into a woman, and didst bless them and say: 'Increase and multiply, and have dominion over the earth';[^198] and didst show them both to be one member by reason of marriage; for because of this shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and the two shall be into one flesh; and whom God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.[^199] Who didst bless Thy servant Abraham, and didst open the womb of Sarah, and didst make him the father of many nations; Who didst bestow Isaac upon Rebecca, and didst bless her childbearing; Who didst join Jacob unto Rachel, and from him didst show forth the twelve patriarchs; Who didst yoke Joseph and Aseneth, bestowing upon them the fruit of childbearing, Ephraim and Manasseh; Who didst receive Zechariah and Elizabeth, and didst show forth unto them the birth of the Forerunner; Who from the root of Jesse according to the flesh didst cause to blossom the Ever-Virgin, and from Her wast incarnate and born for the salvation of the human race; Who through Thine unutterable gift and manifold goodness didst come unto Cana of Galilee, and didst bless the marriage that was there,[^200] that Thou mightest manifest that lawful wedlock and childbearing which is therefrom is Thy will: do Thou Thyself, O all-holy Master, accept our supplication, the supplication of Thy servants; even as there, so also here, having come through Thine invisible presence, bless this marriage; and grant unto these Thy servants a peaceful life, length of days, chastity, love one for another in the bond of peace, long-lived seed, the grace that is in children, an unfading crown of glory. Vouchsafe them to see children's children; keep their bed unassailed by snares; and give unto them of the dew of heaven from on high, and of the fatness of the earth.[^201] Fill their houses with wheat, wine, and oil, and every good thing, that they may impart also unto those in need; granting likewise unto those that are with them all petitions that are unto salvation.

units.slavonic_text: *Сщ҃е́нникъ мл҃твоу сїю̀:*
units.english_text: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, Who art the priest[^202] of mystical and most pure marriage, and the lawgiver of bodily wedlock, the guardian of incorruption, and the dispenser of the goods of this life. Do Thou Thyself now, O Master, Who in the beginning didst fashion man, and didst set him as king over creation, and didst say: 'It is not good for man to be alone upon the earth; let us make him a helper fit for him';[^203] and taking one of his ribs, didst fashion woman, whom when Adam beheld, he said: 'This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called woman, because she was taken out of her man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and the two shall be into one flesh; and whom God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.'[^204]

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 62v. Running header: ЧИ́НЪ]
units.english_text: Do Thou Thyself now, O Master, Lord our God, send down Thy heavenly grace upon these Thy servants; and grant unto this maiden that she may be subject unto her husband in all things, and unto this Thy servant that he may be the head of the wife, that they may live according to Thy will. Bless them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst bless Abraham and Sarah; bless them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst bless Isaac and Rebecca; bless them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst bless Jacob and all the patriarchs; bless them, O Lord our God, as Thou didst bless Joseph and Aseneth; bless them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst bless Moses and Zipporah; bless them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst bless Joachim and Anna; bless them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst bless Zechariah and Elizabeth. Preserve them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst preserve Noah in the ark; preserve them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst preserve Jonah in the belly of the whale;[^205] preserve them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst preserve the holy three Children from the furnace, sending down upon them dew from heaven; let that joy come upon them which the blessed Helen had when she found the Precious Cross.[^206] Remember them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst remember Enoch, Shem, and Elijah; remember them, O Lord our God, even as Thou didst remember Thy holy Forty Martyrs, sending down upon them crowns from heaven. Remember, O God, the parents who have reared them, for the prayers of parents establish the foundations of houses.[^207] Remember, O Lord, Thy servants who have come as bridal companions, and all who have assembled together unto this joy. Remember, O Lord our God, Thy servant *[Name],* and Thy servant *[Name],* and bless them. Grant unto them the fruit of the womb, fair offspring, concord of soul and body. Exalt them like the cedars of Lebanon, and like a fair-branched vine.[^208] Grant unto them seed in full ear, that having all sufficiency they may abound unto every good work, and that which is well-pleasing unto Thee. And may they see the sons of their sons like olive shoots round about their table; and having pleased Thee, may they shine forth like luminaries in heaven, in Thee, our Lord.

units.english_text: O Holy God, Who didst fashion man from the dust, and from his rib didst fashion woman, and didst yoke her unto him as a helper fit for him, because it was thus pleasing unto Thy majesty that man should not be alone upon the earth: do Thou Thyself now, O Master, send down Thy hand from Thy holy dwelling place, and unite this Thy servant *[Name]* unto this Thy servant *[Name],* for by Thee is a wife joined unto a husband. Yoke them together in oneness of mind; crown them into one flesh; grant unto them the fruit of the womb, the enjoyment of fair offspring.

units.english_text: Brethren: Giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ unto God and the Father; submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord; for the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the Head of the Church; and He is the Savior of the body. But even as the Church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in everything. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the Church, and gave Himself up for Her; that He might sanctify Her, having cleansed Her with the washing of water by the word;[^217] that He might present Her unto Himself a glorious Church, not having spot or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that She should be holy and without blemish. Even so ought husbands to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord the Church; for we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones. For this cause, he said, shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and the two shall be into one flesh. This is a great mystery; but I speak concerning Christ and the Church. Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.[^218]

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 67r. Running header: ВѢНЧА́НЇЕ]
units.english_text: There were set there six waterpots of stone,[^222] after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. Jesus said unto them: 'Fill the waterpots with water.' And they filled them up to the brim. And He said unto them: 'Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast.' And they bore it. When the ruler of the feast tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was (but the servants who drew the water knew), the governor of the feast called the bridegroom, and said unto him: 'Every man at first sets forth good wine, and when men have drunk well, then that which is worse; but thou hast kept the good wine until now.' This beginning of signs did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested His glory; and His disciples believed on Him.[^223]

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 70v. Инициал Г] Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е на́шъ, прише́дыи въ Ка́ноу Галиле́йскоую, и҆ соу́щїи та́мо бра́къ бл҃гослови́въ. Бл҃гословѝ и҆ рабы̀ твоѧ̀ сїѧ твои́мъ про́мысло, въ приѡбще́нїе бра́ка съчета́вшаѧсѧ. Бл҃гословѝ и҆́хъ въхѡ́ды и҆ и҆схѡ́ды. Оу҆мно́жи въ бл҃гы́хъ житїѐ и҆́хъ. Въспрїимѝ вѣнца̀ и҆́хъ въ црⷭ҇твїе твоѐ, несквръ́ны и҆ непоро́чны и҆ ненавѣ́тны съблюда́ѧ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ, а҆ми́нь:
units.english_text: O Lord our God, Who didst come to Cana of Galilee, and didst bless the marriage that was there: Bless also these Thy servants, who by Thy providence have been joined in the communion of marriage. Bless their comings-in and their goings-out; multiply their life in good things; receive their crowns into Thy kingdom, keeping them undefiled, and blameless, and without reproach, unto ages of ages. Amen.[^239]

Инициал В] Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е на́шъ , и҆́же въсѣ́хъ щадѧ̀, и҆ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ промышлѧ́ѧ . и҆́же та́йнаѧ вѣ́дый чл҃чскаа, и҆ всѣ́хъ ра́зꙋмъ и҆мѣ́ѧ . оу҆цѣтѝ грѣхы̀ на́шѧ, и҆ безако́нїа простѝ свои́хъ рабъ . призыва́ѧ и҆́хъ на покаа́нїе, подава́ѧ и҆̀мъ проще́нїе съгрѣше́нїѡмъ . грѣхѡ́мъ ѡ҆цѣще́нїе . Ѡ҆ставле́нїе безако́нїѡмъ во́лным же, и҆ нево́лнымъ . и҆́же вѣ́дый немо́щное чл҃чскаго є҆стества̀, зижди́телю и҆ созда́телю. и҆́же ра́хавоу блоудницꙋ прости́вый, и҆ мытаре́во покаа́нїе прїе́мый . непомѧнѝ грѣхѡ́въ на́шихъ невѣ́дѣнїа ѿ ю́ности . а҆́ще бо безако́нїа назри́ши Гдⷭ҇и, Гдⷭ҇и кто̀
units.english_text: O Master, Lord our God, Who sparest all and providest for all, Who knowest the secret things of men and hast knowledge of all things: Purify our sins, and forgive the iniquities of Thy servants, calling them unto repentance, granting them pardon of offenses, purification of sins, remission of transgressions voluntary and involuntary. O Creator and Fashioner, Who knowest the frailty of human nature; Who didst forgive Rahab the harlot, and didst accept the repentance of the Publican: Remember not the sins of our ignorance from our youth. For if Thou shouldst mark iniquities, O Lord, O Lord, who[^255] shall stand? What flesh shall be justified before Thee? For Thou alone art righteous, sinless, holy, plenteous in mercy, tender-hearted, and repenting of the evils of men. Do Thou, O Master, Who hast taken unto Thyself these Thy servants, unite them one to another in love; grant them the conversion of the Publican, the tears of the harlot, the confession of the thief: that by repentance from their whole heart, fulfilling Thy commandments in unity and peace, they may be counted worthy of Thy heavenly kingdom. For Thou art the Builder of all things, and unto Thee do we send up glory, to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^256]

units.english_text: O Lord Jesus Christ, Word of God, Who wast lifted up upon the precious and life-creating Cross, and didst tear up the handwriting against us, and didst deliver us from the oppression of the devil: Purify the iniquities of Thy servants; for, not being able to bear the heat and burden of the day, and the burning of the flesh, they come together unto the second communion of marriage, as Thou didst ordain through Thine elect vessel, Paul the Apostle, saying for the sake of us humble ones: 'It is better to marry in the Lord than to burn.' Do Thou Thyself, as good and the Lover of mankind, have mercy and forgive,[^257] purify, remit, forgive our debts: for Thou art He that hast taken our infirmities upon Thy shoulders. For there is none sinless, even though his life be but one day, that he should be without blemish; save only Thou alone, Who didst clothe Thyself in flesh without sin, and hast granted unto us the incorruption of eternal blessings. For Thou art our God, the God of the penitent, and unto Thee do we send up glory, to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^258]

units.slavonic_text: *По оконча́нїи сеѧ̀ мл҃твы, прїе́мъ вѣнца̀, вѣнча́етъ жениха̀ гл҃ѧ .* Вѣнча́етсѧ ра́бъ Бж҃їи *и҆́мѧ ре́къ*, къ и҆́мѧ ѿца̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃а́го дх҃а . *Та́кожде вѣнча́етъ и҆ невѣ́стꙋ гл҃ѧ .* Вѣнча́етсѧ раба̀ Бж҃їа *и҆́мѧ ре́къ*, къ и҆́мѧ ѿца̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃а́го дх҃а . *Поси́мъ бл҃влѧ́етъ и҆́хъ г҃, гл҃ѧ .* Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е на́шъ сла́вою и҆ чⷭ҇тїю вѣнча́лъ є҆сѝ и҆́хъ . *И҆ та́ко по чи́ноу всѐ, ꙗ҆́коже пи́сано є҆́стъ вы́ше, въ послѣ́дованїи вѣнча́нїѧ, ничто́же не премѣнѧ́юще .* *И҆ ѿпоу́стъ .*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: всем по свещи и станут около масла
units.slavonic_text: *всѣ́мъ по свѣщѝ . и҆ ста́нутъ ѡ҆́коло ма́сла ѡ҆блъ́кшисѧ въ фело́ны бѣ́лы . и҆ взе́мъ пръ́выи по́пъ кади́лницꙋ съ дїакїа́номъ, кади́тъ ѡ҆́крътъ анало́а, и҆ всю̀ цр҃ко҃ . и҆ начина́етъ .* Бл҃ве́нъ Бг҃ъ на́шъ . *Та́же трⷭ҇то́е . Пр҃таа тр҃це . По Ѿ́че на́шъ .* Ꙗ҆́ко твоѐ є҆́стъ црⷭ҇тво . *Гдⷭ҇и помл҃оуй в҃і . Прїидѣ́те поклони́мсѧ г҃ . Та́же* *Ѱло́мъ рм҃в .* Гдⷭ҇и оу҆слы́ши мл҃твоу мою̀ . *Сла́ва и҆ нн҃ѣ . А҆лли́лꙋїа г҃ .* *Та́же дїа́копетїа ма́лаа .* Па́ки и҆ па́ки ми́ромъ Гдⷭ҇у помоли́мсѧ . Застоупѝ сп҃си поми́лꙋй и҆ съхранѝ на́съ . Прⷭ҇тоу́ю чⷭ҇тоу́ю и҆ пребл҃гослове́ноу́ю влⷣчцꙋ на́шю Бцⷣоу и҆ прⷭ҇но дв҃оу марїю съ

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: всеми стыми помяноувше иереи ко подобает
units.slavonic_text: всѣ́ми ст҃ы́ми помѧноу́вше . *Їерѣи .* Ꙗ҆́ко подоба́етъ ти въсѧ́ка сла́ва чⷭ҇ть и҆ поклане́нїе ѿц҃у и҆ сн҃у и҆ ст҃му дх҃у, нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ . *Та́же а҆ллилоу́їа, на гла́съ ѕ҃ .* *Сти́хъ .* Гдⷭ҇и не ꙗ҆́ростїю твое́ю ѡ҆бличѝ менѐ, нижѐ гнѣ́вомъ твои́мъ покажѝ менѐ . *Сти́хъ .* Поми́лꙋй мѧ Гдⷭ҇и ꙗ҆́ко не́мощенъ є҆́смь . *Та́же тропарѣ̀ .* Поми́луй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и поми́лоуй на́съ, въсѧ́кого бо ѿвѣ́та недоумѣ́юще, сїю́ ти мл҃твоу ꙗ҆́ко влⷣцѣ грѣ́шнїи прино́симъ . поми́лоуй на́съ Гдⷭ҇и поми́лоуй на́съ : *Сла́ва .* Гдⷭ҇и поми́лоуй на́съ, на тѧ́ бо оу҆пова́хомъ, непрогнѣ́вайсѧ на ны зѣло̀ .

units.slavonic_text: *Тропа́рь .* Ма́сломъ мл҃рьдїа твое́го влⷣко, оу҆тѣша́ѧ прⷭ҇но дш҃євныѧ коу́пно и҆ тѣле́сныѧ стрⷭ҇ти . и҆ съхранѧ́ѧ ма́сло вѣ́рныхъ . са́мъ и҆ нн҃ѣ оу҆щедрѝ и҆́же ма́сломъ къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́ющи . *Сти́хъ .* Влⷣко многомл҃тиве Гдⷭ҇и, помл҃оуй и҆ и҆сцѣлѝ ра́ба своего̀ . *Тропа́рь .* И҆мѣ́ѧ мл҃тынѧ влⷣко, и҆сплъ́нь всю̀ зе́млю . є҆гда̀ ма́сломъ бж҃твѣ́нымъ ти сп҃се, та́йно пома́зꙋеми . па́че оу҆ма̀ мл҃ти твое́й, вѣ́рно про́симъ да́тисѧ на́мъ :~ *Сла́ва .* *Тропа́рь .* Помаза́нїемъ сщ҃енникъ твои́хъ чл҃колюбче . а҆́пл҃ы твои́ми, на недꙋ́жныѧ рабы̀ твоѧ̀ . дарова́ти проще́нїе заповѣ́давъ и҆̀мъ . и҆́хже

units.slavonic_text: ми́лостьми въсѣ́хъ зна́менаеши, ма́сломъ мл҃ти тво́еѧ : *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Є҆ди́на ми́рови поучи́нꙋ чⷭ҇таа ро́жьши . и҆́же къ Бг҃у твои́ми мл҃твами, лю́тыхъ болѣ́зней и҆ скръ́бей, твои́хъ ра́бъ и҆зба́ви . ꙗ҆́ко да̀ непреста́нно пое́мъ тѧ :~ *Пѣ́снь г҃, і҆рмо́съ .* Весели́тсѧ ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ цр҃кви твоѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇ѐ :~ *Тропа́рь .* Ты̀ є҆ди́нъ ꙗ҆́ко ди́венъ въ чл҃цѣ́хъ сы́й, и҆ вѣ́рнымъ мл҃тивъ . болѧ́щемоу лю́тѣ, да́ждь Хрⷭ҇ѐ бл҃гть свою̀ съвы́шше :~ *Сти́хъ .* Влⷣко многомл҃тиве Гдⷭ҇и, помл҃оуй и҆ и҆сцѣлѝ ра́ба своего̀ . *Тропа́рь .* Ма́сличный сꙋ́чецъ и҆ногда̀, къ оу҆мале́нїю пото́па Гдⷭ҇и . бж҃твенымъ твои показа́вый манове́нїемъ . сп҃си и҆ поми́лоуй стра́ждꙋщаго :~ *Сла́ва .*

units.slavonic_text: *Тропа́рь .* Свѣ́щꙋ бж҃тве́наго свѣ́та, въ ма́слѣ твое́мъ Хрⷭ҇ѐ оу҆ꙗснѝ . и҆ си́хъ пома́зꙋющихсѧ нн҃ѣ вѣ́рою, ма́сломъ твои́мъ влⷣко поми́лꙋй :~ *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* При́зри мл҃тивно, мт҃и всѧ́ческимъ тво́рцу съвы́ше . и҆ го́ркоую зло́боу раздрѣшѝ, болѧ́щемоу мл҃итвами си :~ *Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ д҃ . По: Пасты́рскїи сопль вѣща́нїа твоє̀ .* Ꙗ҆́ко бж҃тве́наа рѣка̀ мл҃тынѧ преи҆мѣ́ѧ . ꙗ҆́ко глоубина̀ мно́жества проще́нїа . ще́дре покажѝ твою̀ ми́лость бж҃твеныхъ строу́й, и҆ всѣ́хъ оу҆врачꙋй . и҆сточѝ чюде́семъ и҆сто́чникъ неза́вистно, и҆ ѡ҆мы́й всѧ̑ны . къ твое́й бо притѣка́емъ

По: Възнесы́йсѧ .* Вра́чъ и҆ помо́щникъ болѧ́щимъ, сп҃съ и҆ и҆збави́тель недꙋ́жнымъ . ꙗ҆́ко всѧ́ческимъ влⷣка и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь . дароу́й здра́вїе недꙋ́гующемоу твое́моу ра́бу . оу҆ще́дри и҆ поми́лоуй лю́тѣ болѧ́щаго . и҆ ѿ сме́рти и҆зба́ви Хрⷭ҇ѐ, ꙗ҆́ко да сла́ви дръжа́вꙋ твою̀ бж҃тве́ноу́ю :~ *Пѣ́снь д҃, і҆рмо́съ .* Въздви́жена тѧ̀ ви́дѣвше цр҃кви . *Тропа́рь .* Ꙗ҆́ко нетлѣ́нно му́ро є҆си Хрⷭ҇ѐ, и҆злива́емое бл҃гтїю, и҆ ми́ра ѡ҆чища́ѧ . оу҆ще́дри и҆ ѡ҆ст҃ѝ бж҃твеными ти мл҃тынами, строу́пы теле́сныѧ пома́зꙋющимъ :~

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тропар тихости знамением твоего масла вся чювствиа
units.slavonic_text: *Тропа́рь .* Ти́хости зна́менїемъ твоє́го ма́сла, вся̀ чю́вствїа влⷣко, знамена́въ рабꙋ̀ твоє́мꙋ . непреходи́мъ и҆ неприкоснове́нны и҆схо́дъ сътворѝ, всѣ́мъ проти́внымъ си́ламъ :-- *Сла́ва .* *Тропа́рь .* Призыва́ти повелѣва́ѧ боля́щии, сщ҃еннодѣ́йственикъ Бж҃тве́ныхъ ти . и҆ си́хъ мл҃твою помаза́нїемъ мл҃ти твоєѧ̀, чл҃колю́бче сп҃се́ннѡ быва́ти . сп҃си мл҃тїю стра́ждꙋщаго :-- *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Бц҃е прⷭ҇но дв҃о прчⷭ҇таа, покро́ве твр́дый и҆ храни́телнице . стѣ́но и҆ приста́нище . лѣ́ствице и҆ забра́ло, помилꙋ́й и҆ сп҃си к тебѣ̀ є҆дино́й прибѣга́ющаго :-- *Пѣ́снь є҃, і҆рмо́съ .* Ты̀ ми Гдⷭ҇и свѣ́тъ въ ми́ръ прише́лъ є҆сѝ .

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тропар ты еси млти сый бже безна
units.slavonic_text: *Тропа́рь .* Ты̀ є҆си мл҃ти сый Бж҃е бе́зна, помилꙋ́й мл҃тиве, бж҃твены ма́сло твои́мъ, стра́ждꙋщаго ꙗ́ко бл҃гоꙋтро́бе Гдⷭ҇ь :-- *Тропа́рь .* Дꙋ́шь на́ши Хрⷭ҇е, и҆ тѣле́съ съ вы́шше . крⷭ҇тнымъ и҆ Бж҃твены зна́менїемъ, ѡ҆с҃ти́въ млⷭ҇рдно, бл҃гостїю твоє́ю высѣ́хъ и҆сцѣлѝ :-- *Сла́ва .* *Тропа́рь .* Неизрече́нное ти чю́до . и́же тѣ́ло твоє̀ млⷭ҇рде, пома́завшїа му́ромъ блꙋ́дница, дре́вле ѡ҆чистисѧ . оу҆ще́дри и҆ раба̀ своєго́ :. *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Препѣ́таа чⷭ҇таа, прⷭ҇но дв҃о влчⷣце помилꙋ́й . и́же Бж҃твенымъ ти пома́зꙋющихсѧ ма́сломъ . и҆ сп҃си ра́ба твоє́го :-- *Пѣ́снь ѕ҃, і҆рмо́съ .* Пожрꙋ́ ти съ гла́сомъ хвале́нїа Гдⷭ҇и .
units.english_text: *Both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

provenance.verbatim_source: *Both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.*

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: тропар масло прощениа скораго члколюбче ты цртвоуеши
units.slavonic_text: *Тропа́рь .* Ма́сло проще́нїа ско́раго чл҃колю́бче, ты црⷭ҇твоу́еши . прⷪ҇рокы и҆ архїере́ѧ бл҃гтїю вѣнчава́ѧ, зна́менїем твои[мъ] . и҆ стра́ждꙋщемоу дароу́й мл҃ть :-- *Тропа́рь .* Да ни скръбь, ни же лоука́вїи бѣ́си прикосноу́тсѧ, помаза́нїю Бж҃тве́номоу, чю́вствомъ сп҃се зна́менанымъ . но кро́вомъ ѡ҆градѝ є҆го̀ си́лою твоє́ю :-- *Сла́ва .* *Тропа́рь .* Прострѝ роу́кꙋ свою̀ съ высоты̀ чл҃колю́бче, на ма́сло сїѐ Бж҃тве́ное, и҆ ѡ҆стѝ є҆ . и҆ покажѝ своє́го ра́ба бѣ́дъ и҆ недоу́гъ вы́шша влⷣко :-- *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Бы́сть ѡ҆ Бз҃ѣ твой хра́мъ, плодови́таа м҃ти тво́рцꙋ ма́слина . є҆ѧ́же и҆сплъ́не ꙗ҆висѧ миръ мл҃ти . є҆го́же

Подо́бенъ: Вы́шниихъ .* Мл҃ти сый исто́чни прєбл҃гіи . вѣ́рою те́плою къ і҆еле́ю неизрече́нномоу твоє́моу , припада́ющихъ бл҃гооу́тро́бне , ѿ всѧ́кого и҆зба́ви ѡ҆злобле́нїа . и҆ недꙋ́гы и́хъ възе́мъ , пода́ждъ Бж҃твенꙋю съ вы́шше бл҃гть . *Пѣ́снь з҃, і҆рмо́съ .* Въ пе́щи а҆враа́мскыѧ . *Тропа́рь .* Ты̀ въ ми́лости и҆ щедрота́хъ є҆си бога́тъ . высѣ́мъ и҆сцѣлѧ́ѧ стрⷭ҇ти дш҃евныя , и҆ тѣле́снаа съкроуше́нїа . и҆ сего въ не́доузѣхъ стра́ждꙋщаго , са́мъ и҆сцѣлѧ́ѧ врачу́й :-- *Тропа́рь .* И҆же ма́сло пома́зꙋѧ всѣ́хъ гла́вы подава́ѧ весе́лїе рабꙋ твоє́мꙋ . ра́достно

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: млти просящему ти и избавлениа богатыя ти млти
units.slavonic_text: мл҃ти просѧ́щемꙋ ти, и҆ и҆збавле́нїа бога́тыѧ ти мл҃ти Гдⷭ҇и :-- *Сла́ва .* *Тропа́рь .* Ѡ҆роу́жїе бы́сть на бѣ́сы сло́ве твоє̀ зна́менїе . Ѡ́гнь попалѧ́ѧ стра́сти пло́тьскыѧ , сщ҃енникъ мл҃твами . и҆миже чл҃колю́бче, ꙗ́ко ѿ оу҆́зъ и҆збавлѧ́ютсѧ стра́ждꙋщеи :-- *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Ты̀ съдръжа́щаго го́рстїю всѧ́ческаа м҃ти Бж҃їа . вноу́тръ въ чре́вѣ приє́мши Бг҃олѣ́пно , и҆ неизрече́нно въплоти́вши ѡ҆ стра́ждꙋщемъ се́мъ оу҆мл҃тивити є҆го̀ про́симъ :. *Пѣ́снь и҃, і҆рмо́съ .* Роу́цѣ распросте́ръ данїи́лъ . *Тропа́рь .* Высѣ́хъ не за́вистно ми́лоуеши , по вели́цей ти ми́лости млⷭ҇рде . сего̀ ра́ди събра́хѡмсѧ всѝ, тайно

units.slavonic_incipit: є҆го́же горѣ̀ въше́дъ посла̀ прича́стникѡмъ сѝ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: егоже горе въшед посла причастником си влко стго
units.slavonic_text: є҆го́же горѣ̀ въше́дъ посла̀ прича́стникѡмъ сѝ влⷣко ст҃го дх҃а да́ръ · то́же ѡ҆́бра радости влⷣко Бж҃твеныѧ пода́жъ нн҃ѣ млѧ́щи ти сѧ :-- *Сла́ва .* *Тропа́рь .* Оу҆ще́дри и҆ поми́лоуй сп҃се , и҆ и҆зба́ви лю́таго ко́зньства · и҆змѝ ѿ стрѣ́лъ лоука́ваго , твои́хъ ра́бъ дш҃ѧ и҆ телеса̀ ꙗ́ко мл҃тивъ Бъ҃, помаза́нїа Бж҃тве́наго сподоблѧ́емый :. *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Пѣ́нїа и҆ мо́лбы дв҃о прие́млющи ѿ свои́хъ ра́бъ · и҆зба́ви не́доугъ лю́тыхъ, и҆ всѣ́хъ нападе́нїи вра́жїихъ, мл҃твами сѝ · и́же съ на́ми прчⷭ҇таа Бж҃тве́номоу ти кро́воу прибѣга́ющаго :-- *Досто́йно є́сть ꙗ́ко ·* *Свѣти́ленъ, подо́бенъ: Посѣти́лъ ны є́стъ свы́ше ·*
units.english_text: *Troparion:* Show compassion and have mercy, O Savior, and deliver from fierce guile; rescue from the arrows of the evil one the souls and bodies of Thy servants, as a merciful God, making them worthy of the divine anointing.[^313]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Troparion:*
Show compassion and have mercy, O Savior, and deliver from fierce guile; rescue from the arrows of the evil one the souls and bodies of Thy servants, as a merciful God, making them worthy of the divine anointing.[^313]

Подо́бенъ: Да́сть зна́менїе ·* *Стїхи́ра а҃ .* Да́лъ єси бл҃гть свою̀ , за твои́хъ бл҃гопрїемѣни́телю а҆пл҃ъ чл҃колю́бче, ма́сломъ сты́мъ твои́мъ, и҆сцѣли́ти всѣ́мъ ꙗ҆́звы и҆ не́дꙋгы · тѣ́мже ма́сломъ твои́мъ, и҆́же вѣ́рою приходѧ́щаго, и҆ нн҃ѣ ꙗ́ко млⷭ҇рдъ Ѡ҆с҃ти поми́лоуй · ѿ высѧ́каго не́доуга ѡ҆чи́сти , и҆ пи́щи нетлѣ́ннѣй ти бога́тно сподо́би :-- *Стїхи́ра в҃ .* Си́ждъ неѡбиме́нне всекро́ткыма
units.english_text: *Sticheron 1:* Thou hast given Thy grace through Thine Apostles, O benign Lover of mankind, to heal the wounds and diseases of all through Thy holy oil; therefore, as a compassionate One, sanctify and have mercy now through Thine oil upon him who comes in faith; cleanse him from every disease, and richly make him worthy of Thine incorruptible delight.[^319]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: слава бгородичен теб чтнейшоую цркоу полатоу
units.slavonic_text: *Сла́ва . Бг҃оро́диченъ .* Тебѐ чтⷭ҇нѣ́йшоую црⷭ҇коу пола́тоу, молю̀ многопѣ́таѧ . оу҆́мъ моѝ ѡ҆чи́сти ѡ҆скве́рненыи ѿ въсѧ́каго грѣха̀ . и҆ жили́ще кра́сно пребж҃тве́ныѧ трⷪ҇ца сътворѝ . ꙗ҆́ко да си́лоу твою̀ и҆ безмѣ́рную млⷭ҇ть, велича́ю сп҃се́ непотре́бныи ра́бъ твоѝ · *И҆ ны́нѣ ·* Ѿ въсѣ́хъ бѣ́дъ рабы̀ своѧ̀ съхранѧ́й, бл҃же́наѧ Бц҃е . да̀ въсѝ въпїе́м ти . ра́доуйсѧ є҆ди́но застоупле́нїе дꙋша́мъ нашимъ :~ *Та́же тр҃тое . пр҃тѧѧ тр҃це . по Ѿче нашъ , ꙗ҆́ко твоѐ є҆стъ црⷭ҇тво . та҃ · тро́ · гла́ · д҃ .* Ско́ръ въ застоупле́нїи є҆ди́нъ сы́й Хрⷭ҇ѐ , ско́рое посѣще́нїе пода́ждь
units.english_text: *Theotokion:* Thee, the most honorable royal palace, do I implore, O all-hymned one: cleanse my mind defiled by every sin, and make it a fair dwelling-place of the all-divine Trinity; that, being saved, I, thine unprofitable servant, may magnify thy power and boundless mercy.[^322]

provenance.verbatim_source:

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 88v. Running header: СВѦЩЕ́НЇЕ]
units.english_text: **Priest:** O Lord, Who by Thy mercy and Thy compassions healest the brokenness of our souls and bodies: do Thou Thyself, O Master, sanctify this oil, that it may be unto those that are anointed therewith for healing, and for the removal of every passion, defilement of flesh and spirit, and of all malice; that in this also Thy most holy Name may be glorified: of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^330]

units.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и , и҆́же ми́лостїю и҆ щедрота́ми твои́ми и҆сцѣлѧ́ѧй съкроуше́нїа дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ на́шихъ · са́мъ влⷣко ѡ҆ст҃и ма́сло сїѐ, ꙗ҆́ко бы́ти пома́зоующимсѧ ѿ не́го въ и҆сцѣле́нїе, и҆ въ оу҆стра́ноу всѧ́кои стра́сти · скве́рны пло́тьскыѧ и҆ дш҃евныѧ, и҆ всѧ́коѧ зло́бы · да и҆ ѡ҆ се́мъ просла́витсѧ твоѐ пр҃тое и҆́мѧ · Ѿца̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃го дх҃а , нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ, а҆ми́нь :~ *Є҆ли́коже гл҃етсѧ мл҃тва сїа̀ ѿ сщ҃енникѡвъ, пою́тсѧ стихы̀ сїѧ · гла́съ д҃ ·* Ско́ръ въ застꙋпле́нїи є҆ди́нъ сы́й Хрⷭ҇ѐ , ско́рое съ вы́ше покажѝ присѣще́нїе, стра́ждꙋщимъ рабѡ́мъ твоимъ

units.slavonic_text: и҆зба́ви ѿ не́доугѡвъ, и҆ гѡ́ркыхъ болѣ́зней · въз̾двигнѝ є҆́же пѣ́ти тѧ̀ и҆ сла́вити , мл҃твами Бц҃а , є҆ди́не чл҃колю́бче :~ Дш҃евныма ѡ҆чи́ма ѡ҆слѣпле́нъ , к тебѣ̀ Хрⷭ҇ѐ прихождоу̀ ꙗ҆́ко слѣпы́й ѿ рожде́нїа , въ покаѧ́нїи зовы̀ ти · мл҃тикъ на́мъ бꙋ́ди є҆ди́не бл҃гопремѣни́телю :~ Дш҃ю мою̀ Гдⷭ҇и, въ грѣсѣ́хъ въсѧ́ческыхъ, и҆ безмѣ́стныхъ дѣѧ́нїихъ лю́тѣ разсла́бленнꙋю , въз̾двигнѝ Бж҃твънымъ си прѣⷣста́тельствомъ , ꙗ҆́коже и҆ расла́бленнаго въздви́глъ є҆си дре́вле · да̀ зовоу̀ ти сп҃се́нъ ще́дре · да́ждь ми Хрⷭ҇ѐ цѣ́лбоу :~
units.english_text: *Troparion 3, Tone 4:* My soul, O Lord, grievously paralyzed by all manner of sins and unfitting deeds, raise up by Thy divine interposition, as of old Thou didst raise up the paralytic; that, being saved, I may cry aloud unto Thee, O Compassionate One: Grant me healing, O Christ![^334]

units.slavonic_text: Бра́тїе, ѡ҆́бразъ прїими́те злостра́стїю , и҆ длъготрѣпѣ́нїю, прр҃кы и҆̀же гла́ша и҆́менемъ Гнⷭ҇имъ · Сѐ бл҃жимъ тръпѧ́щаѧ · тръпѣ́нїе і҆ѡ́вово слы́шасте · и҆ кончи́ноу Гн҃ю ви́дѣсте, ꙗ҆́ко мнѡ́гомл҃тивъ є҆́стъ и҆ ще́дръ · пре́ждеже въсѣ́хъ бра́тїе моѧ̀ не кленѣ́тесѧ ни нб҃омъ, нѝ земле́ю, ни и҆но́ю ко́ею клѧ́твою · боу́ди же ва́мъ є҆́же є҆ѝ є҆ѝ · и҆ є҆́же нѝ нѝ · да̀ не въ лицемиѣ́рїе въпа́дете · Злостра́жетъ ли кто̀ въ ва́съ , да̀ мл҃твꙋ дѣ́етъ · бл҃годꙋ́шествоу́етъ ли кто̀ , да пое́тъ · боли́тъ ли кто̀ въ ва́съ , да призове́тъ пѡпы̀ цр҃кѡ́вныѧ , и҆ да мл҃твꙋ сътво́рѧт

units.english_text: Is any among you suffering affliction? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing psalms. Is any sick among you? Let him call for the priests of the church, and let them pray[^345] over Him, anointing Him with oil in the Name of the Lord. And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise Him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven Him. units.slavonic_text: бы́ти въпа́дшемоу въ разбо́йникы ; Ѡ҆́нъ же речѐ, сътвори́выи мл҃ть съ ни́мъ · Рече́ же є҆моу̀ і҆с҃ · и҆дѝ и҆ ты̀ творѝ та́кожде :~ *Та́же є҆ктінїа̀ ·* Поми́лꙋй на́съ Бж҃е по вели́цей мл҃ти твое́й, мо́лимъ ти сѧ оу҆слы́ши и҆ поми́лꙋй :~ Є҆щѐ мо́лимъ сѧ ѡ҆ мл҃ти ѡ҆ животѣ̀ ѡ҆ здра́вїи и҆ сп҃се́нїи, ѡ҆ посѣще́нїи и҆ ѡ҆ставле́нїи грѣхѡ́въ ра́боу Бж҃їю *и҆́мѧ ре́къ ·* Є҆щѐ мо́лимъ сѧ ѡ҆ прости́ти сѧ є҆моу̀ всѧ́комоу прегрѣше́нїю во́лномоу и҆ нево́лномоу :~ Є҆ще мл҃имсѧ ꙗ҆́ко да Гдⷭ҇ь Бг҃ъ низпо́слетъ є҆моу̀ бл҃гть и҆збавлє́нїа · и҆ ѿ не́мощи въздви́гнетъ є҆го̀ ѿ ѻ҆́дра болѣ́зньнаго · рецѣ́мъ въсѝ Гдⷭ҇и

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 97 маслосщение
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 97r. Running header: МАСЛОСЩ҃ЕНЇЕ]
units.english_text: **Reader:** Brethren: We that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves. Let each one of us please his neighbor for his good, unto edification. For Christ also pleased not Himself; but, as it is written: The reproaches of them that reproached Thee fell upon Me.[^370] For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our instruction, that through patience and comfort of the Scriptures we might have hope. Now the God of patience and comfort grant you to be of the same mind one with another, according to Christ Jesus; that with one mind and with one mouth ye may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. Therefore[^371]

units.english_text: **Priest:** At that time, Jesus was passing through Jericho. And behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, who was a chief tax collector, and he was rich. And he sought to see who Jesus was, and could not because of the crowd, for he was small of stature. And running on ahead, he climbed up into a sycamore tree to see Him, for He was to pass that way. And when Jesus came to the place, looking up, He saw him, and said unto him: Zacchaeus, make haste and come down; for today[^374]

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 98r. Running header: МАСЛОСЩ҃ЕНЇЕ]
units.english_text: **Priest:** I must abide at thy house. And he made haste and came down, and received Him joyfully. And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying that He had gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner. And Zacchaeus stood and said unto the Lord: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have wrongfully exacted aught of any man, I restore fourfold. units.slavonic_text: не боу́детъ въ ра́дость врагоу̀ є҆го̀ · да и҆ на то́мъ просла́витсѧ пр҃тое и҆́мѧ тво[е] · *Възгла́съ ·* *Твое́ бо є҆́стъ є҆́же ми́ловати и҆ сп҃ти ны́ Хе́ Бг҃е, и҆ тебѣ̀ сла́вꙋ восыла́емъ, съ безнача́лным ти ѻ҆ц҃емъ, и҆ прест҃ы́мъ и҆ бл҃гы́мъ и҆ животворѧ́щим ти Дх҃омъ · нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭно и҆ въ вѣ́ки вѣко́мъ ·* *Та́же тре́тїй сщ҃енникъ гле́тъ · Про́, гла́, г҃ ·* Гдⷭь просвѣще́нїе моѐ и҆ сп҃ситель мо́й, кого́ сѧ оу҆бою̀ · *сти́,* Гдⷭь защити́тель животꙋ̀ моемꙋ̀ ѿ кого́сѧ оу҆страшꙋ̀ · *А҆́плъ къ Кори́нѳеѡмъ · Бра́тїе,* вы̀ є҆сте тѣ́ло хв҃о и҆ оу҆́ди ѿ ча́сти · и҆ ѡ҆вѣ́хъ оу҆́бо положѝ Бг҃ъ въ цр҃кви · пе́рвее а҆́плы · второ́е проро́кы · тре́тїе оу҆чи́телѧ · пото́мже ·

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 101v. Running header: ЧИ́НЪ]
units.english_text: **Reader:** I am nothing. And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not love, it profits me nothing. Love suffers long, and is kind; love envies not; love vaunts not itself, is not puffed up, doth not behave itself unseemly, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil; rejoices not in iniquity, but rejoices in the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things. Love never fails.[^388]

units.english_text: **Priest:** body, and for the cleansing and removal of every passion, and of every sickness, and disease, and of every defilement of flesh and spirit. Yea, Lord, send down from heaven Thy healing power; and touch the body of Thy servant *[Name]*. Quench in him the burning flame; subdue the passions, and drive away every bodily ailment. Be a physician unto Thy servant, and raise him up from the bed of sickness, and from the couch of suffering, whole and sound. Grant him to be present in Thy holy church, and to do all Thy good and acceptable commandments.

units.slavonic_text: *Про́ · гла́ д҃ ·* Въ́ньже дн҃ь призовоу́ тѧ, ско́ро оу҆слы́ши мѧ̀ · *Сті́хъ ·* Гдⷭи оу҆слы́ши мл҃твꙋ мою̀, и҆ во́пль мо́[й] · *А҆пл҃ъ къ кори́нѳеѡмъ ·* Бра́тїе, вы̀ є҆стѐ цр҃кви Бг҃а жи́ва, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ Бг҃ъ · Ꙗ҆́ко вселю́сѧ въ ни́хъ, и҆ похождꙋ̀ · и҆ бꙋ́дꙋ и҆̀мъ Бг҃ъ, и҆ ті́и бꙋ́доутъ мнѣ̀ лю́дїе · Тѣ́мже и҆зыдѣ́те ѿ среды̀ и҆́хъ, и҆ ѿлꙋчи́тесѧ гл҃етъ Гдⷭь · и҆ нечистотѣ̀ неприкаса́йтесѧ, и҆ а҆́зъ прїимꙋ̀ вы · и҆ бꙋ́доу ва́мъ въ ѻ҆тц҃а, и҆ вы бꙋ́дете мнѣ̀ въ сн҃ы и҆ дще́рѧ, гл҃етъ Гдⷭь въседръжи́тель · Сїа̀ оу҆̀бо и҆моу́ще ѡ҆бѣтова́нїа възлю́бленнїи, ѡ҆чи́стимсѧ ѿ въсѧ́коѧ скврѣ́ны пло́ти
units.english_text: **Reader:** In what day soever I call upon Thee, speedily give ear unto me.

units.slavonic_text: *Про́ · гла́ д҃ ·* Въ́ньже дн҃ь призовоу́ тѧ, ско́ро оу҆слы́ши мѧ̀ · *Сті́хъ ·* Гдⷭи оу҆слы́ши мл҃твꙋ мою̀, и҆ во́пль мо́[й] · *А҆пл҃ъ къ кори́нѳеѡмъ ·* Бра́тїе, вы̀ є҆стѐ цр҃кви Бг҃а жи́ва, ꙗ҆́коже речѐ Бг҃ъ · Ꙗ҆́ко вселю́сѧ въ ни́хъ, и҆ похождꙋ̀ · и҆ бꙋ́дꙋ и҆̀мъ Бг҃ъ, и҆ ті́и бꙋ́доутъ мнѣ̀ лю́дїе · Тѣ́мже и҆зыдѣ́те ѿ среды̀ и҆́хъ, и҆ ѿлꙋчи́тесѧ гл҃етъ Гдⷭь · и҆ нечистотѣ̀ неприкаса́йтесѧ, и҆ а҆́зъ прїимꙋ̀ вы · и҆ бꙋ́доу ва́мъ въ ѻ҆тц҃а, и҆ вы бꙋ́дете мнѣ̀ въ сн҃ы и҆ дще́рѧ, гл҃етъ Гдⷭь въседръжи́тель · Сїа̀ оу҆̀бо и҆моу́ще ѡ҆бѣтова́нїа възлю́бленнїи, ѡ҆чи́стимсѧ ѿ въсѧ́коѧ скврѣ́ны пло́ти
units.english_text: **Reader:** Ye are the temple of the living God; as God has said: I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people. Therefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, says the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you, and will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be My sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty. Having therefore these promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh[^397]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 105 чин
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 105v. Running header: ЧИ́НЪ]
units.english_text: **Priest:** unto the deliverance from evils for them that expect salvation from Thee. Yea, Master, Lord our God, we pray Thee, Almighty One, that Thou wilt save us all; Who alone art the Physician of both souls and bodies, sanctify us all: Thou Who healest every infirmity, heal also this Thy servant *[Name]*. Raise him up from the bed of sickness. For the sake of the compassion of Thy goodness, visit him with Thy mercy and Thy bounties. Drive away from him every infirmity and disease, that, being raised up by Thy mighty hand, he may serve Thee with all thanksgiving; that having even now partaken of Thine ineffable love for mankind, we may hymn Thee and glorify Thee, Who doest[^405]

units.slavonic_text: ве́лїа и҆ чю́днаа, сла́внаа и҆ преди́внаа · *Твое́ бо є҆́стъ є҆́же ми́ловати и҆ сп҃ати на́съ Бг҃е на́шъ :~* *Про́ · гла́съ, є҃ ·* Ты̀ Гдⷭи съхрани́ши ны̀ и҆ съблюде́ши ны̀ ѿ ро́да сего̀ и҆ въ вѣ́къ · *Сті́хъ ·* Сп҃си́ мѧ Гдⷭи ꙗ҆́ко ѡ҆скꙋдѣ̀ прпⷣбныи · *А҆пл҃ъ къ Гала́тѡмъ посла́нїа Па́влова чьте́нїе ·* Бра́тїе, пло́дъ дх҃о́вныи є҆́стъ, любы̀, ра́дость, ми́ръ, длъготрѣпѣ́нїе, бл҃гть, млⷭрдїе, вѣ́ра, кро́тость, въздръжа́нїе · На тако́выхъ нѣ́сть зако́на · А҆ и҆̀же Хрⷭто́ви сꙋ́ть, пло́ть распѧ́ша съ стрⷭтьми и҆ похо́тьми · А҆́ще живе́мъ дх҃омъ, дх҃омъ и҆ да хо́димъ · Не быва́имъ

units.slavonic_text: тщесла́вни, дроу́гъ дроу́га раздража́юще, дроу́гъ дроу́гꙋ зави́дѧще · Бра́тїе, а҆́ще впа́детъ чл҃къ въ нѣ́кое прегрѣше́нїе, вы̀ дх҃ѡ́внїи и҆справлѧ́йте тако́ваго дх҃омъ кро́тости, блюды́й себѐ да не и҆ ты̀ и҆скоуше́нъ бꙋ́деши · Дроу́гъ дроу́гоу тѧготы̀ носи́те, и҆ та́ко и҆сплъните зако́нъ Хв҃ъ :~ *А҆ллилоу́їа, гла́съ, є҃ ·* Мл҃ти твоѧ̀ Гдⷭи въ вѣ́кы въспою̀ : *Еу҆агге́лїе ѿ Матѳе́а ·* Речѐ Гдⷭь при́тчю сїю : ѻ҆у҆подо́бисѧ црⷭтво нб҃ное десѧти́мъ дѣва́мъ, ꙗ҆́же прїѧ́ша свѣти́лникы своѧ̀, и҆ и҆зыдо́ша въ срѣте́нїе женихоу̀ · Пѧ́ть же бѣ̀ ѿ ни́хъ мꙋ́дры, и҆ пѧт[ь]

units.english_text: **Priest:** were foolish. They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them; but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps. While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept. And at midnight there was a cry made: Behold, the bridegroom comes; go ye out to meet him! Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps. And the foolish said unto the wise: Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.[^412] But the wise answered, saying: Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you; but go ye rather to them that sell,[^413]

units.slavonic_text: и҆ кꙋпи́те себѣ̀ · и҆доу́щимъ же и҆́мъ коупи́ти, прїи́де жени́хъ · и҆ гото́выѧ внидо́ша съ ни́мъ на бра́кы, и҆ затворени бы́ша двє́ри · послѣ́ди же прїидо́ша и҆ про́чаѧ дѣ̂вы гл҃юще, Гди Гди ѿвръзѝ на́мъ · Ѻ́нъ же ѿвѣща[въ] речѐ · а҆ми́нь гл҃ю ва́мъ, невѣ́мъ ва́съ · бди́те оу҆́бо, ꙗ҆́ко невѣ́сте днѐ ни часа̀, въ ньже сн҃ъ чл҃чкыи прїиде́тъ :~ *Дїа́конъ · Поми́лꙋй* на́[съ] Бж҃е по вели́цѣй мл҃ти твое́й, мл҃и ти[сѧ] : є҆ще моли́мсѧ ѡ҆ мл҃ти живота̀ · Ѡ҆ є҆́же прости́тисѧ є҆мꙋ̀ всѧ́комꙋ пре[грѣше́нїю] · ꙗ҆́ко да Гдⷭь Бг҃ъ низпосле́ є҆мꙋ̀ блгⷣть и҆[зцѣле́нїа] · *възгла́[съ] · Ꙗ҆́ко мл҃тивый чл҃колю́бе[цъ]* Гдⷭꙋ помоли́мсѧ · *Та́же мл҃тва ҃є-аѧ ·*

units.english_text: **Priest:** without sin upon the earth; for Thou alone art without sin, Who camest to save the human race, and hast redeemed us from the bondage of the enemy. For if Thou shouldest enter into judgment with Thy servants, not one would be found pure from defilement; but every mouth shall be stopped, having nothing to answer, because all our righteousness is before Thee as a polluted rag.[^424] For this cause, remember not the sins of our youth and of our ignorance, O Lord.[^425] For Thou art the Hope of the hopeless, and the Rest of them that labor and are heavy-laden with sins and iniquities;[^426] and unto Thee do we send up glory, with Thine unoriginate Father, and the All-Holy,[^427]

units.slavonic_text: и҆ бл҃гы[мъ] и҆ животворѧ́щи[мъ] ти дх҃омъ · нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭно и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ :~ *про́ · гла́ ҃ѕ ·* помилоу́й мѧ Бж҃е по вели́цей мл҃ти твое́й · *Сті́хъ ·* Срⷣце чⷭто съзи́жди въ мнѣ̀ Бж҃е · *а҆пл҃ъ · къ каласа́емъ посла́нїе ·* Бра́тїе · ѡ҆блецѣ́тесѧ ꙗ҆́ко и҆збра́ннїи Бж҃їи, ст҃и и҆ възлю́блени · въ мл҃ть щедро́тъ, и҆ блгⷣть · въ смѣреномоу́дрїе, кро́тость, и҆ длъготръпѣ́нїе · прїемлюще дроу́г[ъ] дроу́га · и҆ оу҆гажа́юще себѣ̀ а҆́ще кто̀ на кого̀ и҆́матъ порече́нїе · ꙗ҆́коже и҆ Хс҃ оу҆годи́лъ є҆́стъ ва́мъ, та́коже и҆ вы̀ · надъ всѣ́ми же симѝ стѧжи́те любо́вь, ꙗ҆́же є҆́стъ съю́зъ

units.english_text: **Reader:** And if a man also strive for masteries, he is not crowned, unless he strive lawfully.[^473] The husbandman that labors must be the first to partake of the fruits.[^474] Consider what I say, for the Lord will give thee understanding in all things. Remember the Lord Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my Gospel; wherein I suffer hardship, even unto bonds, as an evildoer; but the word of God is not bound.[^475] Therefore I endure all things for the sake of the elect, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.[^476]

units.slavonic_text: *є҆ѵлїе · ѿ матѳе́а ·* Речѐ Гд҃ь · а҆́ще ѿпоуща́ете чл҃кѡмъ съгрѣше́нїа и҆́хъ , ѿпоу́ститъ и҆ ва́мъ Ѿц҃ъ ва́шъ нб҃ныи · а҆́ще ли не ѿпоуща́ете чл҃кѡмъ съгрѣше́нїа и҆́хъ, ни Ѿц҃ъ ва́шъ ѿпоу́ститъ ва́м[ъ] съгрѣше́нїи ва́шихъ · є҆гда́ же пѡ́стите сѧ , не боу́дите ꙗ҆́ко же лицемѣ́ри сѣтоу́юще · помрача́ю[тъ] бо ли́ца своꙗ̀ , ꙗ҆́ко да ꙗ҆вѧ́т́сѧ чл҃кѡмъ по́стѧщесѧ · а҆ми́нь глю̀ ва́мъ , ꙗ҆́ко възпрїи́моутъ мъздоу̀ свою̀ · Ты́ же по́стѧсѧ пома́жи гла́воу свою̀ , и҆ лицѐ твоѐ оу҆мы́й · ꙗ҆́ко да не ꙗ҆ви́шисѧ чл҃кѡм по́стѧсѧ · но̀ Ѿц҃у тво́емꙋ и҆́же въ та́йнѣ ·
units.english_text: **Priest:** The Lord said: If ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you; but if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.[^479] Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance; for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Truly I say unto you, they have their reward.[^480] But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face; that thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father Who is in secret;[^481]

provenance.verbatim_source: **Priest:** The Lord said: If ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you; but if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.[^479] Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance; for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и отц твой видяй в таине въздаст тебе
units.slavonic_text: и҆ Ѿц҃ъ тво́й ви́дѧй въ та́инѣ възда́стъ тебѣ̀ ꙗ҆́вѣ · не скрыва́йте себѣ̀ съкрѡ́вищъ на землѝ, и҆дѣ́же чрь́вь и҆ тлѧ̀ тли́тъ · и҆ и҆дѣ́же та́тїе подкѡ́поваютъ, и҆ кра́доутъ · съкрыва́йте же себѣ̀ съкрѡ́вищъ на нб҃си · и҆де́же ни чрь́вь ни тлѧ̀ тли́[тъ] · и҆ и҆де́же та́тїе не покѡ́поваютъ, ни кра́доутъ · и҆дѣ́же бо є҆́стъ съкрѡ́вище ва́ше, тоу̀ бꙋ́детъ и҆ срⷣце ва́ше :~ Є҆кте́нїа · Помлꙋ́й на́съ Бж҃е по вели́цей : Є҆ще моли́мсѧ ѡ҆ мл҃ти и҆ животѣ̀ · Ꙗ҆́ко да Гд҃ь Бг҃ъ ѿпоу́ститъ є҆мꙋ̀ всѧ́ко · Ꙗ҆́ко да Гд҃ь Бг҃ъ низпосле́тъ є҆мꙋ̀ бл҃гть и҆ · Възгла́съ · Ꙗ҆́ко мл҃тивый чл҃колꙋ́бецъ · Гдⷵꙋ помоли́мсѧ · и҆ мл҃твоу сїю̀ ·
units.english_text: **Priest:** and thy Father Who sees in secret will reward thee openly. Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves dig through and steal; but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes, and where thieves do not dig through nor steal; for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.[^482]

provenance.verbatim_source: **Priest:** and thy Father Who sees in secret will reward thee openly. Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves dig through and steal; but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes, and where thieves do not dig through nor steal; for where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.[^482]

units.slavonic_incipit: Цр҃ю ст҃ы́и, млⷵрде и҆ многомл҃тиве Гдⷵи
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: црю стыи млрде и многомлтиве гди ис хе
units.slavonic_text: Цр҃ю ст҃ы́и, млⷵрде и҆ многомл҃тиве Гдⷵи І҃с Х҃е, Сн҃е и҆ Сло́ве Бг҃а жива́го · не хотѧ́й съме́рти грѣ́шнаго, но ѡ҆брати́тисѧ, и҆ жи́воу бы́ти є҆мꙋ̀ · не възлага́ю грѣ́шныѧ рꙋкы̀ моѧ̀, на главоу̀ прише́дшаго к тебѣ̀ въ грѣсѣ́хъ, и҆ просѧ́щаго оу҆ тебѐ на́ми ѡ҆ставле́нїе грѣхѡ́мъ · но твою роу́коу крѣ́пкоую, и҆ си́лноую ю҆́же въ ст҃ѣ́мъ є҆ѵлїи се́мъ · є҆́же съслоуже́бници моѝ дръжа́тъ на главѣ̀ раба̀ твоего и҆́млⷶ ре́къ · и҆ молю́ ти сѧ съ ни́ми, и҆ прошꙋ̀ мл҃тивное, и҆ непамѧтозло́бное чл҃колю́бїе твоѐ Бж҃е сп҃сителю нашъ · и҆́же прⷪрокомъ твои́мъ наѳа́номъ, дв҃дꙋ пока́явшꙋсѧ
units.english_text: **Priest:** Holy King, compassionate and plenteous in mercy, Lord Jesus Christ, Son and Word of the living God,[^510] Who desirest not the death of a sinner, but that he turn and live:[^511] I lay not my sinful hand upon the head of him that is come unto Thee in sins, and asks through us of Thee the remission of sins; but Thy mighty and strong hand, which is in this Holy Gospel that my fellow ministers hold upon the head of Thy servant *[Name];*[^512] and I pray unto Thee with them, and beseech Thy merciful and malice-free love for mankind, O God our Savior:[^513] Who through Thy Prophet Nathan, when David repented[^514]

provenance.verbatim_source:
*Prayer of Imposition of the Gospel:*[^509]
**Priest:** Holy King, compassionate and plenteous in mercy, Lord Jesus Christ, Son and Word of the living God,[^510] Who desirest not the death of a sinner, but that he turn and live:[^511] I lay not my sinful hand upon the head of him that is come unto Thee in sins, and asks through us of Thee the remission of sins; but Thy mighty and strong hand, which is in this Holy Gospel that my fellow ministers hold upon the head of Thy servant *[Name];*[^512] and I pray unto Thee with them, and beseech Thy merciful and malice-free love for mankind, O God our Savior:[^513] Who through Thy Prophet Nathan, when David repented[^514]
