units.slavonic_stem_tier2: о своих съгрешениих отпущение даровав и манассииноу
units.slavonic_text: ѡ҆ свои́хъ съгрѣше́нїихъ, ѿпꙋще́нїе дарова́въ · и҆ манассїиноу є҆́же ѡ҆ покаѧ́нїи мл҃твꙋ прїе́мъ · са́мъ вл҃ко и҆ ра́ба твое́го, ка́ющасѧ ѡ҆ свои́хъ є҆моу съгрѣше́нїихъ, прїимѝ ѡ҆бы́чнымъ ти чл҃колю́бїемъ, презира́ѧ всѧ̑ того̀ прегрѣше́нїа · ты́ бо є҆си Бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆́же седмьдесѧ́тъ кра́тъ седмери́цею рекі́й праща́ти впада́ющимъ въ грѣхы̀ · занѐ ꙗ҆́ко вели́чество твоѐ, та́ко и҆ мл҃ть твоа̀ · и҆ тебѣ̀ подоба́етъ всѧ́ка сла́ва, чть и҆ покланѧ́нїе · нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷵно и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ, а҆ми́нь :~ И҆ та́ко болѧ́щїй цѣлоу́етъ ст҃о́е є҆ѵлїе · Сщ҃енници же сконча́вше мл҃твоу гл҃ютъ сїѐ ·
units.english_text: **Priest:** of his own sins, didst grant forgiveness; and didst accept the prayer of Manasseh concerning repentance:[^515] do Thou Thyself, O Master, accept also Thy servant, repenting of the sins committed by him, with Thine accustomed love for mankind, overlooking all his transgressions.[^516] For Thou art our God, Who didst command to forgive seventy times seven unto them that fall into sins;[^517] for as is Thy greatness, so also is Thy mercy.[^518] And unto Thee is due all glory, honor, and worship, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^519]

Amen.[^519]

units.slavonic_incipit: Бл҃гослове́нїе Гд҃а Бг҃а и҆ сп҃са на́шего
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: блгословение гда бга и спса нашего ис ха
units.slavonic_text: Бл҃гослове́нїе Гд҃а Бг҃а и҆ сп҃са на́шего І҃с Х҃а · на и҆сцѣле́нїе дꙋши и҆ тѣ́лꙋ ра́бꙋ Бж҃їю и҆́млⷶ ре́къ · нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷵно и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ а҆ми́нь :~ И҆ начина́ютъ сщ҃енници ма́зати дроу́гъ дроу́га · и҆ всѣ́хъ тре́боующихъ бл҃гослове́нїа сегѡ̀ · пою́ще стїхꙋ́рꙋ сїю̀ гла́съ · д҃ · самогла́снѡ · Исто́чникъ и҆сцѣле́нїемъ, и҆моу́ще ст҃і́и безсре́брници · и҆сцѣле́нїа подава́ете всѣ́мъ тре́боующимъ · ꙗ҆́ко вели́кѡмъ да́рѡмъ сподо́блшесѧ, ѿ при́сно текоу́щаго и҆сто́чника сп҃са на́шего · рече́ бо къ ва́мъ Гд҃ь, ꙗ҆́ко є҆диноревни́теле а҆п҃лѡмъ · сѐ да́хъ ва́мъ вла́сть на доу́сѣхъ нечи́стыхъ · ꙗ҆́ко и҆згони́ти и҆́хъ · и҆
units.english_text: **Priests:** The blessing of the Lord God and our Savior Jesus Christ, unto the healing of soul and body to the servant of God *[Name],* now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^521]

units.slavonic_text: цѣли́ти всѧ́къ не́дꙋгъ, и҆ всѧ́коу боле́знь · тѣ́мже въ повелѣ́нїихъ є҆го до́брѣ пожи́вше · тоу́не прїѧ́сте, тоу́не же дади́те · оу҆врачꙋ́юще стра̑ти дꙋ́шъ и҆ тѣле́съ на́шихъ :~ Сла́ва, и҆ нн҃ѣ · Бг҃о · Болѣ́знїю лю́тою ѡ҆дръжи́мъ · ѿ ѡ҆бою стра́ноу пробода́емъ · дх҃ъ ѡ҆бнемощева́ет ми въ грѣсѣ́хъ мно́зѣхъ · тѣ́ло же па́ки боли́тъ ми строу́пы, и҆ гное́нїемъ · ѿ ѡ҆бои́хъ мѧ Бц҃е и҆сцѣлѝ · мо́жеши бо є҆ли́ка хо́щеши · просѧ́щи є҆го́же породѝ Хрⷵта̀ · є҆го́же молѝ ми́роу оу҆щѣдре́нїе пода́ти, и҆ ве́лїю мл҃ть :~ И҆ поси́мъ пома́завшиисѧ взаи́мнѡ,
units.english_text: **Choir:** to heal every infirmity and every disease.[^526] Therefore, having lived well according to His commandments, freely ye received, freely give;[^527] healing the passions of our souls and bodies.[^528]

units.slavonic_text: пома́зꙋютъ и҆ болѧ́щаго · и҆ гл҃ют є҆кте́нїю є҆ди́нъ по є҆диномꙋ ра́дом · Помлꙋ́й на́съ Бж҃е по вели́цей мл҃ти твое́й, мо́лимтисѧ оу҆слы́ши и҆ поми́лꙋй · Є҆ще моли́мсѧ ѡ҆ мл҃ти животѣ̀, ѡ҆ здра́вїи и҆ сп҃се́нїи, ѡ҆ посѣще́нїи ра́боу Бж҃їю и҆́млⷶ ре́къ · Ѡ҆ є҆́же прости́тисѧ є҆моу всѧ́комоу прегрѣше́нїю во́лномꙋ, и҆ нево́лномꙋ : Ꙗ҆́ко да Гд҃ь Бг҃ъ низпосле́тъ є҆моу благода́ть и҆збавле́нїа · и҆ ѿ не́мощи въздви́гнетъ є҆го̀ ѿ ѻ҆́дра болѣ́зньнаго реце́мъ всѝ · възгла́съ · Ꙗ҆́ко мл҃тивъ и҆ чл҃колю́бецъ Бг҃ъ є҆си, и҆ тебѣ̀ сла́воу възсыла́емъ Ѿц҃ꙋ и҆ сн҃оу и҆ ст҃о́моу дх҃оу · нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷵно

units.english_text: **Reader:** Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered. Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputes not sin, neither is there guile in his mouth.[^564] Because I kept silence, my bones grew old through my crying all the day long. For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me: I was turned into distress when a thorn was fastened in me.[^565] Mine iniquity I acknowledged, and my sin I did not hide. I said: I will confess against myself mine iniquity unto the Lord; and Thou forgavest the ungodliness of my heart.[^566] For this shall every holy one pray unto Thee in a seasonable time; nevertheless, in a flood of many waters

units.slavonic_text: [Ли́стъ рк҃ѕ] [Въ нача́лѣ и҆сповѣ́данїѧ] немоу̀ не прибли́жатсѧ · Ты̀ є҆си прибѣ́жище моѐ ѿ скръ́би ѡ҆дръжа́- щаѧ мѧ̀ · ра́дости моа̀ и҆зба́ви мѧ̀ ѿ ѡ҆быше́дшихъ мѧ̀ · Въразꙋмлю̀ тѧ̀, и҆ наста́влю тѧ̀ на поу́ть се́и въ́ньже по́йдеши · оу҆твръждоу̀ на́ тѧ ѡ҆́чи моѝ · Не боу́дѣте ꙗ҆́ко ко́нь и҆ ме́скъ, и҆́мже нѣ́сть ра́зꙋма · Брозда́ми и҆ оу҆здо́ю че́люсти и҆́хъ въстѧ́гнеши не приближа́ющимсѧ к̾ тебѣ̀ · Мнѡ́гы ра́ны грѣ́шномꙋ, оу҆пова́ющаго же на Гдⷭа млⷭть ѡ҆бы́де · Възвесели́тесѧ ѡ҆ Гдⷭѣ, и҆ ра́доуйтесѧ пра́веднїи · и҆ хвали́тесѧ всѝ пра́вїи срⷣцемъ :~ Ѱало́мъ · н҃ · Помл҃ꙋй мѧ̀ Бж҃е · И҆ вѣ́роую въ є҆ди́наго Бг҃а ·
units.english_text: **Reader:** they shall not draw nigh unto him. Thou art my refuge from the affliction that compasses me; O my joy, deliver me from them that have encircled me. I will instruct thee and guide thee in this way wherein thou shalt go; I will fix Mine eyes upon thee.[^567] Be ye not as the horse or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose jaws thou must muzzle with bit and bridle, lest they draw nigh unto thee. Many are the scourges of the sinner, but him that hopes on the Lord mercy shall encircle. Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous; and glory, all ye that are upright in heart.[^568]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: лист ркз в начале жене грешници и
units.slavonic_text: [Ли́стъ рк҃з] [Въ нача́лѣ] женѣ̀ грѣ́шници · и҆ сподо́би мѧ̀ ѻ҆мочи́ти нѡ́зѣ твоѝ, и҆́же мѧ̀ ѿ а҆́дскыѧ ле́сти свобо́ждьшаѧ · и҆ мѵ́ро бл҃гооу҆ха́нїа тебѣ̀ принестѝ, житїѐ чⷭто, покаѧ́нїемъ ми стѧ́- жано · да оу҆слы́шоу и҆ а҆́зъ бл҃га́го гла́са твоего̀ · вѣ́ра твоѧ̀ сп҃се́ тѧ, и҆дѝ въ ми́ръ :~ И҆ нн҃ѣ · А҆́зъ дв҃о ст҃аѧ Бц҃е подъ кро́въ тво́й прибѣга́ю, вѣ́дѧ ꙗ҆́ко ѡ҆брѧ́щоу тобо́ю сп҃се́нїе · мо́жеши бо ты̀ пре- чⷭтаѧ помощѝ ми :~ Сїю̀ мл҃твꙋ, гл҃етъ дꙋхо́вникъ ѡ҆ не́мъ · [Буквица Щ] Ще́дрый и҆ ми́лостивый Бг҃е · и҆спыта́ѧи срⷣца и҆ оу҆трѡ́бы · и҆ та́йнаѧ чл҃чкаѧ вѣ́дый ·
units.english_text: **Choir:** [unto the] sinful woman; and vouchsafe me to wash Thy feet, which have delivered me from the deceit of hades; and to offer unto Thee fragrant myrrh: a pure life, acquired by me through repentance; that I also may hear Thy gracious voice: Thy faith has saved thee, go in peace.[^574]

units.english_text: **Spiritual Father:** there is no deed invisible before Thee, but all things are naked and revealed before Thine eyes;[^579] Who also knowest all things of mine: loathe me not, neither turn away Thy face from me;[^580] but overlook my transgressions at this hour, Who overlookest the transgressions of men that repent; and cleanse the defilements of my body and soul; and sanctify me wholly unto the end by this Thine invisible and spiritual right hand;[^581] lest, while promising release unto others, and dispensing it through Thine ineffable love for mankind, I myself, as an unapproved servant, should become guilty of sin.[^582] Yea, Master, Who alone art good and the Lover of mankind, let me not turn back[^583]

units.english_text: **Spiritual Father:** open his hearing, to hear well and meekly what I am about to speak unto him; direct his words unto truth; move his heart and soul to compunction; that in all truth, and faith, and love, he may expose his iniquity, as worthy of shame;[^590] forgive him all that he has evilly done; and strengthen him in purity and righteousness to serve Thee all the days of his life;[^591] that prospering, he may glorify Thine all-holy Name, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^592]

Amen.][^604]

units.english_text: **Monk:** passions have befallen me, and many others which I remember not.[^620] Therefore, more than all sinners have I become the most sinful, and more than all that have worked iniquity have I worked iniquity most lawlessly;[^621] and I desire to confess my sins, and to manifest and expose them; but I am ashamed and fearful lest I defile the ears of them that hear.[^622] Therefore indeed, out of all my evils, I have in part exposed certain iniquities, and set them forth here for manifestation; but those that are fiercer and more grievous than these, and unutterable, and most foul, have I concealed and kept silent; neither do I know whether I have remembered to speak all;[^623]

Гд҃ь ꙋ҆́- слышитъ мѧ̀ є҆гда̀ въ́ззовоу̀ къ немоу̀ . гнѣ́ваитисѧ , и҆ не съгрѣ- ша́йте . ꙗ҆́же гл҃ете въ ср҃цяхъ ва́- шихъ , на лѡ́жихъ ва́шихъ ꙋ҆ми- ли́тисѧ . пожри́те жръ́твꙋ пра́вдѣ , и҆ ꙋ҆пова́йте на Гд҃а . мнѡ́ꙁи гл҃ют , кто̀ ꙗ҆ви́тъ на́мъ бл҃га́ѧ ; зна́мена- сѧ на на́съ свѣ́тъ лица̀ твое́го Гн҃и , да́лъ є҆си весе́лїе въ ср҃ци мое́мъ . ѿ пло́да пшени́ца , вина̀ и҆ є҆ле́ѧ свое́го

units.slavonic_text: [Ли́стъ рм҃а] [И҆сповѣ́да́нїю] ꙋ҆мнѡ́жишасѧ . въ ми́рѣ в́коу́- пѣ ꙋ҆сноу̀ , и҆ почі́ю . ꙗ҆́ко ты́ Гн҃и є҆дина́го на ꙋ҆пова́нїе въсели́лъ мѧ̀ є҆си :~ ТА́ЖЕ МЛ҃ТВА СІ́И ВЕЛЕГЛА́СНО . Гн҃и Бж҃е сп҃се́нїа на́шего . поми́лꙋй щедро́та́ми сѝ многомл҃тве раба̀ твоє́го и҆́мѧ ре́къ . приклони́выи нб҃са̀ , и҆ съше́дъ млр҃дїа ра́ди ро́да чл҃чскаго . нехотѧ́й съмр҃ти грѣ́шникѡмъ , но̀ ѡ҆браще́нїа , и҆ животоу̀ . ты́ вл҃ко молѧ́щемоу сѧ рабоу твоє́моу . пода́ждь є҆моу̀ ꙋ҆твръжде́нно мѣ́сто покаѧ́нїа , съ- вѣ́дыи грѣ́хъ , и҆ ѡ҆чища́ѧ безако́- нїа . ѡ҆ста́ви и҆ ѿда́ждь є҆моу всѧ̑ прегрѣше́нїа вѡ́лнаѧ , и҆ невѡ́лнаа . [Сигнатура: р є҃]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: лист рма оборотный чин и причти его к
units.slavonic_text: [Ли́стъ рм҃а ѡ҆боро́тный] [Чи́нъ] и҆ причтѝ є҆го̀ къ ст҃ѣ́й свое́й събо́рнѣ , и҆ а҆пл҃ьстѣ́й цр҃кви . ꙗ҆́ко твоѧ̀ дръ́- жа́ва , и҆ твоє̀ є҆́стъ цр҃тво и҆ си́ла и҆ сла́ва ѿца̀ и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃го дх҃а . нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́ :~ Ѱало́ . ѕ҃ . Гн҃и не ꙗ҆́ростїю твое́ю ѡ҆бличи́ менѐ , ниже́ гнѣ́вомъ твои́мъ покажѝ менѐ . помлꙋ́й мѧ̀ Гн҃и , ꙗ҆́ко не́мощенъ є҆́смь . и҆сцѣлѝ мѧ̀ Гн҃и , ꙗ҆́ко смоути́шасѧ кѡ́сти моѧ̑ . и҆ дш҃а моѧ смоути́сѧ ѕѣлѡ̀ . и҆ ты̀ Гн҃и доко́лѣ ; ѡ҆братѝ Гн҃и , и҆ и҆зба́ви дш҃ю мою̀ . сп҃си́ мѧ ра́ди мл҃ти твое́ѧ . ꙗ҆́ко нѣ́сть въ съмр҃ти помина́ѧй тебѐ , въ а҆́дѣ же кто̀ и҆сповѣ́сть ти сѧ . ꙋ҆троуди́хъ сѧ
units.english_text: **Priest:** and unite him unto Thy holy, Catholic, and Apostolic Church.[^745] For Thine is the dominion, and Thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. [Amen.][^746]

units.slavonic_text: покаѧ́нїе раба̀ твое́го и҆́мѧ ре́къ , припада́юща къ вели́чествїю твоєму̀ . є҆́же съгрѣшѝ простѝ є҆мꙋ̀ ꙗ҆́ко є҆ди́нъ бл҃гъ * и҆зба́ви є҆го̀ ѿ всѧ́кого пло́тскаго прегрѣше́нїа * простѝ є҆го̀ ѿ всѧ́коѧ сквръ́ны , и҆ сꙋ́вѣсть ѡ҆чи́сти * ꙋ҆крѣпѝ є҆го на дѣ́ло твои́хъ за́повѣдей * и҆ сподо́би є҆го̀ досто́инїа ст҃го ѡ҆лтара̀ * и҆ прича́стника Бж҃твеныхъ твои́хъ та́инъ * да чт҃ою дш҃ею и҆ тѣ́ломъ пло́ды твоѧ̀ , и҆ възвраща́ѧсѧ , приєди́нитъ къ ст҃ы̑мъ твои́мъ дѣ́лѡмъ * и҆ бꙋ́детъ наслѣ́дникъ цр҃твїю твоєму̀ нб҃ному * Бл҃гтїю и҆ щедро́та́ми , и҆ чл҃колю́бїемъ є҆диноро́днаго сн҃а твое́го
units.english_text: **Priest:** the repentance of Thy servant *[Name, saying it],* falling down before Thy majesty.[^761] Whatsoever he hath sinned, forgive him, as the only good One;[^762] deliver him from every carnal transgression; forgive him of every defilement, and cleanse his conscience;[^763] strengthen him unto the work of Thy commandments;[^764] and vouchsafe him the dignity of the holy altar, and to be a partaker of Thy divine Mysteries;[^765] that with a pure soul and body he may bear Thy fruits, and, returning, may be joined unto Thy holy works;[^766] and may be an heir of Thy heavenly kingdom:[^767]

units.english_text: **Reader:** How long, O Lord, wilt Thou forget me unto the end? How long wilt Thou turn away Thy face from me?[^770] How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrows in my heart day and night? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?[^771] Look upon me, and hear me, O Lord my God; enlighten mine eyes, lest at any time I sleep unto death;[^772] lest at any time mine enemy say: I have prevailed against him; they that afflict me will rejoice if I be shaken.[^773]

Та́же мл҃твꙋ * Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е сп҃си́телю на́шъ * и҆́же прⷪ҇рокомъ тво́имъ нада́номъ , пока́ѧвшоусѧ дв҃дꙋ ѡ҆ свои́хъ прегрѣше́нїихъ ѿпоуще́нїе пода́въ * и҆ манасїино покаѧ́нїе и҆ мл҃твоу приѧ́тъ * са́мъ нн҃ѣ ра́ба твое́го и҆́мѧ ре́къ , ка́ющасѧ ѡ҆ свои́хъ прегрѣше́нїихъ прїимѝ ѻ҆бы́чнымъ ти чл҃колю́бїемъ * презрѧ̀ є҆моу всѧ̑ прегрѣше́нїа * ты́ бо є҆си Гдⷭ҇и , и҆́же седмьдесѧ́тъ седмери́цею рекі́и праща́ти въпа́дающимъ въ

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: гди бже наш иже петрови и
units.slavonic_text: Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е на́шъ , и҆́же петро́ви , и҆ блꙋдници слеза́ми грѣхы̀ ѡ҆ста́вивъ * и҆ мытарѧ̀ своѧ̑ позна́вша прегрѣше́нїа ѡ҆правда́въ * прїимѝ и҆сповѣда́нїе раба̀ твое́го и҆́мѧ ре́къ * є҆́же ти съгрѣшѝ вѡ́лныѧ и҆ невѡ́лныѧ грѣхы̀ * сло́вомъ и҆ли дѣ́ломъ , и҆ли помышле́нїемъ , ꙗ҆́ко бл҃гъ пре́зри * ты́ бо є҆ди́нъ вла́сть и҆́маши ѿпоуща́ти грѣхы̀ * ꙗ҆́ко Бг҃ъ мл҃тей и҆ щедро́тъ , и҆ чл҃колю́бїа є҆си * и҆ тебѣ̀ сла́воу възсыла́емъ ѿц҃оу и҆ сн҃оу и҆ ст҃о́моу дх҃оу * нн҃ѣ и҆ пр҃но и҆: А҆пл҃ъ * къ тимоѳе́ю * Ча́до тимоѳе́ю * вѣ́рно сло́во , и҆ всѧ́комоу прїѧ́тїю досто́йно *
units.english_text: **Priest:** O Lord our God, Who didst forgive sins unto Peter and the harlot through tears,[^802] and didst justify the publican who acknowledged his transgressions:[^803] receive the confession of Thy servant *[Name, saying it],* whatsoever sins he hath committed against Thee, voluntary and involuntary, in word, or in deed, or in thought; as good, overlook them;[^804] for Thou alone hast authority to forgive sins;[^805] for Thou art the God of mercies and compassions and love for mankind; and unto Thee we send up glory, to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and [unto ages of ages. Amen.][^806]

units.slavonic_incipit: ꙗ҆́ко х҃с прїи́де въ ми́ръ грѣ́шникы
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ко хс прииде в мир грешникы спсти
units.slavonic_text: ꙗ҆́ко х҃с прїи́де въ ми́ръ грѣ́шникы сп҃сти . ѿ ни́хже пръ́вый є҆смь а҆́зъ . но̀ сего̀ ра́ди поми́лованъ бы́хъ , да ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ пока́жетъ і҃с х҃с всѐ дълготръпѣ́нїе , къ ѡ҆́бразоу хотѧ́щимъ вѣ́ровати є҆моу̀ въ жи́знь вѣ́чноую : цр҃ю же вѣкѡ́мъ не тлѣ́нномоу , не ви́димомоу , є҆ди́номоу премоу́дромоу бг҃ꙋ чⷭ҇ть и҆ сла́ва въ вѣ́кы а҆ми́нь :~ Єѵ҃лїе ѿ ма́тѳе́а . Въ вре́мѧ ѡ҆́но , прѣходѧ̀ і҃с ви́дѣ чл҃ка сѣдѧ́ща на мы́тници матѳе́а и҆́менемъ . и҆ гла̀ є҆моу̀ , и҆дѝ по мнѣ̀ , и҆ въста́въ по не́мъ и҆́де . и҆ бы́сть є҆мꙋ̀ възлежа́щꙋ въ домоу̀ . и҆ сѐ мнѡ́ѕи мытарє̀ и҆ грѣ́шници

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: пришедше възлежахоу с исом и с оученикы
units.slavonic_text: прише́дше възлежа́хоу съ і҃сомъ , и҆ съ оу҆ченикы є҆го̀ . и҆ ви́дѣвше фарисе́є гла́хꙋ оу҆ченникѡ́мъ є҆го̀ . почто̀ съ мытарѝ и҆ грѣ́шникы оу҆чи́тель ва́шъ ꙗ҆́стъ и҆ пїе́тъ . і҃с же слы́шавъ речѐ и҆́мъ . ше́дше наоучи́тисѧ , что̀ є҆́стъ , мл҃ти хощоу̀ а҆ не жръ́твѣ . не прїидо́хъ бо призва́ти прв҃ьникы , но грѣ́шникы на покаѧ́нїе :~ Є҆ктенїа̀ . Поми́лоуй на́съ Бж҃е по вели́цей мл҃ти твое́й, мо́лимъ ти сѧ оу҆слы́ши и҆ поми́[лоуй]. Є҆ще мо́лимсѧ оу҆слы́ши ны Бж҃е молѧ́щихъ тѧ ѡ҆ рабѣ́ твоемъ се́мъ , и҆́мѧ рекъ . ѡ҆ ѿда́нїи въсѧ́кого грѣха̀ сътвореннаго и҆́мъ . Гдⷭ҇и

units.english_text: Preserve me, O Lord, for in Thee have I hoped.[^900] I said unto the Lord: Thou art my Lord, for of my goods Thou hast no need.[^901] Unto the saints that are in His earth, the Lord hath made marvelous all His desires in them.[^902] Their infirmities were multiplied; after these things they made haste. I will not assemble their assemblies of blood, neither will I make mention of their names with my lips.[^903] The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup; Thou art He that restorest mine inheritance unto me.[^904] The lines are fallen unto me among my strongholds; for mine inheritance is strong unto me.[^905] I will bless the Lord Who hath given me understanding; moreover even unto the night my reins have instructed me.[^906]

units.english_text: O God, my God, attend unto me; why hast Thou forsaken me?[^912] Far from my salvation are the words of my transgressions.[^913] O my God, I will cry by day, and Thou wilt not hear; and by night, and [it shall] not [be counted] for[^914] folly unto me.[^915] But Thou dwellest in the holy place, O Praise of Israel.[^916] In Thee our fathers hoped; they hoped, and Thou didst deliver them.[^917] Unto Thee they cried, and were saved; in Thee they hoped, and were not put to shame.[^918] But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and the outcast of the people.[^919] All they that saw me laughed me to scorn; they spoke with their lips, they shook the head:[^920] He hoped in the Lord, let Him deliver him; let Him save him, for He desires him.[^921] For Thou art He that drewest me forth from the womb, my hope from my mother's breasts.[^922] Unto Thee was I cast from the womb; from my mother's belly Thou art my God.[^923]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 157 причащениа не отступи от мене ко
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 157r] *причаще́нїа* не ѿстꙋпѝ ѿ менѐ ꙗ҆́ко ско́рбь бли́зъ , ꙗ҆́ко нѣ́сть помага́ѧй ми : Ѡ҆бы- до́ша мѧ̀ те́лци мнѡ́ѕи , ю҆́нци тоу́чнїи ѡ҆дръжа́ша мѧ̀ . Ѡ҆връ́- зоша на́ мѧ оу҆ста̀ своꙗ̀ , ꙗ҆́ко ле́въ въсхища́ѧ и҆ рыка́ѧ . Ꙗ҆́ко вода̀ и҆- злїѧ́хъсѧ , и҆ разсы́пашасѧ всѧ̑ ко́сти моꙗ̑ . Бы́сть срⷣце моѐ ꙗ҆́ко во́скъ , та́ѧ посредѣ̀ чре́ва мое́го . И҆́зше ꙗ҆́ко скоуде́ль крѣ́пость моꙗ̀ , и҆ ꙗ҆зы́къ мо́и прильпѐ горта́ни мое́- моу . И҆ въ пръ́сть смръ́ти съве́лъ мѧ̀ є҆сѝ . Ꙗ҆́ко ѡ҆быдо́ша мѧ̀ ѱѝ мнѡ́ѕи , съ́немъ лоука́выхъ ѡ҆дръ- жа́ша мѧ̀ . И҆скопа́ша рꙋ́цѣ моѝ , и҆ но́ѕѣ моѝ , и҆счето́ша всѧ̑ кѡ́сти т е҃
units.english_text: Depart not from Me, for affliction is near; for there is none to help Me.[^924] Many bullocks have compassed Me; fat bulls have beset Me round. They have opened their mouth against Me, as a ravening and a roaring lion. I am poured out like water, and all My bones are scattered.[^925] My heart is become like wax, melting in the midst of My belly. My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and My tongue cleaves to My throat; and Thou hast brought Me down into the dust of death. For many dogs have compassed Me; the assembly of the wicked hath beset Me round.[^926] They have pierced My hands and My feet; they have numbered all My bones.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 157 правило мо тииже смотреша
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 157v] *пра́вило :* моꙗ̀ . Ті́иже смотрѣ́ша и҆ пре́зрѣ- ша мѧ̀ . Раздѣли́ша ри́зы моꙗ̑ себѣ̀ , и҆ ѡ҆ мати́змѣ мое́й мета́ша жрѣ́бїа . Ты́же Г҃и не оу҆да́ли по́мощь твою̀ ѿ менѐ , на застоупле́нїе моѐ въньмѝ . И҆зба́ви ѿ ѻ҆рꙋ́жїа дш҃ю мою̀ , и҆ и҆з рꙋкѝ пе́сїа є҆диноро́дную мою̀ . Сп҃си́ мѧ ѿ оу҆́стъ льво́въ , и҆ ѿ рѡ́гъ є҆диноро́ждь смѣре́нїе моѐ . Повѣ́мъ и҆́мѧ твоѐ бра́тїи мое́й , по сре́дѣ цр҃кве въспою́ тѧ . Боѧ́щїи- сѧ Г҃а въсхвали́те и҆̀ . Всѐ сѣ́мѧ і҆а́ко- вле просла́вите и҆̀ . Да оу҆бои́т же сѧ ѿ него всѐ сѣ́мѧ і҆и҃лево . Ꙗ҆́ко не оу҆ничижѝ , ни негодова̀ мл҃твы ни́щаго . Ни ѡ҆врати́лъ же є҆́стъ

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 158r] *причаще́нїа* лица̀ своє́го ѿ менѐ . И҆ є҆гда̀ възъзва́[хъ] къ немоу , оу҆слы́ша мѧ̀ . Ѡ҆ тебѣ̀ похва́ла моꙗ̀ . Въ цр҃кви вели́цѣ и҆- сповѣ́мсѧ тебѣ̀ . Мл҃твы моꙗ̑ възда́мъ предъ боꙗ́щимисѧ є҆го̀ . Ꙗ҆дѧ́тъ ни́щїи и҆ насы́тѧтсѧ, и҆ въ- схва́лѧтъ Г҃а възыска́ющїи є҆го̀ . Жи́ва бꙋ́доутъ срⷣца и҆́хъ въ вѣ́кы вѣ́ка . Помѧноу́тсѧ и҆ ѡ҆братѧ́т- сѧ къ Г҃оу вси́ кѡ́нци землѧ̀ . И҆ по- кло́нѧтсѧ пре́днимъ всѧ̑ ѿч҃ьствїа ꙗ҆зы́къ . Ꙗ҆́ко Гн҃е є҆́стъ црⷭ҇твїе , и҆ тъ́и ѡ҆блада́етъ ꙗ҆зы́кы . units.english_text: The Lord is my shepherd, and nothing shall be lacking unto me.[^935] In a place of green pasture, there hath He made me to dwell; by the water of rest hath He nourished me. He hath converted my soul; He hath guided me into the paths of righteousness for His name's sake. For though I should walk through the midst of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff, they have comforted me.[^936] Thou hast prepared a table before me against them that afflict me.[^937] Thou hast anointed my head with oil, and Thy cup which inebriates me, how excellent it is! And Thy mercy shall pursue me all the days of my life, and that I may dwell in the house of the Lord unto length of days.

units.english_text: The earth is the Lord's, and the fullness thereof; the world, and all that dwell therein.[^939] He hath founded it upon the seas, and prepared it upon the rivers. Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord, or who shall stand in His holy place? He that is innocent in hands and pure in heart; who hath not received his soul in vain, nor sworn deceitfully unto his neighbor. He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Savior.[^940] This is the generation of them that seek the Lord, that seek the face of the God of Jacob. Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting gates; and the King of glory shall enter in.[^941] Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. Lift up your gates, O ye princes, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting gates; and the King of glory shall enter in. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of glory.

Възми́- те врата̀ кнѧ́зи ва́ша, и҆ възми́те- сѧ вра́та вѣ́чнаѧ . И҆ въни́детъ цр҃ь сла́вы . Кто̀ є҆́стъ съ́и цр҃ь сла́вы ; Г҃ь крѣ́покъ и҆ си́ленъ , Г҃ь си́ленъ въ бра́ни . Възми́те вра́та кнѧ́зи ва́ша , и҆ възми́тесѧ вра́та вѣ́ч- наѧ . И҆ въни́детъ цр҃ь сла́вы . Чⷭ҇тна пред̾ Г҃мъ смр҃ть прпⷣбныхъ є҆го . Ѡ҆ Г҃и а҆́зъ ра́бъ тво́и , а҆́зъ ра́бъ тво́и и҆ сн҃ъ рабы̀ твоє́ѧ . Растръ́за ꙗ҆́зы моꙗ̑ . Тебѣ̀ пожроу̀ жръ́твоу хвалѣ̀ , и҆ и҆́мѧ Гн҃е призовоу̀ . Мл҃твы моꙗ̑ Г҃ви въздамъ прѣⷣ всѣ́ми людьмѝ є҆го . Въ дво́рѣхъ до́моу Гн҃ѧ , по- сре́дѣ тебе і҆ерл҃име :~ *Сла́ . И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *А҆ллилоу́їа . г҃ . И҆ тропарѧ̑ сїа . Гл҃ . и҃ .* *Б*езако́нїа моꙗ̀ пре́зри Г҃и , и҆́же ѿ дв҃ы рожде́исѧ . И҆ срⷣце моѐ ѡ҆чи́сти цр҃ковь то тво́рѧ прчⷭ҇тому твоє́моу

units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 160v] *пра́вило :* тѣ́лоу и҆ кро́ви . Ниже ѿри́неши менѐ ѿ твое́го лица̀ , и҆́же без̾ числа̀ имѣ́ѧй ве́лїю мл҃ть :~ *Сла́ва .* *В*ъ прича́стїи ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ , ка́ко дръзноу̀ ѻ҆каѧ́нныи . А҆́ще бо дръзноу̀ к тебѣ̀ съ досто́йными пристоупи́- ти , ѻ҆де́жда мѧ ѡ҆блича́етъ ꙗ҆́ко нѣ́сть бра́чна . И҆ ѡ҆соужде́нїе и҆схо- дата́йствоую мнѡ́го грѣ́шной дш҃и мое́и . Ѡ҆чи́сти Г҃и сквръ́ноу дш҃ѧ мое́ѧ, и҆ сп҃си́ мѧ ꙗ҆́ко чл҃колю́бецъ :~ *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *М*нѡ́гаѧ премнѡ́жества мои́хъ Бц҃е съгрѣше́нїи . К тебѣ̀ прибѣго́хъ прчⷭ҇таѧ сп҃се́нїа тре́боуѧ . Посѣтѝ недоу́гоуꙋ́щую мою дш҃ю . И҆ молѝ сн҃а своє́го и҆ Б҃а на́шего , пода́ти ми

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 161 причащениа оставление ихъже съделах зле
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 161r] *причаще́нїа* ѡ҆ставле́нїе , и҆́хъже съдѣ́лахъ ѕлѣ̀ є҆ди́на бл҃гве́наѧ . *Та́же ѱало́мъ н҃ .* *Поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ Б҃е . Кано́нъ причаще́-* *нїю . Гла́ в҃ . Пѣ́снь а҆ . І҆рмо́съ .* Грѧдѣ́те лю́дїе . *сті́хъ .* Срⷣце чⷭ҇то съзи́жди въ мнѣ̀ Б҃е . И҆ дх҃ъ пра́въ ѡ҆бновѝ въ оу҆тро́бѣ мое́й . *Х*лѣ́бъ живота̀ вѣчноу́ющаго , да бꙋ́детъ ми тѣ́ло твоѐ ст҃ое бл҃гооу҆тро́- бне Г҃и , и҆ чⷭ҇тнаѧ кро́вь . И҆ болѣ́знемъ мнѡгоѡ҆́бразным и҆сцѣле́нїе :~ *сті́ :* Не ѡ҆връ́зи менѐ ѿ лица̀ твое́го , и҆ дх҃а ст҃го твое́го не ѿимѝ ѿ менѐ :~ *К*ро́вь твою̀ вл҃ко прчⷭ҇тоую , и҆ тѣ́ло твоѐ прⷭ҇тое , менѐ сподо́би не досто́и- наго . Прїѧ́ти ꙗ҆́сти съ жела́нїемъ . т

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: 161 правило и верою испити
units.slavonic_text: [Fol. 161v] *пра́вило :* и҆ вѣ́рою и҆спи́ти :~ *Сла́ва .* *Ѡ҆*сквръ́ненъ дѣ́лы без̾мѣ́стными ѻ҆каѧ́нный . Твое́го прчⷭ҇таго тѣ́ла и҆ Бж҃тве́ныѧ кро́ве , недосто́инъ сы́и Х҃е причаще́нїа . Є҆го́же мѧ̀ сподо́би :~ *И҆ нн҃ѣ .* *Б*л҃гаа бл҃гве́наа невѣ́сто, ꙗ҆́же кла́съ въздрасти́вшїа не ѡ҆ра́нный , и҆ сп҃си́- телный мироу . Сподо́би мѧ̀ сеѝ ꙗ҆доу́ща сп҃тисѧ :~ *Пѣ́снь г҃ . І҆рмо́ :* *На ка́мени мѧ̀ вѣ́ры оу҆твръдѝ .* *Сті́ :* Срⷣце чⷭ҇то съзи́жди въ мнѣ̀ Б҃е . и҆ д: *С*ле́зныѧ ми пода́ждь Х҃е ка́плѧ , сквръ́ноу срⷣчноую ѡ҆чища́ющѧ . ꙗ҆́ко да бл҃го́ю съвѣ́стїю ѡ҆чище́нъ, вѣ́рою прихождоу̀ и҆ стра́хомъ вл҃ко къ

units.slavonic_text: съ стра́хомъ въкꙋси́ти сегѡ̀, и҆ жи́воу бы́ти :~ Сѣда́лна . гла́съ в҃ . Огнь и҆ свѣ́тъ боу́ди ми сп҃се, прїѧ́- тїе прчⷭ҇тыхъ и҆ животворѧ́щихъ твои́хъ та́инъ . пожига́ѧ грѣхо́в- ныи пле́велъ . и҆ просвѣща́ѧ всего̀ къ и҆сти́нномꙋ Бг҃осло́вїю . не и҆зда́- во сты́нѧ вра́жїи лю́ти преда́вшисѧ, ни тебѣ̀ да́мъ цѣлова́нїа ле́стна . но ꙗ҆́ко блꙋ́дница припада́ю ти . и҆ ꙗ҆́ко разбо́иникъ и҆сповѣ́доуѧсѧ въпїю́ ти . помани́ мѧ Г҃и є҆гда̀ прїи́деши въ црⷭ҇твїи сѝ : Пѣ́снь д҃ . І҆рмо́съ . Пришетвова́въ ѿ дв҃ы . ст҃і : Срⷣце чⷭ҇то съзи́жди въ мнѣ̀ Б҃е . Въсхотѣ́лъ є҆сѝ на́съ ра́ди въпло́щсѧ
units.english_text: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 2:* May the reception of Thine all-pure and life-creating Mysteries be fire and light unto me, O Savior, consuming the tares of sins, and enlightening all of me unto true theology; not betraying the Holy Things to enemies in fierce surrender, nor will I give Thee a deceitful kiss; but like the harlot I fall down before Thee, and like the thief confessing I cry unto Thee: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest into Thy kingdom.[^975]

И҆́же свѣ́та пода́телю . ст҃і : Срⷣце чⷭ҇то съзи́жи въ мнѣ̀ Б҃е . и҆ дх҃ : Ꙗ҆́коже прере́клъ є҆сѝ Х҃е , да бꙋ́детъ оу҆́бо хоудо́моу ра́боу твоемоу̀ . и҆ въ мнѣ̀ пребꙋ́ди ꙗ҆́коже ѡ҆бѣща́сѧ . се́ бо тѣ́ло твоѐ ꙗ҆́мъ Бж҃тве́ное, и҆ пїю̀ кро́вь твою̀ :~ ст҃ : Не ѡ҆́връзи менѐ . Сло́ве Бж҃їи и҆ Б҃е , оу҆́гль да бꙋ́детъ ми тѣ́ло твоѐ Бж҃тве́ное , въ про- свѣще́нїе помраче́нномоу . и҆ ѡ҆чи- ще́нїе ѡ҆сквръне́нѣи д҃ши мое́и кро́вь твоѧ̀ :~ Сла́ва . Преѡ҆сквръне́ноу д҃шїю , и҆ оу҆стнѣ̀ и҆- мы́и нечи́сты , нн҃ѣ несмѣ́ю к тебѣ̀

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ради стых хе таи твоих слава
units.slavonic_text: ра́ди ст҃ы́хъ Х҃е та́и твои́хъ :~ Сла́ва . Съ стра́хомъ и҆ тре́петомъ пристꙋ́пимъ всѝ , и҆ ст҃о́е тѣ́ло Хв҃о прїиме́мъ . и҆ ст҃ꙋ́ю и҆ чⷭ҇тноу́ю кро́вь :~ И҆ нн҃ѣ . Бж҃їе Б҃ъ сло́во ст҃о́е, всего́ мѧ ѡ҆ст҃и нн҃ѣ , приходѧ́щаго къ Бж҃тве́ным та́инамъ твои́мъ , ст҃ы́ѧ мт҃ре твое́ѧ мольба́ми : Ко́н . гла́ в҃ . по́ : Вы́шнихъ и҆ща̀ . Хлѣ́бъ Х҃е въꙁѧ́ти да мѧ̀ непре́зриши , тѣ́ло твоѐ , и҆ Бж҃тве́ноу́ю твою̀ кро́вь . прчⷭ҇- тыхъ вл҃ко и҆ гро́зныхъ твои́хъ та́инъ причасти́тисѧ ѻ҆каѧ́нныи да не бꙋ́детъ ми ѻ҆каѧ́нномоу въ соу́дъ . да бꙋ́де же ми въ живо́тъ вѣ́чный, и҆ бесмр҃тный :~ Пѣ́снь з҃ .

Бж҃їе Б҃ъ сло́во ст҃о́е, всего́ мѧ ѡ҆ст҃и нн҃ѣ , приходѧ́щаго къ Бж҃тве́ным та́инамъ твои́мъ , ст҃ы́ѧ мт҃ре твое́ѧ мольба́ми : Ко́н . гла́ в҃ . по́ : Вы́шнихъ и҆ща̀ . Хлѣ́бъ Х҃е въꙁѧ́ти да мѧ̀ непре́зриши , тѣ́ло твоѐ , и҆ Бж҃тве́ноу́ю твою̀ кро́вь . прчⷭ҇- тыхъ вл҃ко и҆ гро́зныхъ твои́хъ та́инъ причасти́тисѧ ѻ҆каѧ́нныи да не бꙋ́детъ ми ѻ҆каѧ́нномоу въ соу́дъ . да бꙋ́де же ми въ живо́тъ вѣ́чный, и҆ бесмр҃тный :~ Пѣ́снь з҃ .

units.english_text: *Kontakion, Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Вы́шнихъ и҆ща̀):* Despise me not, O Christ, as I take the Bread, which is Thy Body, and Thy divine Blood, and partake, wretched as I am, of Thine all-pure and dread Mysteries, O Master; let it not be unto me, wretched though I am, for judgment, but let it be unto me for life eternal and immortal.[^1007]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: ирмос образоу златому сти срце
units.slavonic_text: І҆рмо́съ . О҆́бразоу злато́мꙋ . ст҃і : Срⷣце чⷭ҇то съзи́жи въ мнѣ̀ Б҃е . и҆ дх҃ : И҆сто́чникъ бл҃гы́хъ , прича́стїе Х҃е бесмр҃тныхъ нн҃ѣ та́инъ , да бꙋ́дет ми свѣ́тъ, и҆ живо́т, и҆ беспⷭ҇рт́їе . и҆ къ добродѣ́тели Бж҃твенѣ́ишеи пре- спѣва́нїю . и҆ къ оу҆множе́нїю хо- дата́йственно , є҆ди́не бл҃же ꙗ҆́ко да̀ славлю тѧ̀ : ст҃ : Не ѡ҆́връзи менѐ ѡ҆ . И҆зба́вльсѧ ѿ ст҃рте́и , и҆ врагѡ́въ, и҆ ноу́жды , и҆ всѧ́коѧ скръби . съ тре́петомъ и҆ любо́вїю пристꙋпа́юще- моу нн҃ѣ , съ бл҃гоговѣ́нїемъ чл҃ко- лю́бче , къ твои́мъ бесмр҃тнымъ и҆ Бж҃твены та́йнамъ . и҆ пѣ́ти тебѣ̀ . бл҃венъ є҆сѝ Б҃е ѻ҆т҃цъ на́шихъ :~ Сла́ .

units.slavonic_incipit: Д҃ше моѧ̀ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, д҃ше стра́стнаѧ оу҆жасни́сѧ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: дше моя каянная дше страстная оужаснися зрящи таинъства
units.slavonic_text: Д҃ше моѧ̀ ѻ҆каѧ́ннаѧ, д҃ше стра́стнаѧ оу҆жасни́сѧ зрѧ́щи та́инъства пре- сла́внаа . въздыха́ющи прослези́- сѧ , въ пе́рси бїю́щи и҆ гл҃ющи . Б҃е ѡ҆цѣ́ти мѧ̀ ꙗ҆́коже блꙋ́днаго :~ И҆ нн҃ѣ . И҆́же сп҃са Х҃а поро́ждъшїа па́че оу҆́ма Бг҃обл҃гтнаѧ . оу҆моля́ю тѧ̀ нн҃ѣ ра́бъ твои́, чⷭ҇тꙋю нечи́стый . хотя́- щаго мѧ̀ нн҃ѣ къ прчⷭ҇тымъ та́инам пристоупа́ти, ѡ҆чи́сти мѧ̀ всего̀ ѿ сквръ́ны пло́ти и҆ доу́ха :~ Пѣ́с̑ и҃ . І҆рмо́съ . И҆́же въ пе́щь ѻ҆́гненꙋ . ст҃і : Срⷣце чи́сто съзи́жди въ мнѣ̀ Б҃е . и҆ : Нб҃ныхъ и҆ стра́шны ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ Х҃е нн҃ѣ та́инъ . Бж҃твеныѧ же твое́ѧ , и҆ та́инныѧ ве́черѧ ѻ҆́бщника

units.english_text: When the glorious disciples at the washing of the supper were illuminated, then was Judas the ungodly, diseased with the love of silver, darkened; and unto lawless judges he betrayed Thee, the righteous Judge.[^1038] Behold, O lover of possessions, him who on account of them acquired insatiability, and gave himself unto hanging![^1039] Flee, O insatiable soul, that dared such things against the Teacher! O Lord Who art good towards all, glory unto Thee!

units.slavonic_incipit: Вл҃ко Г҃и І҆с҃у Х҃е Бж҃е на́шъ,
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: влко ги ису хе бже наш цр цртвоу
units.slavonic_text: Вл҃ко Г҃и І҆с҃у Х҃е Бж҃е на́шъ, цр҃ь цр҃твоу́- ющимъ, и҆ Г҃ь гдⷵтвоу́ющимъ . исто́чниче жи́зни и҆ безсмръ́тїа . и҆́же всеѧ̀ тва́ри ви́димыѧ и҆ не ви́димыѧ съдѣ́тель . и҆́же безна- ча́лнаго Ѽц҃а̀ съприсносоу́щныи сн҃ъ и҆ събезнача́лныи . и҆́же премно́гыѧ ра́ди бл҃готи въ послѣ́днаѧ дни̑ въ пло́ть ѡ҆блъ́кысѧ . и҆ распѧ́тсѧ, и҆ погребе́сѧ за́ ны небл҃года́рныѧ и҆ знонра́вныѧ . и҆ свое́ю кро́вїю ѡ҆б- нови́въ растлѣ́вшее грѣхо́мъ є҆стество̀ на́ше . са́мъ безсмр҃тныи цр҃ю вл҃ко чл҃колю́бче, прїимѝ моѐ грѣ́шное покаѧ́нїе . приклони ѹ҆́хо твоѐ къ мнѣ̀, и҆ оу҆слы́ши глаго́лы моѧ̀ .
units.english_text: O Master, Lord Jesus Christ our God, King of them that reign, and Lord of them that rule;[^1041] Fountain of life and immortality; Maker of all creation, visible and invisible; co-eternal and co-unoriginate Son of the unoriginate Father; Who for Thine exceeding goodness in the last days didst clothe Thyself in flesh, and wast crucified, and buried for us ungrateful and perverse ones,[^1042] and by Thine own Blood didst renew our nature corrupted by sin: Thyself, O immortal King, Master, Lover of mankind, accept my sinful repentance; incline Thine ear unto me, and hear my words.[^1043]

But Thou, O Lord, being forgiving, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy, hast not given me over to perish with mine iniquities, awaiting my conversion by every means. Amen.[^1052]

units.english_text: O Master, Lord our God, only-begotten Son and Word of the living and immortal Father, Who didst give Thyself as a sacrifice for us, for whose sake Thou didst become man, that Thou mightest show us conformed unto Thine image, and unite us unto Thyself by communion of Thy life-creating Mysteries:[^1054] I will extol Thee, for Thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me; but Thou hast brought up my soul from hades, and hast saved me from them that go down into the pit.[^1055] And now incline Thine ear unto me, and hear my words, and make me, unworthy though I am, a partaker, even as of Thine image, so also of Thy most pure Flesh and of Thy very precious Blood: for the remission of sins, for the forgiveness of transgressions, for communion of the Holy Spirit;[^1056] overlooking for me, for the riches of Thy goodness, all sins voluntary and involuntary, both those committed with my knowledge and those in ignorance. For though I am unworthy of heaven and of earth, yet I am Thy creature, and the work of Thine all-pure hands, even if by transgression of Thy commandments I have corrupted Thine image. Overlook my sins, O Thou Who alone takest away the sins of the world, and art the sinless Lord; for against Thee only have I sinned, and before Thee do I fall down, my good God.[^1057]

units.english_text: Even though by my evil deeds I continually provoke Thee to anger, abhor me not who am unclean in heart, defiled in lips, passionate in soul; but trusting in Thy mercy and drawing near, receive me as the harlot, and as the thief, and as the publican; and forgive me the multitude of my many evil deeds, as having authority to remit sins unto them that sin, for the sake of the communion of Thine all-pure Mysteries.[^1058] And as the coal of Thy holy Body burns up the passionate motions of the soul, cleanse my heart, as once the lips of Thy prophet, for the sake of Thine awesome[^1059] seraph:[^1060] enlighten also my thoughts with the light of Thy gladness, and fill me wholly with holiness, for Thou art holy by nature. And by communion of Thy Blood, fill my heart with gladness, and my mind with Thy rejoicing. Mortify all my bodily members through communion of Thy holy Mysteries; and free [me] from every carnal desire by the descent of Thy Holy Spirit.[^1061] Yea, O God, Who comest and makest Thine abode with the Father and with Thy Holy Spirit in all Thy saints;[^1062] Who hast deigned to be received by me, a sinner and unworthy one, in the bloodless sacrifice offered unto Thee, for the sake of Thine immeasurable goodness: do Thou abide in me acceptably[^1063] and inseparably unto the end of my life; and be Thou unto me an addition of life, against the destroyer; a light unto the revelation of Thy hidden mysteries; a guide unto the path of Thy commandments; unto the Heavenly Kingdom, unto eternal gladness; unto the fulfillment of wisdom; unto the completion of the word; unto the contemplation of Thy sayings; a revealer of mysteries of divine and noble things; strength against warring spirits; and the supreme quencher of every desire in me.[^1064] Yea, O God consubstantial with the Father, and Word of God unto us: be Thou all things unto me, Thy servant; and for the sake of the communion of Thy divine Gifts, unite Thyself unto me in one spirit, according to the prayer unto Thy Father and God on behalf of us unworthy ones:[^1065] for I am flesh of Thy flesh, and bearing Thee from divine Baptism,[^1066] even if I have defiled Thy garment.[^1067] For Thou art He that said: *He that eats My Flesh, and drinks My Blood, dwells in Me, and I in him.*[^1068] And Thine is the glory unto ages of ages. Amen.

units.slavonic_text: ми свое́моу ра́боу • и҆ Бж҃твеныхъ ра́ди твои́хъ даро́въ причаще́нїа, съедини́сѧ мнѣ̀ въ є҆ди́нъ дх҃ъ • по и҆́же ѿц҃ꙋ твое́моу и҆ Бг҃ꙋ, на́съ ра́ди недосто́иныхъ моле́нїю • ꙗ҆́ко плот[ь] ѿ пло́тїи твои́хъ є҆смь • и҆ тебѐ носѧ́- имь ѿ Бж҃твенаго кр҃ще́нїа • а҆́ще и҆ ѻ҆де́ждꙋ тебѐ ѻ҆сквръни́хъ • ты бо є҆си рекі́й • ꙗ҆ды́й мою̀ пло́ть, и҆ пїѧ́й мою̀ кро́вь, и҆ а҆́зъ въ не́мъ пре- быва́ю, и҆ то́й въ мнѣ̀ • и҆ твоа̀ є҆́стъ сла́ва въ вѣ́кы вѣ́кѡмъ, а҆ми́нь :~ ТОГО́ЖЕ ВАСИ́ЛЇА ВЕЛИ́КАГО МЛ҃ТВА • къ ст҃о́му причаще́нїю • Вл҃ко ст҃ы́и прч҃тыи, несквръ́- ныи • и҆́же не оу҆недосто́ивы[й]
units.english_text: O holy, all-pure, undefiled Master, Who through Thy great mercy didst not disdain to receive without sin and without defilement our nature, which had become subject to passions through sin; and having cleansed it with Thy holy Blood, poured out for the sake of our salvation, the creation of Thy holy hands;[^1070] Who didst accomplish Thine ineffable dispensation, not for the sake of them that have not sinned against Thee, nor of them that have been well-pleasing unto Thee, but for the sake of them that provoked Thee to anger and turned away:[^1071] Who art the hope of salvation unto them that for their sins have despaired of all hope;[^1072] for Thou Thyself, O good One, hast said: *They that are whole need not a physician, but they that are sick;*[^1073] and: *Thou camest not to save them that are saved, but the lost.*[^1074] Do Thou therefore, O compassionate One, receive in Thy tender mercy also me, unworthy though I am, who trust in Thy compassions, and have dared to draw near unto Thy most pure Body and Blood; and endure to accept my unworthiness as a partaker of Thy dread Mysteries;[^1075] and abhor me not, neither be wroth, nor set me forth as guilty; seeing that I am sinful and unclean, and draw near unworthily.[^1076] But, O gracious Lord,[^1077] Who hast given unto us sinners Thy Body and Blood for the remission of sins: grant unto me, through the communion thereof, of Thine indwelling in me, Thine unprofitable servant, and of my abiding in Thee, my good Master and Savior. And make the communion of these things to be unto me for the lightening of the unspeakable burdens of mine iniquities, for deliverance from guilt, for the cleansing of soul and body;[^1078] for on behalf of sinners, condemned and without defense, hast Thou poured out Thy divine and life-flowing Blood by Thy great mercy:[^1079] which vouchsafe me to drink without condemnation, and to eat Thy life-creating Body. And let not communion be unto me for judgment, who eat and drink unworthily, O Lover of mankind, nor unto a heavier reckoning, instead of obtaining remission of my evil deeds.[^1080] For Thou knowest, Who knowest all things, that not presumptuously, nor as one uncondemned, or as being worthy, do I draw near with boldness; but with fear and trembling,[^1081] with quaking of heart, and of the bones and very marrow;[^1082] for I know myself self-condemned, and unworthy even to look with mine eyes upon Thy dread table.[^1083] Yet because of that whereby Thou hast shown unto sinners Thine ineffable mercy, through the fraction of Thy holy Body and the pouring out of Thy precious Blood: I desire to be nourished with Thy soul-nourishing food, O Christ our God; and I cast myself daringly into the abyss of Thy mercy.[^1084] Gazing upon Thy worshipful and incorruptible Mysteries, which Thou didst receive in Thy love for mankind for the remission of our sins, I am held by fear and joy: by the one indeed because of mine unworthiness, and by the other because of the hope of forgiveness for my sins.[^1085] Behold therefore, O Lord, my lowliness;[^1086] and grant me without guilt and without condemnation to receive Thy divine and deifying Mysteries: for cleansing, for salvation, for remission of my sins; for fleeing the punishment to come, and for obtaining glory; and for the reception of the things prepared for them that love Thee, and that live and abide in Thee:[^1087] by the intercession of Thine all-glorified and all-pure Mother, and of all the saints. Amen.

units.english_text: Lord, I know that I am not worthy, nor sufficient, that Thou shouldest enter under the roof of the house of my soul, because it is all deserted and fallen;[^1089] and Thou hast not in me a worthy place where to lay Thy head.[^1090] But even as from the height Thou didst humble Thyself for our sake, so humble Thyself now also unto my lowliness.[^1091] And as Thou didst deign to lie in a cave and in a manger of brute beasts,[^1092] so receive [me], and enter into the manger of my unreasoning soul, and into my defiled body.[^1093] And even as Thou didst not disdain to enter and sup with sinners in the house of Simon the leper,[^1094] so deign to enter also into the temple of my humble soul, leprous and sinful.[^1095] And as Thou didst not thrust away the sinful harlot like unto me, who came and touched Thee,[^1096] so have compassion also upon me, a sinner, who come and touch Thee; and even as Thou didst not abhor her defiled and unclean lips that kissed Thee,[^1097] so also of mine lips, abhor not [lips] even more defiled and more unclean than hers;[^1098] nor my darkened and unclean and polluted lips, and my unclean tongue. But may the coal of Thy most pure Body, and of Thy precious Blood, be unto me for sanctification, and enlightenment, and health unto my humble soul and body;[^1099] for lightening the weight of my many transgressions; for preservation from all diabolical operations; for the overcoming and restraint of my evil and wicked habits; for the mortification of passions; for the keeping of Thy commandments; for the addition of Thy divine[^1100] grace, and adoption into Thy Kingdom. For not as one who despises do I draw near unto Thee, O Christ God, but as trusting in Thine ineffable goodness: that I be not, through being long removed from Thy communion, devoured by the noetic wolf.[^1101] Therefore I entreat Thee, as Thou alone art holy Master: sanctify my soul and body, mind and heart, reins and inward parts; and renew me wholly, and root Thy fear in my members; and make Thy sanctification irremovable from me.[^1102] And be Thou unto me a helper and protector, steering my life in peace, and vouchsafing me to stand at Thy right hand,[^1103] by the prayers and supplication of Thine all-pure Mother, and of Thy bodiless ministers and most pure powers, and of all the saints who from the ages have been well-pleasing unto Thee. Amen.[^1104]

units.english_text: O Master, Lover of mankind, Lord Jesus Christ my God: trusting in Thy compassions, I entreat Thee, that Thou place me not on Thy left hand with the goats that have provoked Thee to anger;[^1106] neither say unto me: *Amen, I say unto thee, I know thee not.*[^1107] But grant me according to Thy goodness weeping ever, and compunction, and humility unto my heart; and cleanse it with Thy fear; and[^1108] through communion of Thy most pure and life-creating Mysteries, that it may be a temple of Thy goodness.[^1109] For I am exceedingly sinful and unworthy, yet ever do I knock at Thy doors; even if I am despondent and slothful, and negligent concerning my salvation, yet nevertheless I walk in Thy path.[^1110] Save me for the sake of Thy mercy: for Thou art blessed, O Lord, by all things; Thy compassions are upon all Thy works; and Thine is the dominion unto the ages. units.slavonic_text: Бж҃е ѻ҆сла́би ѡ҆ста́ви , оу҆щедрѝ . прости́ ми съгрѣше́нїа моѧ̀ , е҆ли́- ка ти съгрѣши́хъ • и҆ли сло́вом[ъ] и҆ли дѣ́ло[мъ], и҆ли помышле́нїемъ • во́лею , и҆ли нево́лею • ра́зоумомъ, и҆ли неразоу́мїимъ • всѧ̂ ми простѝ ꙗ҆́ко бл҃гъ и҆ чл҃колю́бе[цъ] • мл҃твами прчⷭ҇тыѧ ти мт҃ре • оу҆́мныхъ ти слꙋ- жи́телей , и҆ ст҃ы́хъ си́лъ • и҆ всѣ́хъ ст҃ы[хъ] и҆́же ѿ вѣ́ка тебѣ̀ бл҃гооу҆годи́вши[хъ] • неѡ҆сꙋжде́нно бл҃говолѝ прїѧти ми ст҃о́е и҆ прчⷭ҇тое ти тѣ́ло и҆ чⷭ҇тноу́ю кро́[вь] въ и҆цѣле́нїе дш҃и же, и҆ тѣ́лꙋ, и҆ въ ѡ҆чище́нїе лꙋка́вы ми помышле́нїи • ꙗ҆́ко твое́ е҆́стъ цр҃тво и҆ си́ла и҆ сла́ва ѻ҆ц҃а и҆ сн҃а и҆ ст҃го дх҃а • нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но :~
units.english_text: O God, remit, pardon, have compassion, forgive me my transgressions, whereinsoever I have sinned against Thee: whether by word, or deed, or thought; willingly, or unwillingly; in knowledge, or in ignorance: forgive me all things, as Thou art good and the Lover of mankind;[^1126] by the prayers of Thine all-pure Mother, of Thy noetic ministers and holy powers, and of all the saints who from the ages have been well-pleasing unto Thee.[^1127] Vouchsafe me without condemnation to receive Thy holy and most pure Body and precious Blood, unto the healing of both soul and body, and unto the cleansing of my wicked thoughts.[^1128] For Thine is the Kingdom, and the power, and the glory, of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^1129]

units.slavonic_text: того́же ст҃го і҆ѡа́нна златооу́стаго мл҃тва , къ ст҃омоу причаще́нїю • Вѣ́рꙋю Г҃и и҆ и҆сповѣ́доую , ꙗ҆́ко ты е҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇ъ сн҃ъ Бг҃а жива́го , прише́дый въ ми́ръ грѣ́шникы сп҃ти , ѿ ни́х- же пръ́вый е҆смь а҆́зъ • вѣ́роую ꙗ҆́ко въи́стинноу се е҆́стъ са́мое прчⷭ҇тое тѣ́ло твоѐ , и҆ се е҆́стъ са́маѧ чⷭ҇тнаѧ кро́вь твоѧ̀ • е҆го́же ра́ди молю́ ти сѧ , поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ и҆ прости́ ми • и҆ ѡ҆слабѝ ми прегрѣше́нїа моѧ̀ во́лнаѧ и҆ нево́лнаѧ • ꙗ҆́же сло́вомъ , и҆ли дѣ́ломъ • ꙗ҆́же вѣ́дѣнїемъ и҆ли невѣ́дѣнїемъ • ꙗ҆́же ра́зоумомъ, и҆ мы́слїю • и҆ сподо́би мѧ̀ неѡ҆сꙋжде́нно причасти́тисѧ прчⷭ҇ты ти та́инствъ •
units.english_text: I believe, O Lord, and I confess, that Thou art truly the Christ, the Son of the living God, Who camest into the world to save sinners, of whom I am first.[^1131] I believe also that this is truly Thine own most pure Body, and this is truly Thine own precious Blood.[^1132] Therefore I pray Thee: have mercy upon me and forgive me, and pardon my transgressions, voluntary and involuntary, whether in word or deed, whether in knowledge or ignorance, whether in mind or thought; and vouchsafe me without condemnation to partake of Thy most pure Mysteries,[^1133] unto the remission of sins, and unto life everlasting. For blessed art Thou unto the ages. Amen.[^1134]

units.slavonic_text: Ѧ́ко на стра́шнѣмъ и҆ нелицемѣ́- рнѣмъ твое́[мъ] прѣсто́лѣ сꙗ́дищи Х҃е Б҃е • Ѻ҆соужде́нїю пови́ненъ, и҆ и҆стѧза́нїа и҆мы́й • и҆ сло́во творѧ̀ мои́хъ содѣ́ланныхъ зѡ́лъ • си́це дне́ прежде да́же непрїити́ дневи ѻ҆соужде́нїа моего́ • прѣстою́ предъ тобо́ю, и҆ предъ стра́шными ст҃ы́ми а҆́гг҃лы твои́ми • прекло́ненъ свое́ю сѡвѣ́стїю, преносѧ̀ лꙋка́ваꙗ и҆ сквр́ь- наꙗ, и҆ безако́ннаꙗ моꙗ̀ дѣ́анїа • позо́рствоуꙗ сїꙗ, и҆ ѡ҆блича́ꙗ оу҆ни- чижа́ю • ви́ждь оу҆́бо Г҃и смире́нїе моѐ, и҆ ѡ҆ста́ви всꙗ̑ согрѣше́нїа моꙗ̀ • ви́ждь ꙗ́ко оу҆мно́жишасѧ па́че вла́[съ] главы моеѧ̀ безако́нїа моꙗ̑ •
units.english_text: As sitting upon Thy dread and unbribable throne, O Christ God, guilty of condemnation and subject to examination, and giving an account of the evils wrought by me:[^1138] even so today, before the day of my condemnation is come, I stand before Thee, and before Thy dread and holy angels, bowed down by my conscience, bringing forward my evil, polluted, and lawless deeds;[^1139] exposing and reproving them, I humble myself. Look therefore, O Lord, upon my humility, and remit all my transgressions; look, for my iniquities are multiplied more than the hairs of my head.[^1140]

units.english_text: What evil therefore have I not committed? What transgression have I not wrought? What evil have I not imagined in my soul? Nay, already in deeds also have I committed them:[^1141] fornication, adultery, sodomy, presumption, pride, reproach, debauchery,[^1142] insolence, disobedience, slander, falsehood, evil-speaking, belittling, perjury, calumny, swearing of oaths, blasphemy, idle talking, inflamed passion, mockery, drunkenness, gluttony, belly-madness, hatred, envy, love of money, avarice, usury, vainglory, covetousness of possessions, self-love, extortion, unrighteousness, filthy lucre,[^1143] greed of gain, jealousy, defaming, lawlessness, disobedience, polluted thoughts, and unclean and enervated imaginings, blasphemous also and unspeakable; all my senses and every member have I defiled, corrupted, mired in filth, and made unprofitable;[^1144] I have become in every way a worker for the devil. I know, O Lord, that mine iniquities are gone over my head;[^1145] but measureless is the multitude of Thy compassions, and ineffable the mercy of Thine ungrudging goodness, and there is no sin that can overcome Thy love for mankind.[^1146] Therefore, O most marvelous King, unresentful Lord: make marvelous Thy mercies upon me also, a sinner;[^1147] show forth the power of Thy goodness, and manifest the strength of the tender-hearted compassion of Thy mercy, and receive me, a sinner returning to Thee. Receive me, even as Thou didst receive the prodigal, the publican, the thief, Manasseh, and the harlot;[^1148] receive me who have transgressed beyond measure, in word, and in deed, and in thought, and by improper lust, and by unreasoning desire; and even as Thou didst receive those that came at the eleventh hour, who had wrought nothing worthy:[^1149] so receive me also, a sinner. For greatly have I sinned, and greatly have I committed iniquity, and become defiled;[^1150] greatly have I provoked Thy Holy Spirit to wrath, and have bitterly grieved the compassionate bowels of Thy love for mankind, both by word, and deed, and thought, by night and by day, willingly and unwillingly, manifestly and secretly.[^1151] And I know that openly Thou wilt set all my sins before me, even such as they were wrought by me; and Thou wilt require an account of me, concerning those things wherein knowingly and in ignorance I have boundlessly transgressed.[^1152] But O Lord, Lord, do not by Thy righteous judgment, nor in Thine indignation rebuke me, neither in Thy wrath chasten me! Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for not only am I weak, but also I am Thine own creation.[^1153]

units.slavonic_incipit: просла́влю тѧ̀ въсегда̀, въ всꙗ̑ дни̑
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: прославлю тя въсегда в вс дни живота моего
units.slavonic_text: просла́влю тѧ̀ въсегда̀, въ всꙗ̑ дни̑ живота̀ мое́го • ты́ бо є҆си Б҃е Б҃ъ ка́ющихсѧ • и҆ тебѣ̀ сла́вꙋ възсыла́е[мъ], ѻ҆ц҃оу и҆ сн҃оу и҆ ст҃о́моу дх҃ꙋ • нн҃ѣ и҆ прсно и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣ́комъ, а҆ми́нь :~ того́же ст҃аго їѡа́нна дама́скина • мл҃тва • къ ст҃о́моу причаще́нїю • Оу҆ꙗзве́нъ е́смь ср҃це[мъ] а́зъ, и҆ и҆ста́ꙗ мѧ̀ ре́вность твоꙗ̀, и҆ и҆змѣнѝ мѧ̀ любо́вь твоꙗ̀ вл҃ко • свѧза́н[ъ] е́смь жела́нїемъ твои́мъ • да̀ и҆сплъ́нюсѧ ѿ твои́хъ пло́тей • да̀ насыщꙋ́сѧ живо́тныꙗ и҆ б҃готво́рны[ꙗ] ти кро́ве • да̀ въспрїимꙋ̀ твои́хъ бл҃гъ • да̀ напита́юсѧ твое́го бж҃тв[а] • да̀ досто́инъ бꙋ́доу грѧдоу́щоу ти
units.english_text: Wounded in heart am I, and Thy zeal hath melted me away, and Thy love hath transformed me, O Master; bound am I with desire for Thee:[^1167] that I may be filled with Thy Flesh, that I may be satisfied with Thy life-creating and deifying Blood, that I may receive of Thy good things, that I may be nourished with Thy Godhead,[^1168] that I may be worthy when Thou comest to meet Thee with glory in the airy catching up in the clouds, with all Thine elect:[^1169] that I may sing and worship, and glorify Thee thankfully in confession, with Thine unoriginate Father, and Thy most holy, and good, and life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^1170]

to meet Thee with glory in the airy catching up in the clouds, with all Thine elect:[^1169] that I may sing and worship, and glorify Thee thankfully in confession, with Thine unoriginate Father, and Thy most holy, and good, and life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^1170]

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: с славою оусрести тя на въздуш нем въсхищении
units.slavonic_text: съ сла́вою оу҆срѣ́сти тѧ̀, на въздꙋ́ш- нѣмъ въсхище́нїи на ѡ҆блацѣ́хъ, съ всѣ́ми и҆збра́нными ти • ꙗ́ко да пою̀ и҆ покланѧ́ꙗсѧ , и҆ славлю̀ тѧ̀ бл҃года́рнѣ въ и҆сповѣда́нїи • съ бе́з- нача́лнымъ ти ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ, и҆ пр҃тымъ и҆ бл҃гы́мъ и҆ животворѧ́щимъ ти дх҃омъ • нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ, а҆ми́нь :~ тогѡ́же ст҃го їѡа́нна дама́скина • мл҃тва • къ ст҃о́мꙋ причаще́нїю • На мно́жество щедро́тъ твои́хъ възира́ꙗ, и҆ поучи́нꙋ чл҃колю́- бїа твое́го Х҃е Б҃е • сѐ нн҃ѣ дръз- ноу́хъ пристꙋ́пити • жела́нїе и҆мѣ́ꙗ причасти́тисѧ ст҃ы́мъ твои́мъ и҆
units.english_text: Looking upon the multitude of Thy compassions, and the abyss of Thy love for mankind, O Christ God: lo, now have I dared to draw near, having desire to partake of Thy holy and[^1172] life-creating Mysteries; held fast by fear and dread, I fear to touch them because of the multitude of my sins, lest instead of enlightenment I be burned up.[^1173] Therefore I pray Thee and fall down before Thee, O all-good and marvelous King: forgive my transgressions, voluntary and involuntary; and vouchsafe me without condemnation to receive Thine all-pure Body and Thy precious Blood, unto enlightenment, unto delight, unto joy, and unto gladness of my soul and body,[^1174] now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

units.slavonic_incipit: и҆ да́ждь млⷭ҇ть ненави́дѧщимъ мѧ̀, и҆
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: и дажд млт ненавидящим мя и враждующим ми
units.slavonic_text: и҆ да́ждь млⷭ҇ть ненави́дѧщимъ мѧ̀, и҆ враждꙋ́ющимъ ми, и҆ поношѧ́щимъ ми • та́кожде и҆ ѡ҆клевета́ющимъ мѧ̀ • да никто́же ника́коже ѿ ни́хъ менѐ ра́ди нечи́стаго зло̀ нѣ́како постражде́тъ, ни въ ны́нѣшнемъ, ни въ бꙋ́дꙋщемъ вѣ́цѣ • но̀ ѡ҆чи́сти и҆́хъ млⷭ҇тїю свое́ю, и҆ покры́й и҆́хъ бл҃гтїю свое́ю бл҃гі́й • ѡ҆зарѝ и҆ просвѣтѝ и҆́хъ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ а҆ми́нь :~ Ст҃го сѷмеѡ́на метафра́ста • мл҃тва къ ст҃о́мꙋ причаще́нїю • Еди́нъ чⷭ҇тыи и҆ нетлѣ́нный Гьⷭ҇ • и҆́же за млⷭ҇рдїе чл҃колю́бїа неизрече́ннаго, на́ше въспрїе́мъ сꙋ́щество
units.english_text: And grant mercy unto them that hate me, and that make war against me, and that reproach me; likewise also unto them that slander me; that none of them in any wise on account of me, an unclean man, may suffer any evil, neither in this present nor in the world to come; but cleanse them by Thy mercy, and cover them by Thy grace, O Good One; illumine and enlighten them unto ages of ages. Amen.[^1176]

provenance.verbatim_source:

Amen.[^1176]

units.slavonic_text: безконе́чно славословлю̀ и҆ пою̀ тебѐ, съ безначя́лнымъ ти ѿце́мъ • и҆ прⷭ҇ты́мъ и҆ бл҃гыⷨ и҆ животворя́щимъ є҆диносꙋ́щнымъ ти дх҃омъ • нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡмъ, а҆ми́нь :~ того́же ст҃го сѷмеѡ́на метафра́ста мл҃тва къ ст҃о́моу причаще́нїю • Ѿче и҆ сн҃е и҆ дш҃е трⷭ҇це ст҃аѧ, бл҃гти неистощи́маѧ въ вѣ́къ текоу́щи • доброто̀ мнѡгорачи́телнаѧ, неимы́ сы́тости • вѣ́рою є҆ди́ною сп҃си́ мѧ, и҆ чрезъ наде́ждꙋ • Ѽ свѣ́те трисїѧ́телный Ѽ трⷭ҇це прⷭ҇таѧ • трⷭ҇це ли́ци, и҆ є҆дини́це сꙋ́ществомъ • и҆сточниче премоу́дрости, и҆ ѡ҆сщ҃е́нїа пода́телю •

units.slavonic_incipit: вѣ́рою є҆диною сп҃си мѧ̀, и҆ чрезъ
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: верою единою спси мя и чрез надежду
units.slavonic_text: вѣ́рою є҆диною сп҃си мѧ̀, и҆ чрезъ наде́ждꙋ • Ѽ ѻ҆́гню чисти́телный съгрѣше́нїемъ • дш҃ю мою̀ ѡ҆чи́сти прегрѣше́нїи • дш҃ю мою̀ ѡ҆мы́й невѣ́дѣнїи • дш҃ю мою̀ и҆схитѝ ѡ҆сквръне́нїи • дш҃и мое́й оу҆дръжи помышле́нїа • оу҆́мъ же въцр҃и над разꙋмѣ́ными • стра́стеⷨ покажи въсеси́лна цр҃ѧ • оу҆́мноую свѣ́щю въсїѧ́й срⷣцꙋ мое́моу • свободѝ ѿ тмы̀ грѣха̀ • просвѣтлѝ, и҆ оу҆краси помраче́ннаго • ѻ҆́комъ възри на мѧ̀ млⷭ҇ти́вны • ѡ҆чи́сти, оу҆бѣли потемнѣ́ннаго • Ѽ ѻ҆́ч҃е, сн҃е, и҆ дш҃е трⷭ҇це ст҃а́ѧ • ты́ ми пода́ждь а҆́гг҃ла свѣтоно́сна, оу҆моу̀ поспѣ́шника,
units.english_text: By faith alone save me, and through hope;[^1193] O Fire cleansing sins:[^1194] cleanse my soul of transgressions; wash my soul of ignorances; snatch my soul away from defilements; bridle the thoughts of my soul; and make the mind king over the intelligible faculties; show it forth as an all-powerful king over the passions;[^1195] cause an intellectual candle to shine unto my heart; deliver me from the darkness of sin; enlighten and adorn him that is darkened;[^1196] look upon me with a merciful eye; cleanse and whiten him that is blackened;[^1197] O Father, Son, and Spirit, Holy Trinity: do Thou grant me a radiant angel, a helper to my mind,[^1198] a tutor and protector, a guardian of my soul and body, a guide directing me unto salvation.[^1199] Do Thou make me that am earthly to be sanctified; do Thou separate me from earthly mindsets; do Thou dry up for me the torrents of wickedness; do Thou pour forth for me showers of tears;[^1200] for Thou art a merciful God and Benefactor, bearing no malice toward all that have worked lawlessness; all-accessible unto all that have sinned, longsuffering toward all that have fallen away;[^1201] not established for the righteous alone, nor revealed only to the blameless; Thou hast ordained salvation through confession, and hast granted patterns of repentance:[^1202] and unto me that am loathsome, and polluted; unto me that am deceitful and wretched; unto me that am dark and defiled;[^1203] for I have wrought lawlessness far more than the ancients; I have provoked Thee to anger, and have embittered Thee exceedingly; more than the number of the innumerable stars, more than the number of the sand of the sea have I sinned against Thee;[^1204] there is no form of evil more wicked, there is no shame of evil more deceitful, which I have not committed at every time and place, in soul, and in thought, and in words, and in deeds;[^1205] the abominations of my wickedness are multiplied; by myriads are my evil deeds multiplied; multiplied are the burdens of my transgressions; as by iron bands embittered through conceit[^1206] is my neck; with inescapable bonds am I constricted in heart; neither can I lift up my head, nor have I any relief in conscience;[^1207] unworthily therefore do I look upon the heavenly height; unworthily do I look upon the sight of men; unworthily do I give counsel unto my neighbor; unworthily do I tread upon the earthly dust;[^1208] for I have kindled Thine indignation utterly, and have excessively inflamed Thy dreadful wrath;[^1209] I have provoked Thee to anger, and have embittered Thee exceedingly; before Thee have I committed every abomination; neither have I desired any one of Thy pure volitions;[^1210] nor have I longed for any one of Thy desirable judgments;[^1211] neither have I kept any one of Thy most wise commandments; nor have I held fast any one of Thy sovereign words. And now I bend unto Thee the knees of my heart;[^1212] I bow down my darkened head; I bow down my defiled neck; unto Thy goodness do I bow down my neck; unto Thy goodness do I offer supplication.[^1213] I have sinned, I have wrought lawlessness, and I have committed offence; I have sinned, I have dealt unrighteously, and have transgressed Thy commandments; I have sinned, I have dealt unrighteously, and have condemned others; I have sinned, I have turned away, and was not ashamed;[^1214] yet I make supplication unto Thy goodness, yet I offer a prayer[^1215] unto Thy malice-free loving-kindness; but I beseech Thine extreme tender-heartedness; yea, I beseech and cry aloud: Save and cleanse me![^1216] Remit the multitude of my transgressions; remit the grievous burden of my debts; remit my many defilements; remit all my abominations.[^1217] And crush me not together with my sins; put me not to death together with mine iniquities; snatch me not away together with evil thoughts; burn me not up together with abominations.[^1218] Deprive me not of eternal good things; cast me not out from the immortal banquet; alienate me not from the joy of the saints; deprive me not of my salvation.[^1219]

units.english_text: Grant me again the gift of baptism, the divine Great Monastic Schema;[^1220] for the first I have mired in sins, the first I have defiled with abominations. Vouchsafe me sacred Communion, life, the chalice of God-streaming blood,[^1221] unto the cleansing of my sins, unto deliverance, and unto salvation. And in the final hour, the bitter hour of death; the hour grievous and painful; the hour dark and obscured:[^1222] save, have compassion, and cleanse me! Gently separate my soul from my defiled flesh; make my darkened soul to be illumined; deliver it from the wicked demons; and all the handwritten bonds of my sins,[^1223] tear up the writings of my debts; scatter them into the abyss of hades; rend them, turn them to ashes, burn them utterly to the end![^1224] Send then gentle and radiant angels, repelling the demonic hosts, snatching the soul away from torment, showing mercy to the wretched soul, bearing it on high apart from sins;[^1225] bearing it on high to bow down before the fiery-formed and radiant throne,[^1226] where all the saved offer praise, vouchsafing it the joy of the saints. Accept Thy goodness as an intercessor; grant me Thy grace as a pre-eminent intercessor:[^1227] Thy loving-kindness, Thy malice-free mercy, Thy compassion, Thine extreme tender-heartedness; tender-heartedness. Accept as a second intercessor Her Who is higher than the cosmos, the Adornment, the Mother, Virgin, and Maiden, the Divine Ladder and the Rod, the Animate Throne;[^1228] accept as intercessors the lightning-rayed ranks: Thrones, Cherubim, fiery Seraphim, Dominions, Powers, Authorities, Principalities, Archangels, and Angels;[^1229] accept as intercessor Thy radiant and light-bearing Forerunner, sanctified before swaddling-clothes, the God-proclaiming preacher who shone forth before the Master unto those that were in darkness;[^1230] accept as intercessors the choirs of the saints: the choirs of prophets, patriarchs, fathers, apostles, and crown-bearing martyrs,[^1231] and the assembly of all the holy and light-bearing ones. Accept as intercessor Mary of Egypt: a mortal from the earth, yet one who ascended into heaven;[^1232] accept as intercessor Onuphrius the Great, who, having stripped his body naked, was marvelously robed in divine raiment through good deeds.[^1233] For Thou art a merciful and beneficent God, a God meek unto transgressors, a God Who hast granted deliverance unto sins, a God bestowing salvation upon all; unto me also show all Thy goodness, and pour out upon me the streams of Thy tender-heartedness; for I have transgressed the law more than all men, from my very mother's womb even unto my present time.[^1234] Save me beyond merit,[^1235] and through hope, by Thy grace and Thy loving-kindness alone; that I may bless Thee and magnify Thee with love; that I may give thanks unto Thee and chant unto Thee with piety, being saved in the age to come; that I may bless the blessed Master, Whom the heavenly hosts bless, unto all unnumbered ages. Amen.[^1236]

units.slavonic_text: и҆ чре наде́ждꙋ • бл҃гтїю и҆ бл҃гты́нею твое́ю є҆ди́ною • ꙗ҆́ко да бл҃влю тѧ, и҆ любо́вїю велича́ю • ꙗ҆́ко да бл҃годарю̀ и҆ пою̀ тѧ бл҃гочⷭ҇тно, въ вѣ́цѣ же бꙋ́доущемъ сп҃са́емъ • ꙗ҆́ко да бл҃вєна бл҃влю влⷣкꙋ, є҆го́же бл҃ва́тъ нбⷭ҇ныѧ си́лы, въ вѣ́кы въсѧ̑ неи҆зчете́нныѧ, а҆ми́нь :~ Мл҃тва къ ст҃о́мꙋ причаще́нїю • Ст҃го сѷмеѡ́на но́ваго бг҃осло́ва • Ѿ бж҃твныхъ ра́чїй • Ѡт сквръ́ныи оу҆сте́ • ѿ мръ́зкаго срⷣца, ѿ нечи́стаго ѧ҆зы́ка, ѿ дш҃а ѡ҆сквръне́ны прїими моле́нїе х҃е мои́ • и҆ непре́зрѣвъ ми ни словеса̀, ни ѡ҆́бразы, ни дръ́зость,
units.english_text: From defiled lips, from an abominable heart, from an unclean tongue, from a polluted soul, receive supplication, O my Christ;[^1238] and despise not my words, nor my manners, nor my shameless boldness;[^1239] give me leave to speak boldly what I desire, O my Christ; and rather teach me what is fitting for me to do and to speak.[^1240] I have sinned more than the harlot, who, having learned where Thou didst abide, bought myrrh and came boldly to anoint Thy feet, my Master Christ and my God.[^1241] Even as Thou didst not cast her out when she approached from the heart, neither reject me, O Word;[^1242] but grant me to hold and kiss Thy feet, and with streams of tears, as with precious myrrh, dare to anoint them.[^1243] Wash me with my tears, cleanse me with them, O Word; remit my transgressions, and grant me mercy. Thou knowest the multitude of mine evils,[^1244] multitude; Thou knowest also my sores, and seest my wounds; yet Thou knowest also my faith, and seest my goodwill, and hearest my sighing.[^1245] For there is not hidden from Thee, O my God, my Creator, and my Redeemer, even a tear-drop, nor any part of a drop, nor any movement of the heart.[^1246] Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance, and in Thy book all things are written before Thee.[^1247] Look upon my lowliness, look upon all my toil, and forgive me all my sins, O God of all;[^1248] that with a pure heart, with fearful contemplation, and with a contrite soul, I may partake of Thy most pure and undefiled Mysteries,[^1249] whereby whosoever drinks and eats with a pure heart is vivified and deified.[^1250] For Thou hast said, O Master: *Whosoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood, he abides in Me, and I in him.*[^1251] True indeed is every word of my Master and God; and he who partakes of the divine and deifying graces is no longer alone, but with Thee, O my Christ, the Light of the Three-Sunned Radiance.[^1252] That I may not be alone apart from Thee, the Giver of Life, my breath, my life, my rejoicing, the salvation of the world:[^1253] therefore have I drawn near unto Thee, as Thou seest, with tears and a contrite heart,[^1254] asking to receive deliverance from my transgressions, and to partake uncondemned of Thy life-giving and undefiled Mysteries, that Thou mayest abide, even as Thou hast said, with me, a wretched man; lest the Deceiver, finding me bereft of Thy grace, seize me craftily, and having deceived me, lead me away from Thy deifying words.[^1255] Therefore do I fall down before Thee, and fervently cry unto Thee: Even as Thou didst receive the Prodigal, and the harlot that drew near, so receive me, prodigal and defiled, O Compassionate One, who now come unto Thee with a contrite soul.[^1256] I know, O Saviour, that no other man hath sinned against Thee as I,[^1257] nor did deeds such as I did. But this again I know, that neither the magnitude of transgressions, nor the multitude of sins, surpass the abundant love of my God for mankind;[^1258] but with the mercy of compassion Thou cleansest and makest radiant them that fervently repent, and makest them partakers of the Light; and, marvelous to angelic and human minds, Thou conversest with them many times, even as with Thine own near friends.[^1259] These things make me bold, these things give me wings, O my Christ; and trusting in Thy rich benefits toward us, I rejoice and tremble at once, partaking of fire, being but grass. A marvelous wonder:[^1260]

units.english_text: Brethren, I received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, that the Lord Jesus, in the night in which He was betrayed, took bread, and having given thanks, He brake it and said: Take, eat; this is My Body which is broken for you; this do in remembrance of Me. In like manner also the cup, after supper, saying: This cup is the New Testament in My Blood; this do, as often as ye drink it, in remembrance of Me. For as often as ye eat this bread and drink this cup, ye proclaim the Lord’s death, till He come. Therefore, whosoever shall eat this bread,[^1266] or drink the cup of the Lord unworthily, shall be guilty of the Body and Blood of the Lord. But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup. For he that eats and drinks unworthily, eats and drinks judgment unto himself, not discerning the Lord’s Body. For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and not a few sleep. For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged. But when we are judged, we are chastened by the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.[^1267]

units.english_text: The Lord said unto the Jews who came unto Him: I am the bread of life. Your fathers did eat[^1268] manna in the wilderness, and died. This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that if anyone eat thereof, he may not die. I am the living bread which came down from heaven. If anyone eat of this bread, he shall live unto ages; and the bread that I will give is My flesh, which I gave for the life of the world.[^1269] The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying: How can this man give us His flesh to eat? Then Jesus said unto them: Truly, truly, I say unto you: Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink His blood, ye have no life in you. Whosoever eats My flesh and drinks My blood hath eternal life,[^1270] and I will raise him up at the last day.[^1271]

units.english_text: For It is a coal consuming the unworthy.[^1275] The Flesh of God deifies me and nourishes me: It deifies the spirit, and marvelously and wonderfully nourishes the mind.[^1276] O man, shudder when thou eatest unworthily, for It is fire burning up sins. And cleanse me, O Lord, from every defilement.

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: члколубче нас ради оумрый же и въскрс и
units.slavonic_text: чл҃колꙋ́бче, на́съ ра́ди оу҆мры́й же и҆ въскр҃съ, и҆ дарова́въ на́мъ стра́шныѧ си́хъ, и҆ животво́рныхъ та́инъствъ • да́ждь бы́ти си́мъ мнѣ̀ въ и҆сцѣле́нїе дш҃и же и҆ тѣ́лоу • въ ѿгна́нїе всѧ́каго съпроти́внаго • въ просвѣще́нїе ѡ҆́чїю срⷣца мое́го • въ смире́нїе дш҃евныхъ ми си́лъ • въ вѣ́роу непосты́дноу • въ любо́въ нелицемѣ́рноу • въ исполне́нїе премоу́дрости • въ съблюде́нїе за́повѣдей твои̑ • въ приложе́нїе Бж҃твеныѧ ти бл҃гти, и҆ твое́го црⷭ҇твїа присвое́нїе • ꙗ҆́ко да̀ ст҃ынею твое́ю съхранѧ́емъ, твою бл҃гть помина́ю въсегда̀ • и҆ нектомꙋ̀ себѣ̀ живоу̀,
units.english_text: Lover of mankind, Who for our sake didst die and rise again, and didst bestow upon us these Thy dread and life-creating Mysteries: grant that these may be unto me for the healing of both soul and body, for the driving away of every adversary, for the enlightenment of the eyes of my heart, for the peacemaking of my soul's powers, for faith unashamed, for love unfeigned, for the fullness of wisdom, for the keeping of Thy commandments, for the increase of Thy divine grace, and for the attainment of Thy kingdom;[^1281] that preserved by Thy holiness, I may ever remember Thy grace, and no longer live unto myself,[^1282] but unto Thee, our Master and Benefactor; and thus departing this life in hope of eternal life, I may attain unto everlasting rest, where the voice of them that keep festival is unceasing, and infinite is the delight of them that behold the ineffable beauty of Thy countenance. For Thou art the true desire and ineffable gladness of them that love Thee, O Christ our God, and all creation doth glorify Thee unto ages. Amen.[^1283]

units.english_text: O Master, Christ God, King of ages and Creator of all: I thank Thee for all the good things which Thou hast given me, and for the communion of Thine all-pure and life-creating Mysteries. I pray Thee, O Good One and Lover of mankind: keep me under the shelter of Thy wings,[^1290] and grant me with a pure conscience, unto my last breath worthily to partake of Thy holy things, unto remission of sins, and life eternal.[^1291] For Thou art the Bread of life, and the Fountain of holiness, and the Giver of good things; and unto Thee do we send up glory, with Thine unoriginate Father, and Thine all-holy and good and life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.[^1292]

units.english_text: O Jesus, my God, incomprehensible and invisible;[^1295] O Fire, Who makest Thine angels a burning fire;[^1296] Who by Thine ineffable love hast delivered unto me for food Thy divine Flesh, receiving me as a partaker of Thy Godhead for the sake of the communion of Thine all-pure Body and Thy precious Blood: pass through my whole body and spirit, into all my bones and marrow,[^1297] burning up my sins, enlightening my soul, making clear my mind, illuminating my body, and making an abode in me with Thine all-blessed Father, that I also may abide in Thee evermore;[^1298] through the prayers of Thine all-pure Mother, and of all the saints. units.english_text: Thou Who willingly hast given me Thy Flesh for food, Who art fire consuming the unworthy: burn me not, O my Creator, but rather enter into my members effectually, and into all my joints, into my inmost parts and heart, burning up the thorns of all my transgressions;[^1302] cleanse my soul, sanctify all my thoughts, establish my mind together with my bones; illuminate the simple fivefold count of the senses;[^1303] nail me wholly to Thy fear evermore;[^1304] covering, keeping, and guarding me from every soul-destroying deed and word. Cleanse, wash, and enlighten me; adorn and give me understanding; show me forth as an abode of Thy Spirit alone, and no longer as an abode of sin; that being Thy temple through the entrance of communion, like fire burn up every evildoing and every passion.[^1305] As intercessors I bring unto Thee all the saints: the angelic hierarchies of the bodiless hosts, and Thy Forerunner, and the all-wise Apostles, and with them Thine all-pure Mother;[^1306] whose entreaties receive, O compassionate Christ my God, and reveal me as a child of Thy light, and show me forth as a minister unto Thyself. For Thou alone art the sanctification of our souls, O Good One, and[^1307] their radiance; and unto Thee, as is fitting unto God and Master, do we send up glory, all the days of our life, and now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

units.slavonic_text: свѣ́тлость • и҆ тебѣ̀ подо́бно ꙗ҆́ко Бг҃ꙋ и҆ вл҃цѣ сла́воу възсыла́емъ , въ всѧ̑ дн҃и живота̀ на́шего , и҆ нн҃ѣ и҆ прⷭ҇но и҆ въ вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́мъ, а҆ми́нь :~ мл҃тва, къ прⷭ҇тѣ́й Бц҃и • по ст҃о́мъ причаще́нїи • Прⷭ҇таѧ вл҃чце Бц҃е • свѣ́те помраче́нныѧ ми дш҃а, наде́жде и҆ покро́ве, прибѣ́жище и҆ оу҆твръжде́нїе, и҆ възра́дованїе моѐ • бл҃годарю̀ тѧ̀ ꙗ҆́ко сподо́била мѧ̀ є҆си недосто́йнаго прича́стника бы́ти прчⷭ҇томоу тѣ́лоу, и҆ чⷭ҇тнѣ́й кро́ви сн҃а твое́го • но ро́ждъшїи и҆́стинныи свѣ́тъ, просвѣти́ ми оу҆́мныѧ ѡ҆́чи срⷣца • ꙗ҆́же и҆сто́чникъ безсмр҃тїа ро́ждъшїа ,
units.english_text: All-holy Sovereign Lady Theotokos,[^1309] light of my darkened soul, my hope, shelter, refuge, consolation, and rejoicing: I thank thee that thou hast accounted me, unworthy though I be, to be a communicant of the all-pure Body and precious Blood of thy Son. But, O thou that didst bear the True Light, enlighten the spiritual eyes of my heart; O thou that didst give birth to the Fountain of immortality,[^1310] quicken me who am slain by sin![^1311] O Mother of the merciful and compassionate God, have mercy on me, and give me weeping and contrition in my heart, and humility in my thoughts, and recovery from the captivity of my reasonings;[^1312] and vouchsafe me, unto my last breath, uncondemned to receive the sanctification of the all-pure Mysteries, unto the healing of both soul and body. And grant me, O Sovereign Lady, tears of repentance and confession, that I may sing and glorify thee all the days of my life; for thou art blessed and most glorified unto ages. Amen.

units.slavonic_text: мл҃ть чт҃аа · и҆ бѣсо́вскыѧ и҆зба́ви роукы̀ · ꙗ҆́коже бо псѝ мнѡ́зи ѻ҆бь- стоупи́ша мѧ̀ :~ И҆ нн҃ѣ · Сѐ вре́мѧ по́мощи, сѐ вре́мѧ твое́го застоупле́нїа · сѐ влч҃це вре́мѧ ѡ҆ не́мже дн҃ь и҆ но́щь припада́х те́плѣ, и҆ молѧ́хсѧ тебѣ̀ :~ Пѣ́снь г҃ · І҆рмо́съ · Нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́коже ты Гд҃и Бг҃е · Дѡ́брїи моѝ дроу́зи и҆ зна́емїи · по- что̀ не пла́чете; почто̀ не рыда́ете · и҆ногда̀ люби́маго и҆ дроу́га и҆ бра́та · нн҃ѣ же стра́нна Бг҃а, и҆ всѣ́хъ ва́съ :~ Възлюбле́ннаа моа̀ бра́тїе, зрѧ́ще дѣѧ́нїа моа̀ ѻ҆блича́ема на стави́лѣ мѣри́лнѣмъ · Хр҃та̀ всѣ́хъ Бг҃а мо- ли́те, мл҃тива бы́ти ми :~

units.slavonic_text: Помлноу́йше оу҆́бо възлюбле́ннїи мое́го съпребыва́нїа, Хр҃та̀ моли́те при́- зрѣ́ти на́ мѧ · злоче́стнѣ живо- та̀ лише́на и҆ моу́чима :~ Сл҃: Приклонѝ оу҆́хо твоѐ къ мнѣ̀ Бг҃а мо- е́го мт҃и, ѿ высоты̀ мнѡ́гыѧ ти сла́вы бл҃гаа · оу҆слы́ши въздыха́- нїе послѣ́днее, и҆ роу́кꙋ ми прострѝ :~ И҆́нъ і҆рмо́съ · та́же · И҆здале́че сего̀ дн҃е влч҃це прови́дѧ и҆ того̀ ꙗ҆́ко прише́дша помышлѧ́ю пр҃но · слеза́ми те́плыми молѧ́хсѧ не забы́ти менѐ :~ Ѡ҆быдо́ша мѧ̀ мы́сленїи рыка́юще скѵ́мни, и҆ и҆́щоутъ въсхи́тити и҆ растрѣзати мѧ̀ го́рцѣ · и҆́хъже

units.slavonic_incipit: зоу́бы чт҃аа и҆ че́люсти съкроушѝ, и҆
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: зоубы чтаа и челюсти съкроуши и спси мя
units.slavonic_text: зоу́бы чт҃аа и҆ че́люсти съкроушѝ, и҆ сп҃сѝ мѧ̀ :~ Оу҆га́сшоу оу҆́бо ѿню́дъ ѻ҆рга́ноу сло- ве́сномꙋ · и҆ свѧза́вшоусѧ ѧ҆зы́кꙋ, и҆ затвори́вшоусѧ гла́соу · въ съкрꙋ- ше́нїи ср҃дца молю́ тѧ, сп҃си́телнице моѧ̀ сп҃сѝ мѧ̀ :~ Сла́ва · Въ безако́нїи зача́хсѧ, въскоу́ю роди́хсѧ · и҆ прогнѣ́вахъ Бг҃а бл҃га- го · ѿхождꙋ̀ въ ѡ҆́гнь вѣ́чныи моу́чимъ бы́ти :~ И҆ нн҃ѣ · Не ѿвратѝ ѿ менѐ мнѡ́гыѧ щедроты̀ твоѧ̑ · не затвори оу҆тро́боу твою чл҃колю́бноую чи́стаа · но предста́ни ми нн҃ѣ, въ ча́съ сꙋ́дный помлꙋ́й мѧ̀. Пѣ̑ д҃ · І҆рмѡ́ · Хс҃ мнѣ̀ си́ла Бг҃ъ и҆ Гд҃ь ·

units.slavonic_incipit: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ блоу́дномоу, го́ре ѡ҆каа́- нномоу
units.slavonic_stem_tier2: оувы мне блоудномоу горе окаа нномоу ко
units.slavonic_text: Оу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ блоу́дномоу, го́ре ѡ҆каа́- нномоу · ꙗ҆́ко роу́цѣ простира́ю къ мои̑ дрꙋгѡ́мъ · и҆ сле́зы ѿ ѻ҆́чїю про- лива́ю · и҆ никто́же помага́ет ми :~ По́двигъ предста̀ ми дш҃и всепа́гꙋбный · ѻ҆́чи възвожꙋ̀ къ Бж҃їимъ свѣ́тлы̑ а҆́гглѡ̑ въпїѧ̀, ма́ло ѡ҆ста́вите мѧ жи́ти · но никто́же послꙋ́шаетъ :~ Менѐ рыда́йте, менѐ плачи́те, а҆́гг҃лтїи събѡ́ри, и҆ зе́мнїи вси хр҃то- любци · немл҃тивно бо ми дш҃а ѿ тѣ́ла разлоуча́етсѧ :~ Сл҃: Влч҃це влч҃це нн҃ѣ помозѝ дш҃и недо- оумѣ́ющейсѧ · и҆ къ твое́мꙋ кро́вꙋ є҆ди́номоу зрѧ́щей · непре́зри оу҆́бо бл҃гаа, врагѡ́мъ възда́нꙋ быти ми :~
units.english_text: *Troparion:* Woe is me, the prodigal! Alas for me, the wretched! For I stretch out my hands unto my friends, and I shed tears from my eyes, and no one helps me.

units.slavonic_text: і҆рмо́съ · та́же · Ѻ҆́блаци кропи́те ро́сꙋ ꙗ҆́ко сле́зы, го́ры и҆ хлъми мл҃ти- вно ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ рыда́йте, оу҆да́лившꙋсѧ ѿ Бг҃а · и҆ прибли́жившюсѧ бѣсѡ́мъ :~ Непосты́дное непогрѣши́телное, всѣ́- мже въ ноу́ждахъ прибѣ́жище · влч҃це пренепоро́чнаѧ, ты̀ мнѣ̀ бꙋ́ди при- бѣ́жище въ ча́съ и҆спыта́нїа :~ Просте́рши прчⷭ҇тѣ́и своѝ и҆ всечт҃нѣ́и рꙋцѣ̀, ꙗ҆́ко сщ҃еннѣ́ голꙋби́нѣ кри́- лѣ · подъ кро́вомъ и҆ сѣ́нїю тѣ́хъ покры́й мѧ̀ влч҃це :~ Сла́ва · Въздоу́шнаго кнѧ́ѕѧ наси́лника мꙋ- чителѧ, стра́шныхъ пꙋтестоѧ́телѧ · и҆ напра́сныхъ сего̀ словои҆спыта́телѧ, сподо́би мѧ̀ прейтѝ невъзбра́нно,

units.slavonic_stem_tier2: се въси дние мои исчезоша въи стинноу
units.slavonic_text: Сѐ въси дні́е моѝ исчезо́ша , въи́- стинноу въ соуетѣ̀ ꙗкоже пи́шетъ · и лѣ́та моꙗ̀ съ тща́ніемъ · сѣ́ти же съмрътныꙗ и горкыꙗ , превари́ша ми дш҃ю , ꙗже ма̀ объдръжатъ :~ За текоу́щее временно́е наслаже́ніе , несмѣртно моуче́ быти хощюу блч̃це · и за ма́лоую сла́дость пло́тьскоую , вслѣ́ти въ ѡгнѝ · но мл̃ть твоꙗ̀ да превари́тъ мꙗ :~ Сла́ва · Ѡбходѧщеи ѿсю́доу нахо́дѧтъ , съдръжа́ще мꙗ въсю́доу · дш҃а же моꙗ ѿлага́ет и страши́тсѧ , мно́га исплъ́нена мѧ́тежа · ю́же оутѣ́ши чтаꙗ ꙗвле́ніемъ своимъ :~ И нн҃ѣ · Съпеча́лоующа ни єдинаго въ ско́рби

units.slavonic_text: Въскоу́ю ѿ чре́ва мт҃ре мое́ѧ изыдо́хъ азъ , роди́въ же сѧ стра́стно · како непогыбо́хъ а́бїе , хотѧ̀ въ ѡгнѝ вѣ́чномъ моу́читисѧ · оу́вы кто̀ мене въспла́че , или кто̀ помѧнет :~ Поне́же бѣсѡ́мъ въда́нъ бы́хъ , и въ а́дово дно̀ съ ноу́жею съведо́хсѧ · вѣ́мъ ꙗко вси забы́ша мꙗ · ты же помѧнѝ мꙗ , ѡ а́гг҃ле Гн҃ь :~ Бц҃а · Ѡ Хрⷭ҇а́ мое́го мт҃и , ка́ко мꙗ забы́ , ка́ко непреклонѝ на млⷭ҇рдїе , исто- чившаго кро́вь из ребръ · да сп҃сетъ и́хже създа́ · оу́вы ка́ко затвори́- сѧ млⷭ҇рдїе Хрⷭ҇а мое́го :~ І҆рмо́ та́же · Ꙗко Бг҃а чл҃колюбца мт҃и чл҃колюби́- ваꙗ , ти́химъ и мл҃тивнымъ вънмѝ
units.english_text: *Troparion:* Since I was delivered unto demons, and was brought down by force unto the bottom of hades, I know that all have forgotten me; but do thou remember me, O angel of the Lord!

units.slavonic_text: Преⷣ въсею̀ видимою же и невидимою тва́рїю , єгда̀ Хв҃и предста́нꙋ · трепе́щꙗ и на́гъ и страхозꙑбле́мъ · помѧнѝ мꙗ тогда̀ ст҃аꙗ Бц҃е :~ И нн҃ѣ · Высо́каꙗ влⷣкы Хрⷭ҇а пола́то · твою̀ блгⷣть съвы́ше посла́вши · преварѝ мꙗ нн҃ѣ въ дн҃ь ѡзлобле́нїа · да тꙗ сла́влю ст҃аꙗ Бц҃е :~ пѣ́снь ѳ҃ · І҆рмо́съ · Бг҃а чл҃кѡ не оу҆до́бъ ви́дѣти · Ни к томоу̀ а́зъ непомѧнꙋ̀ , нѣ́сть бо въ а́дѣ помѧноу́ти Гдⷭ҇а · но̀ въ тмѣ̀ лю́тѣ покрыва́емъ сѣдѧ̀ , ѡ- жида́ꙗ всѣ́хъ зе́мныхъ въскрⷭ҇енїе · да ѡсоужде́нъ къ ѡгнь въвръ́гꙋсѧ :~ Ниє́с к томоу̀ менѐ непомѧне́тъ , ни мно́жество а́гг҃лъ , ни а҆рха́гг҃лъ
